name: Tampere Races
description: Tampere Marathon 2025 juostaan sunnuntaina 31. elokuuta. Voit valita juostavaksi maratonin, puolimaratonin, neljänneksen maratonin (10,5 km) tai osallistua maratonviestiin, joka juostaan neljän hengen tiimeissä. Lapsille on oma Minimaratonin tapahtuma Tampereen Stadionilla. Reitissä on tapahtunut muutoksia verrattuna edellisiin vuosiin kaupungin rakennustöiden vuoksi, ja se kulkee pääasiassa asfaltilla ja osittain hiekka-alueilla.

name: Fiskarsin Maraton Raseporis 2026
description: Fiskarsin Maraton Raseporis 2026 on jännittävä juoksutapahtuma, joka tarjoaa osallistujille mahdollisuuden kokea upeita maisemia ja yhteisöllisyyttä. Tapahtuma houkuttelee juoksijoita eri tasoilta, ja se on erinomainen tilaisuus testata omaa kuntoa ja nauttia juoksusta. Maraton on suunniteltu tarjoamaan unohtumattomia hetkiä sekä kilpailijoille että katsojille.

name: Itämeri Maraton
description: Itämeri Maraton juostaan ja kävellään lauantaina 4.10.2025. Matkavaihtoehdot ovat maraton, puolimaraton ja varttimaraton (10,5 km). Virallinen kilpailuaika koko maratonille on kuusi (6) tuntia ja puolimaratonille sekä varttimaratonille 5,5 tuntia. Reitti on virallisesti mitattu, ja startti sekä maalialue sijaitsevat Keskuskoululla, Halmstadinkatu 2. Ennakkoilmoittautuminen päättyy tiistaina 30.9.2025 klo 24.00.

name: Keurusselän Syyslenkki
description: Keurusselän Syyslenkki juostaan Hotelli Keurusselän ja liikuntapuiston maastossa pääosin latupohjia hyödyntäen. Tapahtuma järjestetään lauantaina 4.10. klo 11, ja lenkit ovat pituudeltaan 6 km tai 10 km. Lähtö ja maali sijaitsevat Hotelli Keurusselkä alueella, ja molempien matkojen juoksijoiden kesken arvotaan paikallisia tuotteita sisältävä palkinto. Osanottomaksu on 15€, joka sisältää hotellin kylpylän käytön lenkin jälkeen.

name: Ilmaristen Ympärijuoksu
description: Ilmaristen Ympärijuoksu on juoksutapahtuma, joka järjestetään 06.10.2024 klo 11.00 – 13.00. Tapahtuma pidetään Ilmaristen Metsäpirtti, Pahkalaukkaantie 58, Ilmarinen, Lieto. Järjestäjänä toimii Liedon Luja, TUL V-S.

name: Pirkan Hölkkä & Kieppi
description: Syyskauden kuntoiluhuipentuma Pirkan Hölkkä juostaan sunnuntaina 5.10.2025 jo 55. kerran. Pirkan Hölkän yhteydessä järjestetään Pirkan Kieppi, 14 km, jonka startti tapahtuu Pirkan Hölkän maalialueelta, TAKK:n Nirvan toimipisteen pihalta klo 11.30. Noin 14 km Pirkan Kieppi syksyisen kauniissa Vuoreksen ja Hervannan maisemissa onnistuu kaikilta hyvän peruskunnon omaavilta liikkujilta. Tapahtumassa ei ole kiire, ja osallistujat voivat nauttia ulkona liikkumisesta sekä huoltopisteiden tarjoamista eväistä.

name: Paraisten Lenkki
description: Tule viettämään kanssamme Paraisten lenkin 60. juhlajuoksua sunnuntaina 6. lokakuuta 2024. Juoksulenkki juostaan perinteisellä 10,35 km reitillä, jonka lähtö ja maali ovat Pajbackan urheilukentällä, jossa on myös pukuhuoneet ja suihkutilat. Juhlan kunniaksi kaikille osallistujille jaetaan kultainen muistomitali ja uniikki Paraisten-lenkin T-paita. Maalintulon jälkeen tarjotaan kahvia, mehua ja täytekakkua kaikille osallistujille.

name: Fiskarsin Maraton Rasepori
description: Fiskarsin Maraton Rasepori järjestetään 20.06.2025 Raaseporissa, Fiskarin Urheilijoiden majalta, Kalliomäentie 4. Lähtö tapahtuu klo 10.00, ja kilpailutoimisto avautuu klo 8.30. Kilpailussa on tarjolla useita matkoja: 15 km, 7 km, 2 km ja 0,6 km eri ikäryhmille. Reitti kulkee kauniissa maisemissa hiekkateitä pitkin, mikä tarjoaa juoksijoille mahdollisuuden nauttia luonnosta ja rauhallisista reiteistä.

name: Energiruset
organizer: IF Göta Karlstad och Karlstads Energi
description: Energiruset is an evening race in Mariebergsskogen, organised in collaboration between IF Göta and Karlstads Energi. The race takes place on Thursday, 5 November 2026, and is family-friendly, with a choice of distances of 2 km and 5 km. The 5 km distance has a competitive category for those who want to test themselves; much of the course runs through woodland, and some sections are unlit. After finishing, all participants are treated to a hot dog by the organisers.
course_highlights: The course runs through Mariebergsskogen, including woodland.
Some sections of the course are unlit; a headlamp is recommended.
Distances: 2 km and 5 km; the 5 km has a competitive category.
additional: Date and location: Mariebergsskogen, Thursday, 5 November 2026. You can buy a headlamp when registering. Practical information (chip collection and exact start times) will be published on the organiser’s website. A previous race briefing is available as a PDF: https://ifgota.se/files/PM_ER_2025.pdf. After the race, IF Göta and Karlstads Energi will treat participants to a hot dog. The course will be open during the evening for non-competitive participants, who can start within a specified time window. The start times are tentatively around 18:00.

name: Nuuksio Pikkujoulu Ultra
description: Nuuksio Pikkujoulu Ultra järjestetään lauantaina 16.11.2024 Folkhälsan Solvalla idrottsinstitut -urheiluopistolla klo 9.00 alkaen. Tulossarjassa juostaan tasalähtöisin backyard-tyyliin, viimeinen lähtö klo 16.00 ja maali sulkeutuu klo 17.00. Höntsäsarjassa voi juosta omaan tahtiin niin monta kierrosta kuin haluaa, ja mukana on myös lyhennetty n. 5 km rata, joka tarjoaa yhteislähtöjen tunnelmaa. Tämä tapahtuma on loistava tilaisuus tutustua ultra-juoksuun kauniissa Nuuksion maisemissa, ja tarjoilut sisältävät glögiä, lämmintä mehua, pipareita sekä muuta pientä purtavaa.

name: Teivocup I
description: Teivo Cup I juostiin 26.11.2011 aurinkoisessa säässä, jossa lämpötila oli muutaman asteen yläpuolella. Kilpailuun osallistui 80 juoksijaa, jotka kilpailivat paikoitellen jäisellä reitillä. Nuorten sarjoissa oli mukavasti osanottajia, ja tyttöjen 11-vuotiaiden sarjassa parhaan ajan juoksi Mila Manninen (KU-68) 4.10. Yhdentoista vuoden poikien sarjassa Miska Manninen (KU-68) oli nopein ajalla 4.13, ja miesten 5 km:lla Jarkko Järvenpää paransi vanhaa reittiennätystä kahdella sekunnilla, juosten ajan 14.54.

name: TrailHunt Vooremäe 1000+
description: TrailHunt Vooremäe 1000+ is a trail race among the beautiful hiking trails and forests of Vooremäe in Tartu County. The race highlights challenges such as 1,000 metres of elevation gain in a single run, giving participants the chance to test their abilities and enjoy the positive energy of running on forest trails. The race centre is next to the new service building, with convenient shower facilities and a place to change clothes. There is a staffed aid station on the course, and timing uses a contactless SPORTIdent system. Distances range from a 14 km hike to a marathon of over 42 km, with marathon runners completing exactly three 14.1 km laps.
course_highlights: A 14.1 km lap following the direction of travel on Vooremäe’s large loop
More than 1,000 metres of total elevation gain on the marathon distance
A staffed aid station on the course, passed multiple times
additional: Race numbers can be found before the event in the start list on the Seiklushunt website. Timing uses the contactless SPORTIdent (SI AIR) system, with the chip attached to the wrist. Participants can shower and change clothes at the race centre after the event. There is one staffed aid station on the course, offering water, Coca-Cola and light snacks. On-site registration is not available. Transfers and other changes can be made only by email. Trail running, hilly terrain, registration via Stebby, aid stations, finisher medals, awards ceremony

name: Höstrusket
description: Höstrusket is a trail and road race in Norra Djurgården, Stockholm, taking place on 7 November 2026. Choose from 10 km, half marathon (21.1 km) or marathon (42.195 km), with the start and finish at Fisksjöängsvägen. The race is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners, and features encouraging pacers, well-stocked aid stations and an atmospheric end to the running season in the Royal National City Park. The event is organised by Marathongruppen together with local athletics clubs, and the surplus goes back to sport.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Fisksjöängsvägen in Norra Djurgården (approx. 800 m from Ropsten metro station)
Certified courses, mostly on asphalt with some gravel; 10 km: +103.9 m, marathon: total elevation gain +439 m
Well-stocked aid stations and lap support, as well as clearly marked kilometre signs
additional: Start/finish at Fisksjöäng (approx. 800 m from Ropsten metro station). Bib collection, pacer tent, food and coffee sales, bag drop for warm-up clothes and toilets at the event area. Changing and shower facilities are available at a nearby venue for a fee, a few hundred metres away. Chip timing by RaceTimer; pacers are available for several finish times (lists by distance). Cut-off times: 10 km 2:00, half marathon 2:30, marathon 5:30 (cut-off at the final lap point at 13:40). Minimum ages: 10 km from age 15 (age 13 when accompanied by a guardian); half marathon and marathon from age 17. Some aids and vehicles (poles, inline skates, strollers, bicycles, handcycles and racing wheelchairs) are not permitted; special conditions apply for guides and wheelchair users. The surplus goes back to sport. Registration is open.

name: Iron Backbone Ultra
description: Iron Backbone Ultra is a trail adventure in Kristinehamn built around the Järnleden and offers three distances (15, 30 and 50 km). The race takes place on varied and characterful terrain—deep forests, bogs, small lakes, pastures and old trails—putting both mental toughness and the joy of running to the test. The start and finish are at Hultets friluftsgård, and the 15 km course partly leaves the Järnleden. The organiser, Topp & Dröm, welcomes both experienced trail runners and those who want to try trail running for the first time.
course_highlights: The course largely follows the Järnleden through varied terrain (forests, bogs, lakes, pastures and old trails)
Start and finish at Hultets friluftsgård, Kristinehamn
The 15 km course partly leaves the Järnleden
additional: Three distances are offered: 15 km, 30 km and 50 km; start and finish at Hultets friluftsgård; from 1 October, places are limited to ensure a specially designed medal for every participant; organiser: Topp & Dröm (contact person Lasse / telephone 073-853 75 21), and the information pages have sections on aid stations and equipment. Start times: 30 km and 50 km at 17:00; 15 km at 17:30. No cups are provided at the aid stations; bring your own cup. Start and finish at Hultets friluftsgård, Kristinehamn. Entry fees are updated over time, and from 1 October, places are limited to secure a specially designed medal for every participant.

name: Jätten Bule-löpet
description: Welcome to the 57th Jätten Bule Run on 31 October 2026 at Bulevallen in Österbymo. The race offers an enchanting forest setting, with trails and gravel roads winding through the area. There are recreational race classes for 10 km, 5 km and 2.4 km, where everyone can enjoy a challenging run surrounded by beautiful scenery. IFK Österbymo warmly welcomes all runners to a well-organised event with timing and excellent service.
course_highlights: The 10 km course runs along floodlit trails, forest paths and gravel roads across hilly terrain
The final 4 km take you through an enchanting forest on winding trails with both climbs and descents
The 5 km course is a miniature version of the 10 km course, marked in blue, while the 2.4 km course follows the floodlit trail
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 09:00 at the IFK Österbymo clubhouse by the start area. Timing is chip-based. Changing rooms are available in the clubhouse. Refreshments, including coffee and hamburgers, are available at the start area. Payment by Swish or cash. Bulis will lead a warm-up at approximately 10:00 before the children’s race starts. Start and finish at Bulevallen, Idrottsvägen, Österbymo.

name: Panevėžio maratonas
description: The Panevėžys Marathon 2024 will take place in Panevėžys, Lithuania, and registration will open on September 13, 2024. Anyone who has registered and had a health check may participate. Participants can choose from various distances: a 400 m walk, 2.8 km, 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, and marathon, with different age requirements.

name: Barfrostløpet
description: The Barfrost Race on November 7, 2026, offers three distances: 1,500 m, 5,000 m, and 10,000 m, as well as a fun run class, Run4Fun, at 4.3 km. All starts and finishes are located outside Tanabru Kindergarten, across from the health center, on marked permanent routes in Tanabru center. There is an age limit for the various competition classes, with participants ranging from 4 to 85 years old. Changing rooms are open at Tana Multi-Purpose Hall, and there will be food service and a season kickoff talk after the race at Tanabru School, near the multi-purpose hall.
course_highlights: The Barfrost Race has three distances: 1,500 m, 5,000 m, and 10,000 m, as well as a recreational class, Run4Fun, at 4.3 km.
All starts and finishes are located outside Tanabru kindergarten, opposite the health center, on marked permanent routes in the center of Tanabru.
Changing rooms are open at Tana multi-purpose hall, and there will be food service and a season kickoff talk after the race at Tanabru school.

name: Teivocup
description: Teivocup on talvikauden testijuoksukilpailusarja, joka juostaan Teivon raviradan tienoilla marraskuu-huhtikuu -välisenä aikana kerran kuussa. Kukin osakilpailu on 5 km, ja sarjat ovat miehet ja naiset. Teivocupin toinen osakilpailu kuluvalla kaudella pidetään lauantaina 13.12.2025, jonka jälkeen järjestetään jäsenille pikkujoulut Lamminpään majan Takkahuoneessa klo 14.00-18.00.

name: Radioaseman Maraton
description: Radioaseman Ultra Maraton (100 km) järjestettiin Porissa 23.9.2023 Itä-Porin kuntoradalla, osoitteessa Radioasemantie 1, 28330 Pori. Reitti oli 2 km pitkä ja kulki Porin vanhan lyhytaaltoradioaseman ympäristössä. Tapahtumassa oli useita matkoja: 100 km, 50 mailia, 50 km joukkueena, 50 km yksilö, maraton 42,2 km sekä puolimaraton 21,1 km.

name: Haaga Run
description: Haaga Run juostaan yhdeksättä kertaa 8.11.2025! Tapahtuman järjestävät yhteistyössä Runner's High ja FC POHU. Tapahtumassa matkoina ovat 5 km ja 10 km, ja lähtö sijaitsee Lassilan liikuntapuistossa (Laurinniitynpolku 2, 00440 Helsinki).

name: Ambla SK SV suusatajate seeriajooks+kepikõnd
description: Ambla SK SV Skiers’ Series Run + Nordic Walking is a multi-stage running and Nordic walking series held at Kangrumägi in Järva County. The competition consists of five stages: the first four are time trials, and the final stage is a mass-start run. The results of the best four stages count toward the series standings, and prizes are awarded by age group. The competition is intended for runners using ski poles, which can be borrowed if needed. Special prizes are awarded to those who complete the series.
course_highlights: Five stages: the first four are time trials, and the final stage is a mass-start run
Held at Kangrumägi in Järva County
Only runners using ski poles are included in the competition standings
additional: Only runners using ski poles are included in the competition standings. Ski poles can be borrowed if needed. Every runner or Nordic walker who completes all five stages receives a special prize. Age groups range from age 6 to 55+. Points are awarded as follows: 1st place 30 points, 2nd place 27 points, 3rd place 25 points, and so on. In the event of a tie, the placing in the final stage decides. The fifth stage is scheduled for 8 November 2026, starting at 12:00. The best four stage results count toward the series standings.

name: Jessheim Vintermaraton
description: Jessheim Winter Marathon takes place on Sunday, November 9th in Jessheim. The marathon and half marathon will meet at the entrance to Myrvegen, where there will be a merging area of over 1 km, allowing everyone to find a good spot. This means that both the marathon and half marathon will be on the course at the same time.
course_highlights: The marathon and half marathon will meet at the entrance to Myrvegen.
There will be a weaving area of over 1 km, so that everyone can find a good spot.
Both the marathon and half marathon will be out on the course at the same time.

name: Nummela Backyard Ultra
description: Tervetuloa seuraamaan loppuunmyytyä tapahtumaa Nummelanharjulle! Tapahtuma juostaan 11.10.2025 alkaen klo 10:00 Nummelanharjulla Vihdissä. Kilpailu on Silver kilpailu, jonka voittaja lunastaa suoran paikan Satelliitti MM-kilpailuun vuodelle 2026. Voittajalle on luvassa 500€ rahapalkinto ja toiselle sijalle 300€. Kaikki osallistujat palkitaan NUBU-laudeliinalla ja puisella osallistujamitalilla.

name: Hercules Trail Run 11.10
description: Jo yhdeksännen kerran järjestettävä Hercules Trail Run kutsuu juoksijat Porvoon upeimmille poluille! Päivä alkaa lasten Polkurallilla, jossa vuosina 2013–2025 syntyneet pääsevät juoksemaan 2 km mittaisen reitin Mustijoen kauniissa luonnossa. Tämän jälkeen, tuntia myöhemmin, starttaavat porrastetusti 7 km, 14 km ja 21 km matkat. Reitti on suunniteltu sopimaan kaiken tasoisille juoksijoille ja ulkoilun ystäville, tarjoten ainutlaatuisen mahdollisuuden nauttia Porvoon upeimmista poluista lokakuun toisena lauantaina.

name: NAMI-matka
description: NAMI-matka juostaan lauantaina 11.10.2025 klo 9.00 Kyötikkälän urheilukeskuksessa, Kangasalla. Tarjolla on useita juostavia matkoja: 100 km, 50 km, maraton sekä nonstop, jossa voi juosta haluamansa määrän kilometrejä. Reitti on tarkkuusmitattu 2 km ja huolto on aina lähellä. Kaikille juoksijoille tarjotaan maalihuollossa keitto ja kahvia, ja osallistujat saavat osallistumismitalin.

name: Suojuoksun Elämyskisa
description: Loksemme voimme ilmoittaa, että Ojassuolle rakennettavan aurinkovoimalan rakennustyöt sallivat tänäkin vuonna Suojuoksun järjestämisen. Suojuoksu juostaan Kauklaisten Ojassuolla lauantaina 12.10.2024 klo 13. Tähän hieman erilaiseen juoksutapahtumaan kannattaa tulla haastamaan itsensä ja juoksukuntonsa sekä kokemaan omanlaisensa juoksuelämys. Tervetuloa läheltä ja kaukaa, sekä konkarit että ensikertalaiset!

name: Joutenlammen Jotos
description: Joutenlammen Jotos on matalan kynnyksen ulkoilutapahtuma kaikenikäisille, jossa voit valita oman tapasi osallistua. Juoksijoille on tarjolla 10 kilometrin juoksu ajanotolla, joka edellyttää ennakkoilmoittautumista. Osallistumismaksu on 20 euroa, ja hintaan sisältyy keittolounas, lastenhoito juoksun ajaksi sekä saunomismahdollisuus. Lapsille on oma maksuton lenkki sekä mukavaa puuhaa askartelun ja leikin parissa.

name: Joensuu Night Run
description: Joensuu Night Run 12h juostaan virallisesti mitatulla 325,336 metrin mondo-radalla Joensuussa 16.-17.11.2024. Kilpailu alkaa lauantaina klo 20:00 ja päättyy sunnuntaiaamuna klo 8:00, jolloin juoksusuuntaa vaihdetaan kolmen tunnin välein. Tapahtuma on IAU Bronze label -kilpailu ja siinä on sarjat naisille ja miehille, ikäraja 18 vuotta.

name: Gränsö Trailrun
description: Gränsö Trailrun is a running event in Gränsö Nature Reserve outside Västervik, offering technical and scenic trails, coastal rocky shorelines, and some of Sweden’s finest oak pastures around Gränsö Castle. Choose between 8 km and 15 km on well-marked courses, or let the children take part in Gränsö Kids Trail (up to age 12). The race offers both timed participation and Fun Run without timing, and encourages an enjoyable experience in nature—why not combine it with a spa visit at Gränsö Castle? Welcome to experience the Västervik archipelago at its best.
course_highlights: Coastal rocky shorelines and the cliffs of Skanvik along the course
Trails through sparse pine forest and valuable oak pastures, with technically varied sections
The 15 km course has a bonus loop on Ekholmen; the 8 km and 15 km courses join at the Kroken aid station
additional: The event center opens at 09:00 at Gränsö Castle. Start times: Gränsö Kids Trail 10:15, 8 km 11:00, 15 km 11:15. The first finishers are expected at approximately 11:35, and the finish closes at 13:45. Courses are marked with hanging red-and-white tape and signs; parts of the course follow existing hiking trails. Surface: mainly trails/hiking paths, with sections of rocky terrain, natural terrain, and short road stretches. Aid stations: one on the 8 km course and two on the 15 km course. All children receive a medal and refreshments after finishing. Registration is online and remains open until one hour before the start. 8 km and 15 km courses; online registration until one hour before the start; aid and hydration stations along the course; timed participation or Fun Run without timing; start times: 11:00 (8 km) and 11:15 (15 km); first finishers at approximately 11:35; finish closes at 13:45; spa option at Gränsö Castle.

name: Mörkertrail
location: Garphyttans nationalpark entrance parking area, Lekeberg Municipality, Sweden
price_range: 250 kr för vuxna; 50 kr för deltagare under 18 år
description: Mörkertrail is a unique 10 km trail race run in total darkness in Garphyttan National Park in Lekeberg Municipality. Participants run along a reflective-marked course featuring both technical and easy-running trails, with the light from their headlamps as the only source of illumination. The race offers an atmospheric and challenging experience, with elevation gain and the quiet of the forest as companions. After finishing, participants can enjoy a grilled sausage by the fire. The start and finish are at the car park by the national park entrance, and the race starts at 17:00 on 14 November 2026.
course_highlights: 10 km trail in total darkness, with a headlamp as the only source of light
Reflective-marked course featuring both technical and easy-running trails
Course with elevation gain on the edge of Kilsbergen
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 16:00. A short briefing takes place 10 minutes before the start. No on-site registration. The national park car park has limited spaces, so please carpool. Outdoor toilets are available, but there are no changing facilities. You must bring your own headlamp with a fully charged battery. The course has muddy sections and a water station halfway. Race bibs can be collected from 16:00; sausage and a drink are included after the finish. Places are limited, and there is no on-site registration.

Mustaschmilen takes place at Solvalla in Stockholm, where the horses make way for runners for a day. We’re looking forward to a festival on November 21. We’ll fill the stadium with runners of all ages and welcome you whether you’re an elite runner or a recreational runner. Together with the spectators, sponsors, and activities, we’ll make it an unforgettable arena experience.

Mustaschmilen in Stockholm has three distances: 5 km, 10 km, and 1 km for children. The two longer races will be run on a loop course filled with upbeat music and an enthusiastic announcer along the 1,000-meter course.

name: Klubbmesterskap 5k
description: The club championship 5k is a running competition that is part of Tjøme Running Club's events. The courses are officially measured, and the competition is held over a distance of 5 km. This championship gives members the opportunity to compete for club championship titles and set club records. The race takes place from beautiful Grønneset at Ånøya on Wednesday, June 25, starting at 6:00 PM, and is designed to challenge both beginners and experienced runners.

After the race, there will be opportunities for swimming, grilling, and an awards ceremony followed by applause.

name: Team Fillinge Ultras Terränglopp
location: Gummiverkstaden, Bankekind, Linköping Municipality, Östergötland, Sweden
description: Team Fillinge Ultra’s trail race is a friendly, local event organized by Team Fillinge Ultra. The race is approximately 10 km long and consists mostly of scenic gravel roads and lovely trails just outside Fillinge, south of Bankekind/Linköping. The event is being held for the second year and has a relaxed, welcoming atmosphere for trail runners who want to enjoy nature. Meet at Gummiverkstaden (gathering at 10:40); the race starts at 11:00.
course_highlights: Approximately 10 km
Mostly scenic gravel roads and lovely forest trails
Gathering and start at Gummiverkstaden, south of Bankekind (near Fillinge/Linköping)
additional: Information meeting at 10:40 at Gummiverkstaden; start at 11:00. The race is organized by Team Fillinge Ultra (contact: marcuslundin@gmail.com). Website operator/event partner: Trailrunning Sweden AB (info@trailrunningsweden.se). New course route for 2025 and all 100 entries sold out one week before the race; new hiking prize “The Golden Toaster”; logistics information includes a bus from Linköping toward Åtvidaberg (get off at Sandtorp) and parking at Gummiverkstaden (limited space; carpooling encouraged).

name: Hammarby Alpin Marathon
location: Vindskyddet i Barnbacken, Hammarbybacken, Stockholm, Sweden
description: Hammarby Alpin Marathon is a unique alpine marathon in the heart of Stockholm, running up, over and around Hammarbybacken. The race consists of 22 laps and is slightly longer than a standard marathon—a microultra that, in the organiser’s words, could also be called Sweden’s probably slowest marathon. The course is technical and spectator-friendly, with the lap point and finish at the shelter in the children’s slope. The event is a festive Advent celebration organised by Stockholm Multisportklubb.
course_highlights: 22 laps around Hammarbybacken (start, lap point and finish at the shelter in the children’s slope)
Start at the bottom of the hill (to the left of the lift when facing the summit) and climb over the “Trysil” section by the jetty
Technical sections: down along the service road, around the chimney, through Indianparken, inside the allotment gardens and along the cycle path
additional: Organiser: Stockholm Multisportklubb. Registration takes place at the lap point/finish (the shelter in the children’s slope). Nearest metro station: Hammarbyhöjden. Start location: at the bottom of the hill, to the left of the lift. Registration is via RaceID, according to the registration page. Registration and finish are at the shelter in the children’s slope; bags can be left at the foot of the hill; a tarpaulin is provided in case of rain; toilets are behind the car park; the right of public access applies; results are published after the race (top 10 faster).

name: Rantasaunan Lenkki
description: Rantasaunan Lenkki ja Osmojuoksut juostaan perjantaina 8.6. Osmo-juoksut alkavat klo 18.00, ja juoksijat sijoitetaan sarjoihin iän mukaan. Ilmoittautumisen jälkeen juoksijat jaetaan sopiviin eriin, ja numerot jaetaan noin klo 18.00. name: Adventsjoggen
description:
Experience a magical start to the festive season with Adventsjoggen at Stora Hjortstorps Gård in Örebro on 29 November! Bring your friends, family or colleagues for a day filled with exercise, community and delicious food. Choose between a scenic 7.2 km or a challenging 15 km. There’s also a 600 m Kidsrun for the youngest participants.

After the race, a warming reward awaits: hearty goulash and freshly baked bread, all included in the entry fee! The course takes you through beautiful surroundings, starting and finishing at the farm, along idyllic landscapes past Rävgången and Naturens Hus.

The course is relatively flat, making it one of the fastest certified 10 km options in Rogaland.

Kerran kuukaudessa järjestettävässä juoksussa on mukana aina 100-200 eri ikäistä juoksijaa, ja upea reitti kiertää Loimijoen maisemissa. Juoksijat starttaavat joko 5,8 km tai 11,2 km pitkälle reitille, joka kulkee Forssan kaupunkikeskustan liepeillä vanhan puuvillatehtaan puistossa. Lähtö ja maali sijaitsevat Keskuskadulla, yli satavuotiaan Elävien kuvien elokuvateatterin edustalla.

images.alt_text: Kolme juoksijaa Forssan Puistojuoksussa kauniilla reitillä.
Forssan Puistojuoksussa juoksijoita talvisessa maastossa.

name: 2026 Audi Vana-aasta jooksupäev
location: Rocca al Mare kool, Tallinn, Harju County, Estonia
description: Audi Vana-aasta jooksupäev is a traditional winter running event taking place on 19 December 2026 in front of Rocca al Mare School in Tallinn. The event centre and start/finish are conveniently located at the school, and the programme includes three distances: a marathon, a relay marathon and an 8.4 km run. The courses run mainly along shared-use paths and are well marked and safe, offering a sporting way to end the year. Participants are provided with medical assistance, timing, medals, and hot tea at the refreshment stations and finish.
course_highlights: The 8.4 km run follows shared-use paths and is marked with signs and course marshals.
The marathon consists of 5 laps, each a 8.44 km paved shared-use path.
The relay marathon consists of 5 legs, each a lap of 8.44 km.
additional: The marathon and relay marathon have participant limits of 100 marathon runners and 150 teams, respectively. The 8.4 km run is limited to 150 runners. Race numbers are distributed on race day at Rocca al Mare School. Medical assistance is available at the start/finish area. Awards are presented after the run or marathon, as applicable. Running on the road is prohibited and may result in disqualification. The course is in an urban setting. Registration and entry fees are listed in detail. The event is held annually and is part of the Estonian running calendar.

name: Panevėžio Kalėdinis Bėgimas
description: On the first Saturday of winter, the annual Eurovaistinė Christmas Run will take place, celebrating its 50th anniversary this year. This running festival will welcome thousands of participants, standing out for its festive atmosphere and distinctive participants dressed in Christmas costumes. The event schedule has been shifted so participants can run after dark, when the magical Christmas spirit comes alive on the streets of Panevėžys. This year, we invite you not only to prepare Christmas costumes but also to add illuminated details that will turn the crowd of runners into a glowing Christmas spectacle.

name: Valestrandsmarka Rundt
description: Valestrandsmarka Rundt is a fun run organized by Osterøy IL, taking place on May 24, 2024. Participants can look forward to a beautiful course of 4.4 km in scenic surroundings, with a start time at 6:45 PM. There is a great atmosphere in the pancake area, which brings together both experienced and new participants, and awards are given to those who have completed multiple races.
course_highlights: The course is 4.4 km around Valestrandsmarka in Osterøy.
Participants can expect a fantastic course with scenic surroundings.
There is a great atmosphere in the pancake area that brings together both experienced and new participants.

Two runners ready for Valestrandsmarka Rundt.
Runners ready to start in Valestrandsmarka Round.

name: Buugin Pamaus Juoksu
description: Tervetuloa ensimmäistä kertaa järjestettävään hyvän mielen uuden vuoden juoksuun Buugi Liikuntakeskukseen 31.12.2024 klo 18.00! Tapahtuman järjestävät yhteistyössä Buugi Liikuntakeskus ja Hippoksen Maratonkerho, ja sen tavoitteena on olla Keski-Suomen paras tapa aloittaa uuden vuoden vietto hyvässä seurassa juoksun ja buffet-ruokailun avulla. Osallistujat voivat valita 10 km:n matkan naisille ja miehille kilpa- sekä kuntosarjoissa.

images.alt_text: Juoksijoita maantiellä talvisessa maisemassa.  #BuugiPamaus
Juoksija punaisella juoksuradalla. Hyvän mielen uuden vuoden juoksu.

name: Uudenvuodenjuoksu
location: Tanelinrannan nuoriso- ja urheilukeskus, Lampitie 10, Seinäjoki
distance_verbose: 10 km, 10 km, 8.2 km, 7.6 km, 5 km, 5 km, 5 km, 5 km, 2.4 km, 1.2 km
description: Uudenvuodenjuoksu on upea tilaisuus nauttia liikunnasta uudenvuodenaattona. Tapahtuma järjestetään 31.12.2024 eri paikoissa, kuten Seinäjoella, Limingassa, Liedossa ja Imatralla, ja se tarjoaa osallistujille monipuolisia matkoja eri ikäisille ja tasoisille juoksijoille. Reitit ovat virallisesti mitattuja ja turvallisia, ja niillä on liikenteenohjaus. Tapahtuma kerää yhteen juoksuharrastajia ja tarjoaa myös mahdollisuuden nauttia kahvia ja virvokkeita alueen kioskeista.

images.alt_text: Eurajoen Uudenvuodenjuoksu -juoksija numerolla 323.

Eurajoen Uudenvuodenjuoksun lähtö, lumisessa säässä.
Eurajoen Uudenvuodenjuoksu - juoksijoita lumisessa maastossa.

name: Naujametinis ruonių maratonas
description: 2026-01-01 Pasvaliečiai invites all club members and friends to the 1st New Year’s SEALS MARATHON, which will take place in Pasvalys. This marathon is part of the traditional 18th ice-swimming event organized in Pasvalys District. After the marathon, a club members’ meeting will be held, during which the club’s most active members will be awarded.

name: Talvijuoksu Lappeenranta
description: Talvijuoksusarja on talvijuoksutapahtuma, joka järjestetään Lappeenrannassa. Tapahtuma alkaa ja päättyy Pallon liikuntahallin vieressä osoitteessa Tukkikatu 2. Ilmoittautuminen tapahtuu lähtöpaikalla 20 minuuttia ennen lähtöä, ja tarjolla on eri matkoja: 3 km, 5 km ja 7 km. Lapsille on tarjolla noin 1 km matka, ja kaikki reitit kulkevat valaistua pyörätietä pitkin edestakaisena reittinä. Tapahtuma on ilmainen ja kaikille avoin, pakkasraja on -15 C.

name: Polar Night Marathon
description: The Polar Night Marathon is a spectacular race during the blue hour north of the Arctic Circle. Choose from several distances, from 5 km to the full marathon (42.195 km), and experience the magic of the Arctic's magnificent nature. This race takes place in early January, during the polar night period, when the sun does not rise above the horizon.
course_highlights: Experience the magic of the Arctic's magnificent nature.
Choose from several distances, from 5 km to a full marathon (42.195 km).
The race takes place during the blue hour north of the Arctic Circle.

images.alt_text: Northern lights over Tromsø during the Dark Time Race. Magical!
Runners in the snow during the Mørketidsløpet in Tromsø.
Runners in the Polar Night Run in Tromsø. Snow, darkness, and festive lights.
Runners at the start of the Polar Night Run in Tromsø.

name: Talvijuoksusarja 3/6
description: Talvijuoksusarja 3. osakilpailu järjestetään 30.12.2023 Mikkelissä, ja se tarjoaa juoksijoille mahdollisuuden osallistua eri pituisille matkoille, kuten 10 km ja 6 km. Tapahtuma on suunniteltu erityisesti talviolosuhteisiin, ja se houkuttelee niin kilpa- kuin harrastejuoksijoita. Edellisissä kilpailuissa on nähty erinomaisia suorituksia, ja osallistujat voivat nauttia talvisesta juoksutunnelmasta.

images.alt_text: KOMIA Talvijuoksusarjan 3/6 osakilpailu Mikkelissä. Juoksijat maantiellä.

Juoksijoita KOMIA Talvijuoksusarjassa. Sateinen päivä.
Juoksija talvijuoksukilpailussa Mikkelissä.

name: Forssan Puistojuoksu
description: Forssan Puistojuoksu on jo 30 vuotta kaupungin kuntoa kohottava tapahtuma, johon osallistuu kerran kuukaudessa 100-200 eri ikäistä juoksijaa. Upea reitti kulkee Loimijoen maisemissa ja tarjoaa vaihtoehtoina 5,8 km tai 11,2 km pituiset matkat. Juoksijat starttaavat ja maali on Keskuskadulla, yli satavuotiaan Elävien kuvien elokuvateatterin edustalla.

name: XXV bėgimas Laisvės gynėjų dienai paminėti
description: The XXV Run Commemorating Freedom Defenders’ Day in Klaipėda is a traditional running event held to honour those who died and fought for Lithuania’s freedom. The event brings together the city’s community and visitors and takes place in Klaipėda on January 18. Participants can choose between two distances: the main 8 km course and a shorter 3 km course for schoolchildren, seniors and anyone who finds the longer course too challenging. The event starts in the evening, and the routes pass through scenic parts of the city, including a cycle path and the Summer Amphitheatre.
course_highlights: The 8 km course follows a cycle path past Klaipėda Summer Amphitheatre, Liepojos Street and H. Manto Street
Finish near Klaipėda City Municipality (Liepų St. 11)
The 3 km course starts near Klaipėda Summer Amphitheatre and is intended for schoolchildren and seniors
additional: Race bibs have an external timing chip. Picking up race bibs in advance is recommended to avoid queues on event day. Bib pickup for 8 km runners is on a bus near the Rotušė, and for 3 km runners it is near the Summer Amphitheatre. Buses depart for the start locations at 19:00. Individual warm-up: 19:45–19:55. The course closes at 21:20. Medals are awarded to the first 900 finishers. The event is organised with buses and community participation; the start is at the Klaipėda Giruliai Radio and TV Tower.

name: Teivocup III 2027
description: Teivocup III 2027 on kuusiosainen harjoituskilpailu ja testijuoksusarja, joka järjestetään kerran kuukaudessa marraskuusta huhtikuuhun. Tapahtuma tarjoaa juoksumahdollisuuksia eri ikä- ja sarjaryhmille, ja matkat ovat 5 km ja 2 km. Reitti kulkee kevyen liikenteen väylää pitkin, ja lähtö sekä maali sijaitsevat Teivon ravikeskuksen risteyksessä. Ilmoittautuminen tapahtuu Lamminpään Ulkoilumajalla, ja kilpailun startti on klo 12.00. Parhaat juoksijat palkitaan.
course_highlights: Reitti kulkee kevyen liikenteen väylää pitkin
Lähtö ja maali Teivon ravikeskuksen risteyksessä
Matkat 5 km ja 2 km eri sarjoille
additional: Ilmoittautuminen Lamminpään Ulkoilumajalla klo 11.30 mennessä, suositellaan saapumaan ajoissa ruuhkan välttämiseksi. Sarjat: 5 km M/M40/M50/N/N40/N50, 2 km P/T 09/11/13. Parhaat palkitaan. Kuusiosainen juoksusarja, rekisteröityminen alkaa klo 11:30, juoksu alkaa klo 12:00.

name: Götas ungdomsspel
location: Eva Lisa Holtz Arena, Karlstad, Sweden
price_range: 110–120 kr per gren; efteranmälan i mån av plats mot dubbel avgift
description: Götas Youth Indoor Games is an athletics competition for young people, held at the modern Eva Lisa Holtz Arena in Karlstad. The event provides a welcoming and supportive environment for young athletes to compete and develop in various athletics disciplines. The arena is a multifunctional indoor facility with seating for 1,700 spectators, creating a great atmosphere for both participants and spectators. The event is organised by IF Göta Karlstad, one of Sweden’s most successful athletics clubs, and offers a safe and inspiring competition environment.
course_highlights: The competition is held indoors at Eva Lisa Holtz Arena, a modern venue with seating for 1,700 spectators
Multifunctional facility for both competitions and training
Organised by IF Göta Karlstad, a club with a long tradition and a strong record in athletics
additional: The competition takes place at Eva Lisa Holtz Arena, which opened in 2022 and is a modern indoor venue for athletics and physical training. The multifunctional arena is also used for meetings and training courses. IF Göta Karlstad covers the entry fees for a maximum of three events per competition for its members. Entries for children and young people under 14 should be sent to the relevant group email address, or to tavlingsanmalan@ifgota.se if no group email address is available. Enter by 24 January via EasyRecord or gus@ifgota.se. Participants compete in their age category or the senior category.

name: EcoTrail Stockholm Winter
location: Stora Skuggan, Norra Djurgården, Stockholm, Sweden
description: EcoTrail Stockholm Winter is a winter adventure for runners who love nature even when the temperature drops. The race takes place in beautiful Norra Djurgården, starting and finishing at Stora Skuggan. Choose from three distances on snowy trails and enjoy a unique winter medal at the finish. After the race, warm up at the after-run with a hot drink and refreshments alongside other runners.
course_highlights: Rolling snowy trails in Norra Djurgården
Aid stations at 4 km on the 6 km and 12 km courses
Start and finish at Stora Skuggan, easily accessible by metro and bus
additional: Everyone who finishes receives a unique winter medal. Aid stations are located at 4 km on the 6 km and 12 km courses. The start and finish are at Stora Skuggan, close to the metro and bus. After the race, a warming after-run with a hot drink and refreshments is available. Registration is through the partner EQ Timing and is binding, with no refunds. Refund protection can be purchased as an add-on through Startklar. Start and finish at Stora Skuggan. Registration is open until 29 January 2027.

organizer: Marathongruppen med Hässelby SK och Spårvägens FK

description: Winter Run Stockholm is an atmospheric winter race taking place at Skansen and Djurgården on January 31, 2027. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km on a course that combines historic surroundings with beautiful winter scenery, illuminated by fire performers, torches and flares. The race also includes a children’s race for ages 7–11, making it an experience for the whole family. The event is organized by Marathongruppen together with the athletics clubs Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK, and any surplus goes back to sport.
course_highlights: 5 km course with 57% paved surface and 43% gravel
Just over 1 km through Skansen’s historic surroundings, with the rest around Djurgården
The course is illuminated by flares, fire baskets and a fire show
additional: Children’s race: 1.3 km for ages 7–11. Minimum age: 13 for 5 km (11 when accompanied by a parent or guardian) and 15 for 10 km (13 when accompanied by a parent or guardian). Skansen is a dog-free zone. The course is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association and officially measured by an approved course measurer. There is a risk of ice on the course, so shoes suitable for winter conditions are recommended. Skansen opens to runners at 14:30. Start times: children’s race 16:30, 5 km 17:00, 10 km 18:00. There is also a children’s race for ages 7–11. Any surplus goes back to sport.

name: Teivocup IV 2027
description: Teivocup IV 2027 on kuusiosainen harjoituskilpailu- ja testijuoksusarja, joka järjestetään marraskuusta huhtikuuhun kerran kuukaudessa. Tapahtuman neljäs osakilpailu juostaan 6. helmikuuta Lamminpään Ulkoilumajalla Ylöjärvellä. Sarjassa on useita matkoja eri ikä- ja sarjaluokille, ja reitti kulkee kevyen liikenteen väylää pitkin Teivon ravikeskuksen risteyksen läheisyydessä. Ilmoittautuminen tapahtuu paikan päällä viimeistään klo 11.30, ja lähtö tapahtuu klo 12.00. Parhaat juoksijat palkitaan.
course_highlights: Reitti kulkee kevyen liikenteen väylää pitkin
Lähtö ja maali Teivon ravikeskuksen risteyksessä
Useita matkoja eri ikä- ja sarjaluokille (5 km ja 2 km)
additional: Ilmoittautuminen tapahtuu paikan päällä Lamminpään Ulkoilumajalla viimeistään klo 11.30. Sarjassa on matkat 5 km (M/M40/M50/N/N40/N50) ja 2 km (P/T 09/11/13). Useita kilpailuluokkia, tapahtuma tarjoaa mahdollisuuden osallistua talvijuoksuun suomalaisessa luonnossa.

name: Vintermossa (Mossaloppet)
description: Vintermossa is a winter edition of Mossarun, a trail race featuring a challenging, technical 21 km loop with over 600 metres of elevation gain. The race is self-supported and unstaffed, so participants navigate using a GPX file, with no trail markings. A large fire is kept burning throughout the event to warm up cold runners, and participants can grill their own food. Skis are allowed if there is enough snow, making it possible to combine running and skiing on the loop.
course_highlights: 21 km loop with 600+ metres of elevation gain
Technical, hilly terrain with high-quality trails
Unstaffed race with self-navigation using a GPX file
additional: The race is unsupported, with no timing or checkpoints. There is no cut-off time. Mandatory equipment includes an emergency blanket and a headlamp. A large fire is kept burning throughout the event for participants to warm themselves between laps. Participants can choose to run one or more laps. Skis are allowed when there is snow. Participants are encouraged to Swish any amount they wish to War Child or another organisation of their choice. An external race calendar lists the distance as 241.4 km; this information is not confirmed on Mossarun’s results page.

name: Sormlands Winter Trail
location: Nävekvarns IP, Nävekvarn, Nyköping Municipality, Sweden
description: Sörmlands Winter Trail is a winter race offering three distances: 43 km, 22 km and 10 km, all starting and finishing at Nävekvarns IP in Nävekvarn. The routes pass through varied terrain, including forest trails, hilly landscapes and scenic coastal sections, providing a challenging and picturesque experience. The race uses electronic timing and has several aid stations with food and drinks along the course. After the finish, all participants are served a hot meal and non-alcoholic recovery beer. Safety is a priority, with mandatory equipment and access to showers and changing rooms at the start.
course_highlights: Varied terrain with forest trails, hilly slopes and coastal paths
Several aid stations with food, hot drinks and Umara Energy
Electronic chip timing and clear cut-off times for each distance
additional: Start times: 43 km at 09:00, 22 km at 10:00, 10 km at 11:00. Maximum cut-off times: 8 hours for 43 km, 5 hours for 22 km, 2 hours for 10 km. Mandatory equipment includes, among other things, a mobile phone, windproof jacket, thermal base layer, hat, gloves, water bottle (at least 500 ml), whistle, emergency blanket and headlamp when running in the dark. Showers, changing rooms and toilets are available at Nävekvarns IP. Parking is available for a fee at the start/finish area. After the race, runners are served a hot meal and non-alcoholic Mineral Brewing Recovery Lager. The distances are 10, 22 and 43 km. Race numbers can be collected at the start area at Nävekvarns IP. Aid stations offer food and hot drinks, and a hot meal is served at the finish. Mandatory equipment includes, among other things, a charged phone, wind jacket, water and trail shoes with good grip. Parking is available for a small fee.

name: Bėgimas varžybos „Bėgame už Laisvę“ 2026
description: The “We Run for Freedom” race is a unique running event in Mažeikiai, held to commemorate February 16, the Day of the Restoration of the State of Lithuania. The event promotes an active lifestyle, community, and the celebration of freedom. Participants are invited to join this traditional celebration and run together for freedom.
course_highlights: 10 km road race
The event takes place in Mažeikiai
Held to commemorate February 16
additional: All runners are advised to gather at the 200 m start at 11:35. The event includes various age groups; registration takes place at M. Račkauskas Gymnasium, and participants receive medals.

name: LAPONIE Boreal Winter-Trail Trail To Be Alive
description: Laponie Boreal Winter-Trail on ainutlaatuinen talvinen seikkailu Inarissa, joka tarjoaa osallistujille mahdollisuuden kokea arktinen luonto ja revontulet. Tämä talvinen polkujuoksutapahtuma vie juoksijat upeisiin maisemiin Lapin erämaassa, tarjoten unohtumattomia elämyksiä luonnon keskellä. Tapahtuma on osa Trail to Be Alive -sarjaa, joka tunnetaan laadukkaista ja elämyksellisistä polkujuoksukilpailuistaan eri puolilla maailmaa. Juoksijat voivat odottaa haastavaa mutta palkitsevaa reittiä, joka yhdistää luonnon rauhan ja talven kauneuden.
course_highlights: Arktinen talvinen erämaa Inarissa
Mahdollisuus nähdä revontulia
Haastava polkujuoksureitti luonnon keskellä
additional: Tapahtuma on osa kansainvälistä trail-kiertuetta, mutta tarkempia tietoja reitistä tai rekisteröitymisestä ei ole saatavilla.

name: SFT - Skåne Frozen Trail
description: Skåne Frozen Trail is a trail running event offering several distances in the beautiful Snogeholm area, with the start and finish at Gydarps gård. The race features challenging and scenic routes on the Skåneleden and other trails, with distances of 12 km, 30 km and 50 km ultra. The event is open to all levels and focuses on competing against yourself rather than others, with a warm and welcoming atmosphere. Participants can enjoy well-marked courses, electronic timing, aid stations and warming soup after the finish. SFT is also part of the RUNTGS 70K Challenge 2027.
course_highlights: 30 km route on the Skåneleden and trails in Snogeholm
50 km ultra with 30 km + 20 km laps
New 12 km distance with 150 m elevation gain
additional: Mandatory equipment: emergency blanket and mobile phone. Well-marked course with electronic timing. Manned aid stations at km 15/45 and an additional one near the finish area for the 50 km. Heated cabin with toilet and shower. Soup with bread after the finish. Limited number of places. Accommodation can be booked near the start/finish through Des ti nation Snogeholm. Start and finish at Gydarps gård in Snogeholm. Elevation gain: 150 m D+ for 12 km, 505 m D+ for 30 km and 830 m D+ for 50 km. Emergency blanket and mobile phone are mandatory equipment. Limited number of places.

name: Teivocup V 2027
description: Teivocup V on talvinen testijuoksukilpailusarja, joka järjestetään Teivon raviradan ympäristössä marraskuusta huhtikuuhun kerran kuukaudessa. Kilpailussa juostaan 5 kilometrin reitti, ja se on suunnattu kaiken tasoisille juoksijoille harrastajista kilpaurheilijoihin. Ilmoittautuminen tapahtuu paikan päällä vähintään tuntia ennen starttia, ja osallistumismaksu on 10 euroa per tapahtuma, seuran jäsenille 7 euroa. Sarjassa on miesten ja naisten sarjat sekä yhteisökilpailu.
course_highlights: 5 km juoksureitti Teivon raviradan ympäristössä
Talvinen kilpailusarja marraskuusta huhtikuuhun
Sopii kaikentasoisille juoksijoille harrastajista kilpaurheilijoihin
additional: Ilmoittautuminen tapahtuu paikan päällä vähintään tuntia ennen starttia. Sarjassa on miesten ja naisten sarjat sekä yhteisökilpailu. Tapahtuma tarjoaa mahdollisuuden osallistua 5 km juoksuun ja liittyä suomalaiseen juoksuyhteisöön. Osallistumismaksut ja tarkemmat tiedot eivät ole tällä hetkellä saatavilla.

name: Lapland Arctic Ultra
description: Lapland Arctic Ultra is an extreme winter race held in Överkalix, Swedish Lapland. The race offers several distances from 20 km to 500 km, and participants can choose to compete on foot, on skis or by mountain bike. The courses follow snowmobile trails through frozen rivers, lakes, marshes and forests, with spectacular views and challenging Arctic conditions. The start and finish are at Grand Arctic Resort, and the race crosses the Arctic Circle twice on the 185 km distance. This is a unique challenge for endurance athletes who want to test their limits in Europe’s last wilderness.
course_highlights: Courses on snowmobile trails through frozen rivers, lakes, marshes and forests
The 185 km distance crosses the Arctic Circle twice
Start and finish at Grand Arctic Resort in Överkalix
additional: Participants can choose to compete on foot, on skis or by mountain bike. A mandatory training camp is required for participants with no experience in extreme cold. Transfers are available from Jockfall to the start area, including transport of pulks. There is no prize purse. Drop bags are not allowed under the rules. The start is at Grand Arctic Resort in Överkalix, beside the Kalix River. A training course is planned for 2–5 March 2027 and is mandatory for participants with no experience in extreme cold.

name: 2026 metų Kovo 11-osios bėgimas, skirtas Lietuvos Nepriklausomybės atkūrimo dienai paminėti
location: Gargždų kultūros centras, Gargždai, Klaipėdos apskritis, Lithuania
price_range: nemokamai iki IV grupės, 4-5 eurai vėlesnėms grupėms

tiers.label: tier_1

description: The 2026 March 11 Run is dedicated to commemorating Lithuania’s Restoration of Independence Day and aims to encourage the public to take part in sports and identify the strongest runners in various age groups. The event takes place near Gargždai Cultural Centre, and participants can choose from different distances according to their age and fitness level. The run is open to everyone, with participants starting in groups between 10:00 and 10:30. This traditional event promotes physical activity and brings the community together to mark an important date.
course_highlights: Start and finish near Gargždai Cultural Centre
Different distances from 1.3 km to 14.3 km, according to age group
The course consists of laps, with the number run determined by age group
additional: Race bibs can be collected on race day from 8:45 to 9:30. Participants start in two groups: Groups I–III at 10:00, and Groups IV–V at 10:30. Registration is online only and closes on March 10 at 20:00. Participants may not be accompanied by bicycles or other vehicles during the run; directional markers will be placed along the course. Various race courses, online registration, awards, traffic management during the event.

name: Nuotykių lenktynės „Aplink Rėkyvos ežerą“
description: The “Around Lake Rėkyva” adventure race is a stage of the Lithuanian Running Cup, held in Šiauliai by Lake Rėkyva. It is a run approximately 14.5 km long, intended for recreational and professional runners, with the aim of promoting running and encouraging a healthy lifestyle. The event takes place in spring and is part of the Lithuanian Running Cup series, which includes various races throughout Lithuania. Participants are invited to test their abilities and enjoy the natural scenery around the lake.
course_highlights: An approximately 14.5 km route around Lake Rėkyva
The race takes place in Šiauliai, surrounded by nature
A Lithuanian Running Cup stage for both recreational and professional runners
additional: The entry fee is non-refundable unless the event is cancelled. Participants may change their distance or transfer their registration to another participant until advance registration closes, subject to a €10 change fee. Registration and entry fee administration is handled by VšĮ Bėgimo taurė. The event took place on 2026-03-15, but the planned date is 2027-03-21; the course is not marked, participants choose their own route, and navigation and tactics are important.

name: Vantaan Maantiejuoksucup 4/5
description: Vantaan Maantiejuoksucup on Suomen suurin ja nopein talvijuoksusarja, joka tarjoaa matalan kynnyksen maantiejuoksukilpailuja Vantaan Hakunilassa. Sarja koostuu viidestä osakilpailusta, joissa juostaan 5 km ja 10 km matkoja. Kilpailut houkuttelevat laajan osallistujajoukon, ja ne juostaan virallisesti mitatuilla reiteillä aurinkoisissa kevätsäissä. Sarjapassin ostamalla voi osallistua kaikkiin osakilpailuihin helposti ilman erillistä ilmoittautumista joka kerta. Tapahtuma on perinteikäs ja tarjoaa myös mahdollisuuden juoksukouluihin ja valmennukseen.
course_highlights: Virallisesti mitatut 5 km ja 10 km reitit Vantaan Hakunilassa
Nopeat ja tasokkaat talvijuoksukilpailut
Kilpailut järjestetään aurinkoisissa kevätsäissä ja houkuttelevat laajan osallistujajoukon
additional: Sarjapassin ostamalla osallistuu kaikkiin viiteen osakilpailuun ilman erillistä ilmoittautumista. Kilpailunumerot haetaan kisatoimistolta ja palautetaan jokaisen kisan jälkeen. Vaihtomahdollisuus matkan välillä infopisteellä puoli tuntia ennen lähtöä. Kenttäurheilijat-58 ry:n jäsenet voivat osallistua maksutta sarjapassilla, kun jäsenmaksu on maksettu. Tarkka tapahtuma ja tulokset, ei suoraa mainintaa hinnasta tai radan erityispiirteistä

name: Bėgimas „Runway Run 2026“
location: Lietuvos oro pajėgų bazė, Šiauliai, Lithuania
description: Runway Run 2026 is a 3 km run held at the Lithuanian Air Force Base in Šiauliai. The event offers a unique opportunity to run on a runway, an unusual and exciting place to race. It is intended for school pupils, college students, the community, and the public, promoting an active lifestyle and sports. Participants can enjoy the distinctive atmosphere and test their abilities on this special course.
course_highlights: 3 km run on a runway
Location: Lithuanian Air Force Base, Šiauliai
Unique running course within the airport grounds
additional: The event is intended for school pupils, college students, the college community, and the public. Registration is open, but prices and registration deadlines were not specified. Free parking spaces may be available for students. The event takes place in a setting organized by Šiauliai State College. The event date is April 3, 2027; the distance is 3 km; the location is the Lithuanian Air Force Base in Šiauliai. Registration details were not specified.

name: Påsksmällen

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Män och kvinnor öppen klass Landsväg 5 km 12:30 300:-

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Män och kvinnor öppen klass Landsväg 10 km 12:30 300:-

description: Påsksmällen is a classic road and cross-country race organized by Enhörna IF, starting and finishing at Enhörna Friluftsgård in Södertälje. The race offers several categories for children, youth and adults, with distances ranging from approximately 600 metres to 10 kilometres. This well-established event will be held for the 49th time in 2027 and offers an enjoyable and challenging running experience in scenic surroundings. Participants can look forward to a family-friendly atmosphere, with on-site late registration available. Swedish Athletics Federation competition rules apply.
course_highlights: Classic road and cross-country race
Start and finish at Enhörna Friluftsgård
Several distances from 600 m to 10 km
additional: On-site late registration is available until 60 minutes before each start, for an additional fee (SEK 100 for adult categories, SEK 50 for youth categories). Start times for children’s and youth categories are between 11:00 and 11:35, while adult categories start at 12:30. Results and start lists will be published on the website. Participation constitutes consent to the publication of names and any photographs on the association’s website and social media. Regular registration closes on 27 March. On-site late registration is available until 60 minutes before each start and costs extra. Everyone is welcome in the recreational category.

name: Kanallöpet
location: Bergvallen, Borensberg, Motala Municipality, Östergötland, Sweden
organizer: Borensbergs IF, OK Skogsströvarna, Vreta SoMK
description: Kanallöpet is an annual running event offering both competitive and recreational categories over half-marathon, 10 km and 5 km distances. All races start at 13:00 from three different locations along National Road 34 between Linköping and Motala, and finish at the Bergvallen sports ground in Borensberg. The race is organised by Borensbergs IF, OK Skogsströvarna and Vreta SoMK, and welcomes runners of different ages and abilities. Buses transport participants from the finish area to the start locations before the race. Late registration is available at the start locations for an additional fee.
course_highlights: Mass start from Ljungsbro, Sjöbacka bridge and Brunneby Musteri
Finish at the Bergvallen sports ground in Borensberg
Bus transport from the finish to the start locations before the race
additional: Race bibs can be collected at the respective start location before the start. Late registration takes place at the start locations between 11:30 and 12:30, with a 50% surcharge on the regular fee. Medals are free for participants aged 16 and under; others can buy a medal at the finish. Refreshments are available at the finish area. The distances are suitable for both competitive runners and recreational runners, with membership required for the competitive category. Registration is via the web, with payment by Swish or bank giro. The race has a long tradition and attracts around 360 participants each year.

name: SäterMaran inkl. DM i halvmaraton
description: SäterMaran is an annual running event in Säter that includes the district championships in the half marathon. The event offers several distances, including the half marathon and 10 km, and welcomes runners of different levels. It is organized by Säters IF FIK and is known for its friendly atmosphere, focus on the joy of running, and sense of local community.
course_highlights: Half marathon and 10 km distances
Low participation in the full marathon, with a focus on the half marathon and 10 km
Held in Säter amid scenic surroundings
additional: Late registration for the full marathon is closed due to low participation, but registration for the half marathon and 10 km remains open as usual.

name: adidas Premiärmilen
description: adidas Premiärmilen is a 10-kilometre race that kicks off the running season in Stockholm. The race follows a course in Norra Djurgården, with the start and finish near Universitetet metro station. Runners can test their fitness ahead of upcoming races or get their running year underway with the help of experienced pacers. The course has been officially measured and features a varied mix of surfaces: asphalt, gravel and paving slabs.
course_highlights: 10 km course in Norra Djurgården with 117 metres of elevation gain
Surfaces: asphalt (64.7%), gravel (29.8%), paving slabs (5.3%) and wooden bridge (0.2%)
Start and finish approximately 500 metres from Universitetet metro station
additional: Time limit: 2 hours from the start. Minimum age: 15 (born in 2012). Walking poles, strollers, inline skates, roller skis, bicycles and racing wheelchairs are not permitted. Wheelchair participation is allowed subject to special conditions, with participants starting in the final start group. Water stations are strategically placed along the course. The provisional start time is 11:00, and the time limit is two hours. Water stations and medical services are available along the course and at the start and finish area.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.stockholmmarathon.se/premiarmilen/): 2027-04-03 — "ANMÄLAN ÄR ÖPPEN – VI SES DEN 3 APRIL 2027" (was estimated 2027-03-27)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: ANMÄLAN ÄR ÖPPEN – VI SES DEN 3 APRIL 2027

name: Tradicinės bėgimo varžybos „Senvagė-2026“
location: Senvagė and Kultūros ir poilsio parkas, Panevėžys, Lithuania
description: The traditional “Senvagė-2026” running competition is part of a Lithuanian Running Cup stage and takes place in Panevėžys, in Senvagė and Culture and Recreation Park. The event brings together running enthusiasts from various cities to promote sports, a healthy lifestyle, and the discovery of the natural and cultural beauty of Lithuania’s regions. The competition is part of the long-standing Lithuanian Running Cup tradition, which has brought together professional and amateur runners across the country since 2009. The event takes place in spring, giving participants the opportunity to enjoy nature and active recreation.
course_highlights: The competition takes place in Senvagė and Culture and Recreation Park in Panevėžys
A traditional Lithuanian Running Cup stage featuring runners from various cities
Encourages participants to discover the nature and architecture of Lithuania’s regions
additional: Registration is managed by VšĮ Bėgimo taurė. The entry fee is non-refundable unless the event is cancelled. Participants may change their distance or transfer their registration to another person no later than the close of advance registration. If changing from a more expensive to a less expensive distance, the price difference is non-refundable. The participant change fee is 10 euros. The event will take place at Kranto g. 24, Panevėžys, with online registration available.

name: Komian kirkon hölkkä
description: Komian Kirkon hölkkä on Ylistaron Kilpa-Veljet ry:n järjestämä juoksutapahtuma Ylistaron alueella. Kilpailu tarjoaa monipuolisia reittejä, kuten 5 km, 10 km ja puolimaraton, jotka kulkevat kauniissa maastossa ja tarjoavat vaihtelevia maisemia. Tapahtuma on suosittu paikallisten keskuudessa ja tarjoaa hyvän mahdollisuuden testata kuntoa kevään alussa. Kilpailu on osa Ylistaron Kilpa-Veljet ry:n aktiivista tapahtumakalenteria ja suunnistustoimintaa.
course_highlights: Vaihtelevat reitit: 5 km, 10 km ja puolimaraton
Kauniit ja monipuoliset maastot Ylistaron alueella
Reittikartat saatavilla 5 km ja puolimaraton/10 km reiteille
additional: Kilpailuohjeet juoksijoille, kannustajille, huoltajille ja kökkäväelle löytyvät kilpailuinfo-sivulta. Tulospalvelu ja ilmoittautuneet ovat nähtävissä verkossa. Kilpailun reittikartat ovat saatavilla PDF-muodossa 5 km ja puolimaraton/10 km reiteille. Tapahtuma järjestetään 4. huhtikuuta 2027, ja se sisältää erilaisia kilpailu- ja osallistumismahdollisuuksia. Kilpailun tulokset ja lisätiedot löytyvät tapahtuman verkkosivuilta.

name: Arctic Marathon
description: Arctic Marathon tarjoaa ainutlaatuisen juoksukokemuksen Suomen Lapin upeissa maisemissa. Valittavana on maraton, puolimaraton ja 10 km:n matkat, jotka kulkevat läpi arktisen luonnon. Osallistujat majoittuvat neljän tähden suomalaisissa mökeissä, joissa on sauna, ja nauttivat täysihoidosta sekä monipuolisista aktiviteeteista, kuten huskysafareista, avantouinnista ja revontulien katselusta. Tapahtuma yhdistää urheilun ja elämykset ainutlaatuisella tavalla, ja se on osa kansainvälistä Wildmarathon-sarjaa.
course_highlights: 42 km:n maratonreitti Suomen Lapin luonnossa
Mahdollisuus juosta myös 21 km puolimaraton tai 10 km
Reitti kulkee arktisessa ympäristössä, jossa voi nähdä revontulia
additional: Tapahtumaan sisältyy lentokenttäkuljetukset Rovaniemeltä Santa Claus Holiday Villageen, majoitus 4* mökeissä saunoineen, kaikki ateriat, palkintojenjako, huskysafari, avantouinti ja mahdollisuus nähdä revontulia. Ohjelmassa on myös juoksun jälkeinen sauna- ja jäähdyttelyaktiviteetti sekä rentoutumista. Juoksun lähtö tapahtuu Santa Claus Holiday Villagesta. terrain includes snow roads and forest tracks, temperatures from -12°C to -7°C, recommended gear includes spikes and thermal clothing, registration includes accommodations, meals, transfers, and Arctic experiences

name: Vårruset Uppsala
location: Studenternas IP, Uppsala, Uppsala Municipality, Sweden
description: Vårruset Uppsala is a recreational race for women, offering distances of 2.5 km and 5 km, with the start and finish at Studenternas IP. The event is all about the joy of movement and camaraderie, and welcomes participants of all fitness backgrounds and ambition levels. You can register individually or as part of a team; registered teams receive a picnic after crossing the finish line. Vårruset has a long tradition dating back to 1989 and offers an inclusive environment where women can feel safe and inspired to take part.
course_highlights: Certified 5 km course
Start and finish at Studenternas IP, Ulleråkersvägen 6
Picnic after the finish for teams of 5
additional: Race bibs can be collected May 3–5 at Intersport Boländerna. Picnics can be collected using the team captain’s race bib. The event area opens at 17:30, with a sponsor village and activities. There is a place to leave warm-up clothes and showers are available at the arena. Water stations and toilets are located at the start and finish. The recommended age is 11 for the 2.5 km distance (from age 7 when accompanied by an adult) and 13 for the 5 km distance (from age 11 when accompanied by an adult). Registration is binding and remains open until race day, up to 1 hour before the start. Optional timing is available, and all individual participants receive a medal, a finish-line bag and a race bib. The event is suitable for recreational runners and teams and is held in an inclusive atmosphere.

name: Östgötatidningen Mjölby Stadslopp
price_range: 325 kronor (ordinarie), 195 kronor (kyrkundan), gratis för barnloppet, tillkommer 50 kronor för efteranmälan
description: Östgötatidningen Mjölby City Run is a popular running event featuring a scenic six-kilometre course through Mjölby, starting and finishing in Stadsparken. The course runs along the Svartån and includes both challenging climbs and enjoyable downhill stretches, on an almost entirely asphalt surface. In addition to the main race, there is also Kyrkundan, approximately 3 km, and a free children’s race, Bostadsbolaget Lilla Stadsparksloppet. All participants who cross the finish line receive a medal in recognition of their achievement. The race is organised by Norrköpings Löparklubb in collaboration with IK Akele and Mjölby Cykelklubb.
course_highlights: 6 km course starting and finishing in Stadsparken, Mjölby
Runs along the Svartån for most of the route; 99% asphalt
Includes challenging climbs and enjoyable downhill stretches
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport Mjölby on Friday 8 May from 12:00 to 18:00, with a 25% discount coupon. The warm-up is led by Fitness4You before the start. Everyone who crosses the finish line receives a medal. The children’s race has four starts between 11:00 and 11:45, with age groups up to 12 years. The main race starts at 13:00 and Kyrkundan at 13:10. Late registration is available until 8 May for an additional fee of SEK 50. Massage is available in the start and finish area. The race takes place in Stadsparken, with options for company tents, registration via the website, race bib collection at Intersport Mjölby, and sponsorship.

name: Springtime Mariestads stadslopp

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Gratis deltagande för barn upp till årskurs 6 och personer med funktionsvariation

description: Springtime Mariestads Stadslopp is an annual road race organized by Mariestads AIF and Korpen Mariestad since 1982. The race takes place in Mariestad in early May and offers several distances for all ages and abilities, including 10 km, 5 km, a children’s race and a race for people with disabilities. The event is part of the Västsvenska Löparcupen and welcomes both competitive and recreational runners in various categories. It is a traditional, well-attended running festival with strong involvement from volunteers and participants.
course_highlights: Two main distances: 10 km (2 x 5 km) and 5 km on city streets
Children’s race and race for people with disabilities, with shorter 500 m and 2,000 m routes
Part of the Västsvenska Löparcupen
additional: Start times: Funkisloppet at 10:30, Minimara at 11:15, 10 km and 5 km at 12:00. Participation in the senior and veteran categories requires membership in a club affiliated with the Swedish Athletics Federation. Participants may run with a guide in Funkisloppet. Course maps are available via a link on the website. Multiple race distances, including 5 km, 10 km, and children’s and disability races; registration is required; medals and prizes for participants.

name: Kungsholmen Runt
price_range: 100 kr rabatt för medlemmar, övriga priser ej specificerade
description: Kungsholmen Runt is a popular running race in Stockholm, offering both half-marathon and 10 km distances. The race follows flat courses around Kungsholmen, making it an excellent opportunity for anyone looking to set a personal best. The event is a celebration for all, with the start and finish in Rålambshovsparken, and welcomes runners of all ages and abilities.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course around Kungsholmen
Start and finish in scenic Rålambshovsparken
The race offers both half-marathon and 10 km distances
additional: The race is a celebration for all, with flat courses suited to setting a personal best. There is also a children’s race. The start and finish are at Rålambshovsparken. Information about bus services and road closures is available for participants. Terrain around Kungsholmen, registration via link, children’s race for up to age 13

name: Björnlunken 2026
description: Björnlunken is a trail race that welcomes everyone, from children and recreational participants to experienced runners and mountain bikers. The race follows a scenic route through the pine-covered esker between Alberga and Kungsör, along trails and gravel roads with moderate hills and technical sections. The event has an open, welcoming atmosphere created together by volunteers, spectators and participants, and is run by Kungsörs Sportklubb on a voluntary basis. Many return year after year, while new participants take part for the first time.
course_highlights: Trail running and cycling along a pine-covered esker
Trails and gravel roads with moderate hills
Technical sections in nature between Alberga and Kungsör
additional: Late registration opens on the Thursday before race week. Start lists for pre-registered participants are available. The race is run by Kungsörs Sportklubb on a voluntary basis, with a strong sense of community among participants, volunteers and spectators.

name: Startmilen
price_range: 2026 års avgifter: 50–80 kr för KnatteStarten, 100–250 kr för 5 km och 200–300 kr för 10 km
description: Startmilen is a recreational race in Örebro that welcomes runners of all abilities and marks the start of the outdoor running season for many. The event offers a 1 km race for children, 5 km for juniors and veterans, and 10 km for competitive runners and recreational participants. The start and finish are at Tybblelundshallen, near Örebro University, and the course runs along streets in the Almby district. The 10 km race is the district championship for Södra Svealand and is part of the Södra Svealand Running Series. Official timing is provided for all races except the children’s race.
course_highlights: Start and finish outside Tybblelundshallen at Örebro University
The course runs along streets in the Almby district
The 5 km and 10 km courses are certified by a federation course measurer
additional: Race numbers are distributed at Tybblelundshallen from around 10:30 on race day. Timing uses a transponder, which is loaned out when race numbers are distributed and must be returned after finishing. A fee of SEK 800 applies for a lost transponder. All races except KnatteStarten are timed. Prize ceremonies take place at 13:40 for the 5 km and 15:30 for the 10 km. All finishers receive a medal. All finishers receive a medal. Information about distances and fees is from the 2026 edition and may change for 2027.

name: Tjust Trail Run
description: Tjust Trail Run is a trail race organised by Tjust Bike & Running Club in Västervik. The race offers a challenging and sweaty competition on winding trails, over beautiful rocky outcrops and through the scenic nature of Småland. Participants get to experience the Småland forest in a unique way, running across varied terrain. Welcome to a wonderful running experience in a beautiful natural setting.
course_highlights: Winding trails through the Småland forest
Sections over beautiful rocky outcrops
Beautiful and varied terrain
additional: Changes to the race distance are possible by email until 31 March. On the longest distance (The Long Run), runners must complete a lap by 11:45 to be allowed to continue for the second lap. Race bibs must be clearly visible. Trail shoes and a mobile phone are recommended. If withdrawing, participants must notify a race official or call the number provided. Transport can be arranged from aid stations if needed. Trail shoes and a mobile phone are recommended. Distance changes can be made until 31 March.
