description: Koeru kergejõustikuvõistlused on traditsiooniline kergejõustiku võistlus, mis toimub Koeru KK staadionil. Võistlusel osalevad mehed ja naised kahes vanusegrupis ning võisteldakse mitmetel aladel, sealhulgas 100 m jooks, kaugushüpe, kuulitõuge, kettaheide, odavise ja 1000 m jooks. Võitja selgitatakse kolme parema ala punktide liitmise teel. Võistlus on avatud kõigile ja pakub võimalust osaleda kõigil aladel, kus noored kasutavad oma vanuseklassile vastavaid heitevahendeid.

name: Maardu kevadjooks
description: Maardu kevadjooks ja tervisekäimine on traditsiooniline spordipäev, mis toimub Maardus ja toob kokku liikumishuvilised igas vanuses. Üritusel on mitmed jooksud ja tervisekõnnid erinevatele vanusegruppidele ja võimekusele, sealhulgas lastejooksud, noortejooks, erivajadustega inimeste matk ning 3 ja 5 kilomeetri jooksud. Osalemine on tasuta ning iga lõpetaja saab medali. Ürituse eesmärk on pakkuda liikumisrõõmu, hea enesetunde ja aktiivset päeva värskes õhus, rõhutades perede ja sõprade koosveedetud aega.

name: jooks ümber Harku järve
description: Arco Vara 55. jooks ümber Harku järve toimub 30. mail 2026 Tallinnas Harku järve rannas. Tegemist on 6,5 km pikkuse jooksuga, mis kuulub 2026 Maru Järvejooksude sarja ja on selle sarja teine osavõistlus. Lisaks jooksjatele on oodatud ka kepikõndijad ja käijad, kes stardivad viimases grupis. Rajal on joogipunktid ning võistluskeskus pakub lisaks jooksule ka laste kergejõustiku töötuba ja pop-up poode. Osalejatele tagatakse medal, ajavõtt kiibiga, spordijook ja vesi rajal ning autasustamine.

name: adidas Stockholm Marathon
description: The adidas Stockholm Marathon is a classic marathon that takes place this year on 30 May 2026 and attracts both elite and recreational runners. The race is 42,195 metres long, measured according to current regulations, and follows a new course through central Stockholm. The event is organised by athletics clubs Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK, and the organisers highlight extensive runner services along the course. The race starts at Stockholm Olympic Stadium and offers seeding opportunities through events including adidas Premiärmilen and adidas Premiärhalvan.
course_highlights: 42,195 metres, measured according to the Swedish Athletics Association and IAAF
New course through central Stockholm (including Sveavägen and Kungsgatan), passing through the city
World-class runner services along the entire course
additional: Start and finish area: Lidingövägen outside the clock tower at Stockholm Olympic Stadium. The race starts in two waves, at 12:00 and 12:10. The marathon time limit is 6.5 hours, and there are four checkpoints with cut-off times along the course. Seeding: the deadline for submitting a time for seeding is 3 May 2026; adidas Premiärmilen and adidas Premiärhalvan count towards seeding. adidas Premiärmilen (10 km) takes place in Norra Djurgården, has a total elevation gain of 117 m, mixed surfaces and a provisional start time of 11:00; the time limit is 2 hours and the contact for Premiärmilen is info@premiarmilen.se. The event is organised by Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK, and the website is provided by Marathongruppen i Stockholm AB. The event is sold out for 30 May 2026. The course runs through central Stockholm and finishes at Stockholm Olympic Stadium; runners can also take part in related Adidas events such as Premiärmilen, Premiärhalvan and Shake Out Run.

name: Backyard Ultra Vänge
description: The loop is a real gem, if we may say so ourselves—a slice of Uppland at its best. The race hub is High Chaparral Park, with its large green spaces: a natural race base in the heart of the community of Vänge. Backyard Ultra Vänge will draw spectators along the course, which awaits you dressed in lovely spring attire. We have taken care to create a varied and somewhat challenging course. The result is an experience where something is always happening and the running never gets monotonous. Large parts of the race take place on the slightly bumpy trail on the outskirts of the community. You’ll feel as if you’re flying over soft ground beneath big trees and past colossal rocks. Several national-team runners began their running careers here, and many prominent floorball players have sweated through hard training sessions. An oasis in the forest—with a glimpse of Highway 72. A road tunnel takes you beneath the highway and into the unique Uppland rowing village of Vänge-Ekeby. The village, which has been a listed building since 1998, has medieval origins and a preserved village layout. Vänge Hembygdsförening has given the village an active cultural life and attracted many visitors. The course winds through this fantastic setting. Take the opportunity to enjoy the atmosphere and a glimpse of society as it once was. Then it’s back beneath the highway and into the forest on small trails. Before you know it, you’re back in the community and looping around High Chaparral. Take a short rest and perhaps enjoy some of the energizing snacks on offer. Then you’re off again. Wonderful!

name: Seskarö Trailrun 2026
location: Seskarö Havsbad & Camping, Seskarö, Haparanda Municipality, Sweden
distance_verbose: 12 km, 7 km, 3000 meter, 2 km, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: Seskarö Trailrun 2026 is northern Sweden’s most fun race, offering courses for everyone, regardless of experience or age. It’s a competition and an experience for the whole family, with a focus on the joy of running. The courses wind through Seskarö’s fantastic trails and the beautiful natural surroundings of the Haparanda Archipelago, with varied terrain including forest, gravel, cobblestones and sand. Several distances are available, from 500 metres for the youngest participants to 12 km for those looking for a greater challenge on technical terrain.
course_highlights: The course follows existing trails and combinations of trails, with varied surfaces including forest, gravel, cobblestones and sand
Technically challenging sections with jumps over logs and rocks, as well as sandy and cobblestone sections
Detailed course maps for 12 km (clockwise), 7 km (clockwise) and 3 km (counterclockwise) are available on site
additional: Race bibs can be collected on Friday 29/5 from 17:00 to 20:00 and on Saturday 30/5 from 08:00 at Seskarö Havsbad & Camping. Race numbers must be collected at least 30 minutes before the start. All participants receive a Seskarö Trailrun participant medal. Showers and toilets are available. Proceeds from the entry fee go towards maintaining and developing the Seskarö Trails outdoor recreation area. The race is held at Seskarö Havsbad & Camping. Proceeds go towards maintaining and developing the Seskarö Trails outdoor recreation area.

name: Blue Mountain Trail Run
price_range: 150–550 kr beroende på distans och anmälningstid

price_tiers.distance: 15 km - Alvars stig by Nordväggen AB
6 km - Östra Ånnabodasjön by ICA Glansen

description:
Blue Mountain TrailRun is a trail race in Kilsbergen, 20 kilometres west of Örebro. Four courses of 6, 10, 15 and 21 km, all starting and finishing at First Camp Ånnaboda.

The courses follow Bergslagsleden and the MTB trails around Ånnaboda: narrow paths, roots and rocks, boardwalks over streams, moss-covered spruce forest and views over forest lakes. The 21 km Blankhult course has 527 metres of elevation gain and is the race’s long loop, for those looking for technical trails and hills. The 15 km Alvars stig is the middle distance, with trails all the way. The 10 km Trolldalsvägen is the classic 10-kilometre course. The 6 km Östra Ånnabodasjön course loops around the lake on mostly easy-to-run trails and is suitable as a first trail race.

Women’s and men’s categories on all courses, no time limit, electronic timing and a medal for everyone who finishes. The runner who breaks the course record on the 21 km course receives 5,000 kronor. Fifth edition in 2027, organised by Garphyttans IF Orientering since 2023.
course_highlights: Technical trails and hilly terrain along stage 9 of Bergslagsleden
Passes several forest lakes, including Norra Ånnabodasjön and Stora Dammsjön
Climbs to Sånnabodahöjden, with expansive views over Närkeslätten
additional:
Race bibs can be collected at the race office from 09:00, no later than 45 minutes before the start.
Registration opens on 1 December 2026 via RaceID and remains open through the Thursday before the race. On-site registration is available from 09:00–09:15 on race day.
Aid stations with water, sports drink and snacks approximately every five kilometres. Trail shoes are recommended.
Burgers, coffee and pastries in the finish area. Swimming in Södra Ånnabodasjön after the race.
21 km course records: 1:16:41 (men) and 1:29:16 (women).

name: Öland Lighthouse Challenge
description: Öland Lighthouse Challenge is an ultramarathon on Öland, starting at Långe Erik Lighthouse. The race is offered over three distances—50 km, 50 miles and 100 miles—and follows coastal stretches, meadows and woodland, with views of the Alvar and the Baltic Sea. The event is well organised, with aid and energy stations along the course; all finishers receive a medal and a T-shirt. It is organised by Högby IF and is suitable for both experienced ultrarunners and recreational runners trained for long distances.

name: „Vilties bėgimas“
description: Vilties bėgimas yra pilietinė iniciatyva, skirta kurti solidarumo ir vilties kultūrą onkologinių ligonių bei jų artimųjų palaikymui. Renginys vyksta Klaipėdos senamiestyje ir siūlo įvairias distancijas nuo 0,2 km vaikams iki pilno maratono 42,195 km. Bėgimas vyksta žiedinėmis trasomis, kurios leidžia dalyviams mėgautis miesto vaizdais ir kartu prisidėti prie svarbios socialinės misijos. Tai tradicinis renginys, suburiantis sportininkus ir bendruomenę vieningam tikslui.

name: Läänemaa sörgib ühissörk
description: Läänemaa sörgib ühissörk on meeleolukas ja rahulik pereüritus, mis toimub 31. mail Haapsalu raudteejaamas. Ühissörk on umbes 3+ kilomeetri pikkune rahulik jooksutempo (~7:30 min/km), mis kutsub osalema kõiki Läänemaa liikumishuvilisi. Üritus on kampaania lõppakord, mis ühendab maikuu jooksul toimunud erinevad sörgid üle maakonna. Oodatud on nii juba osalenud kui ka uued liikumishuvilised, et koos nautida liikumist ja tugevdada kogukonnatunnet.

name: Meie oma maijooks 2026
description: Meie oma Maijooks 2026 on traditsiooniline jooksuvõistlus, mis toimub 1. juunil Kolga-Jaani kooli staadionil ja spordiväljakutel. Võistlusel on erinevad distantsid ja vanuseklassid, mis sobivad igas vanuses jooksjatele, kepikõndijatele ja liikumisharrastajatele. Ürituse eesmärk on edendada tervislikku eluviisi, pakkuda võimalust võistelda ning väärtustada perekeskset ühistegevust Kolga-Jaani piirkonnas. Osalejatel on võimalus nautida mõnusat õhtust jooksu kergliiklusteel ja staadionil ning saada tunnustust parimatele jooksjatele ja piirkonna esindajatele.

name: Virtuaaljooks suvi 2026
description: Virtuaaljooks suvi 2026 on paindlik kaugosalusega jooksuvõistlus, mis võimaldab osalejatel läbida valitud distantsi oma kodukohas sobival ajal. Võistlus hõlmab erinevaid distantsi valikuid, sealhulgas 5 km, 10 km ja poolmaratoni (21 km), ning pakub võimalust osaleda ka lastejooksul. Osalejad saavad oma tulemused salvestada ja üles laadida GoAndRun.eu portaali, mis tagab tulemuste usaldusväärsuse ja võrdluse teiste osalejatega üle maailma. Virtuaaljooks annab võimaluse spordis osaleda keskkonnasõbralikult ja mugavalt, ilma et peaks kohale minema.

name: Vårruset Sundsvall
description: Vårruset Sundsvall is a popular spring fun run held at Hamnträdgården, with the start and finish in central Sundsvall. The event offers two distances, 2.5 km and 5 km, with the course passing through the city centre and along Selångersån. It is a fun run with timing on the 5 km distance and a great sense of community. Teams can take part, and participants are treated to a picnic after finishing. The event is open to all ages, with a recommended minimum age of 7 when accompanied by an adult, and is a perfect spring activity for both recreational and competitive runners.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Hamnträdgården in Sundsvall
The course passes through the city centre and along Selångersån
Two distances: 2.5 km and 5 km, with a certified 5 km course
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport in Birsta City in the days before the event. Teams of 5 people are treated to a picnic after finishing. You can opt out of timing when registering. There are no changing facilities at the venue, but there is a supervised area where you can leave warm-up clothes. Water stations and toilets are available at the event area. The recommended minimum age is 13 for the 5 km (11 when accompanied by an adult) and 11 for the 2.5 km (7 when accompanied by an adult). Participants receive a medal, a finish-line bag and a race bib. Teams consist of five people and receive a picnic after finishing.

name: Kambja Tervisejooksud
description: Kambja tervisejooksud on traditsiooniline jooksusarja üritus, mis sai alguse 2016. aastal ja toimub 2026. aastal kolmel etapil. Jooksud toimuvad Kambja terviseradadel, pakkudes osalejatele võimalust nautida metsaradu ja mõningaid asfaldisegmente. Sarja eesmärk on propageerida tervislikke eluviise ning motiveerida inimesi tervisejooksuga tegelema. Igal etapil toimub 10 km võistlusjooks ning lisaks tervisejooks ja võimsusjooks, kus kasutatakse kehakaalu ja tõusu kõrguste vahe arvestust. Kõikidel kolmel etapil osalenud jooksjad saavad sarja särgi ning peavõitjatele on auhinnaks jalgratas Merida Big Nine 20.

name: Vårruset Östersund
location: Storsjön, north of Badhusparken, Östersund, Sweden
organizer: Marathongruppen i samarbete med lokala idrottsklubbar, däribland Trångsvikens IF
description: Vårruset in Östersund is a springtime fun run offering 2.5 km and 5 km distances along the shore of Lake Storsjön, north of Badhusparken. The event is family-friendly, with a recommended minimum age of 7 when accompanied by an adult, and offers a lovely spring evening with a post-finish picnic for teams. The start and finish are by Lake Storsjön, and the 5 km course is officially measured. Participants receive a medal and a finish bag, and can enjoy a music quiz and prizes. They can choose whether or not to have their time recorded.
course_highlights: The course follows the shore of Lake Storsjön, with the start and finish by the lake
The event area is north of Badhusparken, near Jamtli
Officially measured 5 km course, with a 2.5 km distance also available
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport Östersund on 23 and 30 May, 11:00–17:00. Teams consist of 5 people, and team members must register individually. A post-finish picnic is included for teams and can be collected by presenting the picnic voucher on the team captain’s race bib. The event area is easily accessible on foot, by bicycle, or by train to Västra station. There is a water station, portable toilets, and a facility at the information desk for storing warm-up clothes and valuables. The 5 km course is officially measured. Five-person teams receive a picnic after the finish. Information about the location and event setup comes from the organizer’s 2026 information; details for 2027 have not been confirmed by the sources.

name: 5. ETAPP - Merimets
description: 5. etapp - Merimetsa on osa 24. Tervisejooks ja -kõnd sarjast, mis toimub Pelguranna ja Stroomi ranna parklates. See 3,6 km pikkune etapp pakub osalejatele võimalust nautida kaunist loodust ja terviseradu mereäärses piirkonnas. Üritus on sobilik nii jooksjatele kui ka kõndijatele, kes soovivad aktiivselt aega veeta ja oma tervist parandada. Sarja etapid toimuvad erinevates Tallinna piirkondades, pakkudes mitmekesiseid maastikke ja vaateid.

name: Filter Temposari
description: Filter Temposari on Eesti vanim ja mainekaim temposari, mis pakub võimalust proovile panna end rattasõidus, jooksus või rulluisutamises. Sarja kuus etappi toimuvad Tallinna ümbruses ja pakuvad eraldistardiga kiirusvõistlusi, kus osalejad saavad täpselt mõõta oma vormi. Sarja eripäraks on ka paarisstart Kiili etapil ning auhinnaprogramm Kullapada, mis tunnustab stabiilset osalemist. Võistlused toimuvad üldjuhul kolmapäeva õhtuti ning rajad on kiired ja lühikesed, sobides hästi sprindihuvilistele.

name: Blodomloppet Stockholm
organizer: IFK Lidingö Friidrott och IFK Lidingö SOK
description: Blodomloppet in Stockholm is a recreational race that raises awareness of the vital importance of blood donation and promotes a healthy lifestyle. Participants can walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km, either individually or in a team with colleagues and friends. The race is a popular workplace wellness activity and ends with a large picnic, offering a social and meaningful experience for all ages and levels. There is also Lilla Blodomloppet for children, Specialomloppet, and the option to participate remotely.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km distances in central Stockholm
Walking category where dogs are allowed
Lilla Blodomloppet for children aged 1–12
additional: Dogs are allowed in the 5 km walking category. Wheelchairs and walking poles are permitted only in the walking categories. Strollers are not allowed during the race, but are allowed in the event area. Team registration (at least 5 people) includes a picnic bag, with extra bags available to purchase. Tents can be rented for teams or companies in the event area. Start times are divided into several groups for the 5 km and 10 km, including walking and competitive categories, with prizes for the top 3 runners. Teams must register with five people. The walking categories are not timed; blood donors receive a discount. Information about the course route and start times for 2027 will be announced later.

name: Valgamaa lahtised MV
description: Valgamaa lahtised MV orienteerumissprindis on orienteerumisvõistlus, mis toimub Valga piirkonnas. Võistlus on osa RMK Eestimaa Orienteerumispäevakutest, mis on koguperesündmused, kus osavõtuks ei ole vanuselisi piiranguid. Rajad on loodud nii, et neid saab läbida erineva tasemega osaleja, ning võistlejad saavad valida endale sobiva tempo. Võistlusel kasutatakse ajavõttu ning vajadusel on võimalik rentida SI-pulk, et aidata orienteerumisel. Üritus on mõeldud kõigile, kes soovivad nautida looduses liikumist ja orienteerumist heas seltskonnas.

name: Vårruset 2025 — Luleå
location: Luleå University of Technology, Porsön, Luleå, Sweden
description: Vårruset in Luleå is part of Sweden’s largest fitness tour for women and offers a welcoming and inclusive running experience. The race is organised by Marathongruppen and takes place at beautiful Porsön, by Luleå University of Technology. Participants can choose between the 2.5 km and 5 km distances on a course measured for accuracy. The event includes a medal, a finish-line goodie bag, a music quiz with prizes, and timing for the 5 km race, and concludes with a picnic for team participants.
course_highlights: Course measured for accuracy for the 5 km race
Start and finish at Porsön, Luleå University of Technology
Water station and sponsor village at the event area
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport Luleå in the days before the race, as well as at the event area on race day. Teams that register receive a picnic after finishing, which can be collected by presenting the picnic voucher on the team leader’s race bib. There are no changing facilities, but participants can leave their warm-up clothes in a bag labelled with their name and bib number. Toilets and water are available on site. The event area opens at 16:00, with a sponsor village and activities. RaceTimer’s search results list Vårruset Luleå on 12 June 2025. Information about the distances and event format comes from Vårruset’s official website.

name: Lammasmäe Eesti Ööjooks - Rakvere 2026
description: LAMMASMÄE Estonian Night Run - Rakvere 2026 is a night running race taking place in Rakvere on June 12, 2026. This popular sporting event brings together running enthusiasts and offers an exciting, lively night-running experience. The race takes place amid the beautiful scenery around Rakvere, giving participants a unique opportunity to enjoy sport and the urban environment at night.
course_highlights: Night run in Rakvere and its surroundings
Beautiful and varied terrain
Lively and energetic race atmosphere
additional: The event includes a range of distance options and promotes healthy lifestyles and community support.

name: NATTMILEN 2026 - Sundsvall
description: Nattmilen is a popular night race in Sundsvall, celebrating its fifth anniversary in 2027. The race offers 5 km and 10 km distances with a mass start and timing, as well as an optional untimed distance. The race starts at 22:00 from Stora torget and has a festive atmosphere with music, energy and an after-run at restaurant Bloco. Nattmilen is an event for everyone, from beginners to experienced runners, and has become one of Sundsvall’s most anticipated summer running evenings.
course_highlights: Run through Sundsvall’s beautiful stone city
Mass start and timing for the 5 km and 10 km distances
Sweden’s only finish chute with a bar, in place since 2023
additional: Late registration is available online until 30 minutes before the start on race day, as long as places remain. Race bibs can be collected at Stadium City Sundsvall during race week or at the start area between 19:00 and 21:30 on race day. There is a water station along the course with water and sports drink. After the race, participants are invited to an after-run at restaurant Bloco with mingling and festivities. Participants can choose to run without timing at either 5 km or 10 km. Participants under 18 must be accompanied by an adult, or be at least 14 years old to run independently. The organizer documents the race with photos and video that may be published, but participants can opt out of appearing by contacting event@morron.se. The event is documented in photos and video. The stated race date is 4 June 2027; previous race information gives 5 June 2026.

name: Peura Trail
distance_verbose: 100 km, 50 km, 37 km, 23 km, 13 km, 5 km

name: Jaanikese jooksukross
description: Jaanikese jooksukross on jooksusarja teine etapp, mis toimub Jaanikese Moto- ja Vabaajakeskuses. Rajal on mitmekesine maastik, mis sobib nii harrastajatele kui ka kogenud jooksjatele. Üritus pakub võimalust nautida sportlikku võistlust kaunis looduses ning on osa aktiivsest jooksu- ja rattarajast keskuses.

name: Narva Linna Jooks - 5 km ja 21,1 km
description: Narva linna jooks on Ida-Virumaa suurim rahvaspordiüritus, mis toimub 5. ja 6. juunil Joaorgis, Narvas. Üritus on kahepäevane, kus reedel toimub miilijooks raekojaplatsi ümbruses ning laupäeval peetakse põhisõidud, sealhulgas 5 km ja 21,1 km distantsid. Tänavune rada on tasasem, mis võimaldab joosta paremaid aegu ning võistlus on ka Eesti meistrivõistlusteks maanteemiilijooksus. Narva linna jooks toob rajale tuhandeid harrastajaid ja tippsportlasi, pakkudes suurepärast rahvaspordielamust.

name: Luhamaa piirijooks
description: Luhamaa piirijooks on osa Võrumaa jooksu- ja kõnnisarjast, mis pakub mitmekesiseid distantsivalikuid nii jooksjatele kui ka kõndijatele. Põhidistants kulgeb asfaldil Luhamaa külamaja ümbruses ning on ligikaudu 5,9 km pikk. Lisaks on olemas lühemad minidistantsid ja mudilaste jooksud, mis sobivad igas vanuses osalejatele. Sarja eesmärk on pakkuda sportlikku ja sõbralikku võistluskogemust Võrumaa kaunis looduses.

name: Padise liigub
description: Padise liigub on Lääne-Harju liikumissarja osa, mis toimub Lääne-Harju Kultuurikeskus Padise rahvamajas. Rada kulgeb mööda Padise kaunist maastikku, pakkudes põnevust ja silmailu jooksjatele, käijatele ja kepikõndijatele. Üritus sobib kogu perele, lisaks 5 km põhidistantsile on kavas ka lastejooksud. See on suurepärane võimalus nautida liikumist ajaloolises ja looduskaunis keskkonnas.

name: Jaanikese jooksukross
description: II Jaanikese jooksukross toimub 6. juunil 2026 Jaanikese Moto- ja Vabaajakeskuses ning on osa Rein Leppiku nimelisest Valgamaa jooksu- ja kõnnisarjast. Võistlusel on mitmed distantsid, sealhulgas lastejooksud, 2,7 km jooks ja kõnd ning põhijooks 5,4 km. Rajad kulgevad krossirajal ning osalejatel on võimalus nautida sportlikku võistlust erinevates vanuseklassides. Korraldajaks on Valgamaa Spordiliit, kes ootab kõiki jooksuhuvilisi osalema ja nautima aktiivset päeva.

name: SunRun
description: SunRun Saaremaa 2026 on meeskondlik kogemustejooks, mis toimub Saaremaa kaunis looduses. Jooks algab päikesetõusul Kuressaarest ja lõpeb päikeseloojangul Illiku laial Orissaarel, läbides kokku 180 km. Võistlusel saavad osaleda kõik kollektiivid, sõpruskonnad ja spordiklubid, kes moodustavad meeskonna ning jagavad distantsi omavahel. Jooksu eesmärk ei ole võit, vaid sõpradega mugavalt ja nautides koos joosta. Iga osaleja saab GPS käepaela, mis toimib teatepulga rollis, ning rajal on joogipunktid ja toitlustus.

name: Björnfrossa Ultramarathon
location: Kungsbergets skidanläggning, Sandviken Municipality, Gävleborg County, Sweden
description: Björnfrossa Ultramarathon is a 65 km trail race through the scenic bear country of Gästrikland, starting and finishing at Kungsberget Ski Resort. The course mainly follows the Gästrikeleden Trail and features beautiful, occasionally technical trails, as well as some gravel roads. The race is organised by the Björnfrossa Organising Association and offers a challenging experience with approximately 1,200 metres of elevation gain and four aid stations along the way. Participants are advised to carry mandatory equipment, including a headlamp and mobile phone, for safety and communication.
course_highlights: 65 km of trail running along the Gästrikeleden Trail
Occasionally technical trails and sections of gravel road
Over 1,200 metres of elevation gain and four staffed aid stations
additional: The start and finish are at Kungsberget Ski Resort. Bib numbers are handed out at the start area and must be worn visibly throughout the race. Mandatory equipment includes a headlamp and a mobile phone with the race organisers’ number saved. There is no drop-bag service, so participants must carry all their equipment from the start. Medical staff are available at the start/finish, but participants are responsible for themselves out on the course. The maximum time limit is 12 hours. The start and finish are at Kungsberget Ski Resort. Previous race information states that there are four staffed aid stations, a 12-hour time limit, and mandatory headlamp and mobile phone; the race is not a sanctioned competition.

name: Söder Runt
description: Söder Runt is a popular 10 km race around Södermalm in Stockholm, known for its beautiful, fast course along the water with no uphill sections. The race attracts many runners aiming for a personal best and offers a flat, easy-to-run route on asphalt and gravel. After crossing the finish line, runners can enjoy a popular After Run party with music, socialising, food and drinks. The start and finish are at Tantolunden and Hornstulls strand, respectively, and the race is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Federation.
course_highlights: 10 km around Södermalm along the water
Flat, easy-to-run course on asphalt and gravel
No uphill sections; many runners achieve personal bests
additional: Water stations are located after 4 km and at the finish. Strollers and dogs are not allowed. All participants receive a medal and products at the finish. The minimum age is 14 for the race and 18 for the After Run. Payment is made via the website by card, Swish, invoice, or bank giro/postgiro for larger groups. The course is officially measured, and the race is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Federation. The minimum age is 14; strollers and dogs are not allowed. The 2027 start time is provisionally listed as 19:45.

name: Samogitia Ultra 2027 - Where Dreams Go to Die
description: Samogitia Ultra is a unique endurance race held in the Germanto Landscape Reserve near Telšiai, Lithuania. Participants run a 6.7 km forest trail loop every hour on the hour, continuing until only one runner remains, known as the Last Man Standing. The race challenges runners' endurance, strategy, and grit, with a minimum of 7 loops required to earn a medal. The course features about 70 meters of elevation gain per loop and is set in a beautiful natural reserve.
course_highlights: 6.7 km forest trail loop with about 70 meters of elevation gain
Course runs through the Germanto Landscape Reserve near Telšiai
100% forest single- and double-track trails and gravel; the same loop is run day and night
additional: Runners must complete each 6.7 km loop within one hour or be eliminated. A minimum of 7 loops (46.9 km) is required to earn a medal. Runners receive warnings 3, 2, and 1 minute before each loop. Personal tents can be set up from 6 PM the day before the race near the start gate. Toilets are available about 50 meters from base camp. Water and hot water are available at base camp. There are no showers, but a clean lake is nearby. Walking during the race is allowed and recommended. Personal items can be left in tents, but are not the organizer's responsibility. The event has a tent base and aid stations, but there are restrictions on support along the course.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 24. Laekvere – Simuna jooks
description: Lääne-Virumaa jooksu- ja kõnnisarja 2026. aasta kolmas etapp on traditsiooniline Simuna-Laekvere jooks, mis on leidnud kindla koha jooksjate kalendris ja südames. Jooks on omapärane selle poolest, et jooksu suund vahetub iga aasta. Üritus toimub Simuna Koolis ning kutsub kõiki jooksuhuvilisi osalema.

name: E-Lux Peetri Jooks
description: E-LUX Peetri Jooks on Eesti üks meeleolukamaid rahvaspordiüritusi, mis ühendab erinevas vanuses ja võimekusega jooksusõpru. Peamine distants on 10 km, kus võetakse aega ja autasustatakse parimaid, kuid lisaks on ka heategevusjooks, noortejooks ning lastejooksud. Üritus toimub Peetris ning pakub lisaks jooksule ka suurt expo- ja laadaala, kus on kohal erinevad kauplejad ja meelelahutus. Heategevusjooks toetab Tartu Ülikooli Kliinikumi Lastefondi ning selle kaudu liikumispuudega lapsi. Kõik lõpetajad saavad ägeda suvise medali.

name: Simuna-Laekvere rahvajooks
description: Simuna-Laekvere rahvajooks on traditsiooniline harrastajate jooksuvõistlus, mis toimub üle aasta vahelduvalt Simuna ja Laekvere vahel. Rada kulgeb mööda kõvakattega teid, sisaldades lainelisi lõike ja mõningaid tõuse, pakkudes osalejatele vaheldusrikast jooksukogemust. Võistlus on sõbralik ja hästi korraldatud, sobides nii kogenud jooksjatele kui ka harrastajatele, ning pakub peale jooksu ka sauna ja sooja suppi. Osalejate arv on tavaliselt umbes 100 ringis, mis tagab mõnusa ja rahuliku atmosfääri. Võistlusel auhinnatakse vanuseklasse ning esimesed kümme saavad jooksusärgi.

name: Västerås Stadslopp
price_range: 2026: 120–400 kr beroende på lopp och anmälningstid
description: Västerås Stadslopp is a festival in Vasaparken, inviting runners of all ages to take part in various races, including children’s races and a team race. The event is organised by Västerås Friidrottsklubb and offers a wonderful atmosphere, with activities for children, mascots, and opportunities to participate regardless of disability. Race bibs are collected on site, and services include bag drop and water stations. Teams that register receive a food bag after the finish, making it a fun, social running experience.
course_highlights: Children’s races with three different distances to choose from
Children’s activity area with an obstacle course, high jump and shot put
Start and finish in Vasaparken, with access to toilets and water refill stations
additional: Race bibs are collected on site in Vasaparken on 7 June from 09:00, with a separate collection time for the 2.5 km and longer distances after 11:00. Teams of four receive a food bag after the finish. Toilets and water refill stations are available at Rådhuset near the start. Bag drop is available, but there is no cover. The children’s races are limited to 400 participants and are fully booked for 2026. Mascots and a children’s activity area will be on site. The date for 2027 will be announced later. Race bibs are collected in Vasaparken. Teams of four can receive a food bag/picnic after the race.

name: Võru kergejõustikuõhtu
description: Võru kergejõustikuõhtute sari on traditsiooniline kergejõustikuürituste sari, mis ühendab staadionijooksude, heidete ja hüpete võistlused. Iga õhtu koosneb ühest heite- ja ühest hüppealast ning jooksudistantsidest, pakkudes mitmekesist kergejõustiku kogemust. Võistlused toimuvad Võru staadionil ning kasutavad IAAF punktitabelit paremusjärjestuse koostamiseks. Sarjas on viis etappi, millest üks on Võru maakonna meistrivõistlused. Osalejatele on oluline registreeruda iga etapile eraldi ning rinnanumber kehtib kogu hooaja jooksul.

name: Aastajooks
description: Pärnu aastajooksud on 1985. aastal alguse saanud jooksusarja, mis on inspireeritud idamaade kalendrist ning pühendatud igal aastal vastava aasta sümbolloomale. 2026. aasta jooksusarja teema on tulihobuse aasta, mis koosneb üheksast etapist, mis toimuvad kolmes erinevas asukohas Pärnus: Vallikäär, rand ja Reiu-Raeküla terviserada. Igas asukohas toimub kolm etappi, pakkudes mitmekesist ja huvitavat jooksukogemust. Sarja korraldab Pärnu Kahe Silla Klubi, kes kutsub kõiki jooksuhuvilisi osalema ja nautima sportlikku suve Pärnus.

name: 6. ETAPP - Nõmme terviserada
description: Nõmme terviserada on osa Stamina Spordiklubi poolt korraldatavast Tradehouse tervisejooksu ja -kõndi sarjast, mis motiveerib liikumisharrastust läbi tervisekilomeetrite kogumise. See etapp pakub võimalust nautida Nõmme piirkonna terviserada, mis sobib nii jooksjatele kui ka kõndijatele. Sarja raames saab osaleja koguda tervisekilomeetreid nii päris- kui ka kaugetappidel ning personaalsel treeningul. Üritus on avatud kõigile liikumishuvilistele, kes soovivad oma tervist parandada ja aktiivselt aega veeta.

name: Gallaberget Trailrun
description: Gallaberget Trailrun is a trail race organized by Vretstorps IF Löpning. The race features a more challenging course with plenty of trails and forest terrain, offering a demanding and scenic running experience. After the race, participants can enjoy some social time with hot dogs in buns and a swim in the evening sunshine. The event attracts runners of different ages and abilities and is appreciated for its great atmosphere and well-organized arrangements.
course_highlights: A more challenging course with plenty of trails
Forest terrain and scenic surroundings
Hot dogs in buns and a swim in the evening sunshine after the race
additional: After the race, hot dogs in buns are served, and participants can swim in the evening sunshine. Previous races have had around 65 registered runners and included great prizes from sponsors such as Vitamin Well and Nocco. The 2026 edition had a 10 km race category. After the race, hot dogs in buns were served, and participants could go for a swim.

name: 31. Joosu Järvejooksu sarja 3. etapp
location: Viljandi järve tervise- ja suusarada, Viljandi, Estonia
description: The 3rd stage of the Joosu Lake Run Series is a running event held on the health and ski trail around Lake Viljandi. The race gives participants the chance to enjoy beautiful views of the lake and varied terrain. The event is part of a series organised by the Joosu Health Sports Club, which promotes an active and healthy lifestyle. Everyone is welcome to enjoy the sporting atmosphere and the beauty of nature.
course_highlights: Health and ski trail around Lake Viljandi
Beautiful lake views throughout the course
Varied terrain suitable for runners of different levels

name: Vanglateenistuse jooks
description: Vanglateenistuse jooks on osa Ida-Viru jooksusarjast, mis toimub Jõhvi muusikaväljakul. See kergejõustikuüritus pakub osalejatele võimalust nautida jooksu kaunis Ida-Virumaa keskkonnas. Sarja raames toimub mitmeid etappe erinevates paikades, pakkudes mitmekesist jooksukogemust. Üritus on avatud kõigile jooksuhuvilistele ning on traditsiooniliselt hästi korraldatud ja sõbralik.

name: ELVA SÜDAÖÖJOOKS 2026 TARTUMAA LIIGUB ETAPP
description: Elva Südaööjooks 2026 on öine jooksu- ja kõnnivõistlus, mis toimub Elvas Kultuurikeskuse juures. Võistlused algavad õhtul ja pakuvad erinevaid distantsi valikuid, sealhulgas 10 km jooks ja kõnd ning lastejooksud. Üritus on osa Tartu maakonna liikumisüritustest ning sobib nii aktiivsetele jooksjatele kui ka peredele. Korraldajad ootavad kõiki osalema ja nautima sportlikku õhtut Elva kaunis looduses.

name: Eesti noorte KV
description: Eesti noorte karikavõistlused vibuspordis toimuvad Pärnus, pakkudes noorsportlastele võimalust võistelda ja arendada oma oskusi. Võistlusel osaleb mitmeid vibuklubisid üle Eesti ning see on oluline sündmus noorte vibulaskjate kalendris. Võistlus toimub Tammiste staadionil, kus sportlased saavad näidata oma täpsust ja osavust. Üritus on traditsiooniline ja toetab noorte arengut vibuspordis.

name: Öland Ultra Trail
description: Öland Ultra Trail is a fantastic trail adventure through the beautiful natural surroundings of northern Öland. The race offers two distances, 50 km and 25 km, starting from Böda Sand and Byxelkrok respectively, with both distances finishing at Böda Sand. The course offers scenic views and passes places such as Skäftekärr, Byrums raukar, Neptuni åkrar and Trollskogen. Everyone who completes the race receives a medal, and pre-registered participants receive a T-shirt included in the entry fee.
course_highlights: Passes Skäftekärr, Byrums raukar, Neptuni åkrar and Trollskogen
50 km starts at Böda Sand; 25 km starts at Byxelkrok
Both distances finish at Böda Sand
additional: Late registration is available until 11 June, as well as during bib collection on Friday 12 June from 19:00 to 20:00 and on race day, 13 June, from 07:30 to 09:00. Payment can be made in cash, by card or via Swish. Aid stations are located along the course. A T-shirt is included in the entry fee for participants who register by 6 June and specify their shirt size. Everyone who completes the race receives a medal. Pre-registered participants receive a T-shirt if they register by 6 June. The 50 km race starts at 09:00 and the 25 km race at 10:00.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://olandrunning.se/lopp/oland-ultra/): 2027-06-12 — "Tid & datum 12 juni 2027 50 km kl. 09:00" (was estimated 2027-06-12)

name: Urskogsloppet

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälningsavgiften är 200 kr och anmälan stänger den 10/6.

description: Urskogsloppet is a recreational race on simple trails through a magnificent old-growth forest in Örnsköldsvik Municipality. There are two distances: the original long race of 19.7 kilometres, starting in Backe/Berg and finishing at Bigvallen in Björna, and a shorter 6.6-kilometre race that starts and finishes at Bigvallen. The race is always held on the Saturday before Midsummer weekend and partly follows the Urskogsleden hiking trail. Björnadagen, with activities and an awards ceremony, takes place alongside the race. The terrain is uneven in places, with logs, rocks and wet sections, providing a unique running experience close to nature.
course_highlights: Run on simple trails through old-growth forest
Partly follows the Urskogsleden hiking trail
Uneven terrain with logs, rocks and wet sections
additional: The race starts in Backe/Berg, with bus transport from Björna. Depending on the number of participants, there are two start groups, starting at 11:00 and 11:30. Timing is by wrist chip, with a split time at 11.5 km. At the finish, there are changing rooms and showers, as well as the option to buy food for those who pre-ordered. Shoes with spikes are not allowed in the changing facilities. Parking is available at Björna School, and carpooling is recommended. The race has four checkpoints with drinks and light refreshments. The terrain is wet and uneven in places, so runners should be prepared. The 19.7 km course has four checkpoints. Registration, parking and changing facilities are at the school in Björna, and bus transport to the start in Berg is included for registered participants.

name: Nalta Backyard Ultra
description: Nalta Backyard Ultra is a unique ultramarathon where endurance matters, not speed. The challenge is to run one lap of an approximately 6.7-kilometre course every hour on the hour, for as long as you can. The start and finish are at Ursberget ski lodge in Piteå, and the race continues until only one runner can complete another lap. It is a test of both physical and mental strength on a technically demanding forest course.
course_highlights: 6.7-kilometre loop with approximately 65 metres of elevation gain
The course includes forest trails, running tracks, gravel road and approximately 500 metres of asphalt
Technically demanding sections, clearly marked with signs and course tape
additional: Registration takes place from 07:30 to 08:30, with the race briefing at 08:30. The start and finish are at Ursberget ski lodge, with a grassy area for participants’ equipment. There are two small changing rooms, one shower and two toilets at the event area. The site map shows the start area, lap checkpoint, finish, race management, refreshment area, participant area and recommended parking. The race starts at 09:00 and continues every hour on the hour. Registration is listed as 07:30 to 08:30, and the race briefing at 08:30. Participation is at your own risk.

name: Flosjön-Edstjärn
location: Flosjön–Edstjärn, Gagnef Municipality, Dalarna County, Sweden
description: Flosjön-Edstjärn is a half marathon organized annually by Edstjärns Idrottsklubb in Gagnef. The race is open to everyone and runs through scenic areas around Flosjön and Edstjärn. It is a well-established event that promotes sport and community, especially among young people. The club encourages participation in various sports and offers a great opportunity to experience beautiful scenery while running.
course_highlights: Half marathon around Flosjön and Edstjärn
Scenic views and varied terrain
Organized by the volunteer-run Edstjärns IK, with a focus on youth sports
additional: All registrations are binding, and participation is at your own risk. Personal data is handled by Edstjärns IK and Mitt Lopp. Names and results are published at www.eik.one. The organizer may stop the race if necessary to protect participants’ health and safety.

name: EKVA lahtised kergej. võistl.
description: EKVA lahtised kergejõustikuvõistlused toimuvad Kohilas ning pakuvad võimalust osaleda erinevates kergejõustiku alades veteranide ja harrastajate seas. Võistlused on mõeldud aktiivsetele sportlastele igas vanuses, kes soovivad mõõtu võtta ja nautida kergejõustiku võistlusmõnusid. EKVA korraldab regulaarselt erinevaid meistrivõistlusi ja sarju, mis toetavad jooksmise ja kergejõustiku populariseerimist Eestis. Võistlused on avatud nii harrastajatele kui ka veteranidele, pakkudes võimalust võistelda vanuseklassides.

name: Viimsi maraton
description: Viimsi maraton 2026 toimub Viimsi poolsaarel ja pakub osalejatele ühe suure ringi pikkuse raja. Start ja finish on Randvere kooli parklas. Rajal on vaheldusrikas maastik, mis hõlmab nii asfalteeritud teid kui ka metsaradu, pakkudes tõuse ja langusi kogu distantsi vältel. See on suurepärane võimalus nautida suvist jooksu koos positiivse kogukonnaga.

name: Dadathlon Run and Festival (Stockholm, Hagaparken)
description: DaddyHood Dadathlon is a sporting event for dads and children that aims to inspire movement and quality time together. The event takes place both live in Hagaparken, Stockholm, and virtually for participants who cannot attend in person. It is a family-friendly activity that promotes healthy habits and a sense of community among active dads and their children.
course_highlights: Family-friendly run in Hagaparken, Stockholm
The event offers both live and virtual participation
Strollers are welcome during the run
additional: The event is part of a global virtual sports challenge featuring three sports over three months: running in May, cycling in June, and hiking. Strollers are welcome during the run. Virtual participation is free, and the event aims to create unforgettable memories and build healthy habits together with the children. Dadathlon consists of three events held at different times throughout the year. Activity can be recorded using an app or sports watch.

name: Rapla Selveri suurjooks, virtuaaljooks
description: Rapla Selveri Suurjooks on traditsiooniline jooksuvõistlus, mis toimub Raplas ja pakub mitmeid distantsivalikuid alates lastejooksudest kuni poolmaratonini. Võistluskeskus asub Rapla Selveri parklas ning rajad kulgevad linna tänavatel ja maanteedel, olles hästi tähistatud ja mõõdetud. Osalejatele on tagatud turvalisus ning jooksu korraldab Kehakultuur OÜ koostöös ajakirjaga Jooksja. Eelregistreerimine lõpeb 20. mail ning stardigrupid moodustatakse eeldatava lõpuaegade alusel, et tagada sujuv ja ohutu jooksupäev.

name: Blodomloppet (Visby)
organizer: VIF Gute Friidrott och Blodcentralen i Visby
description: Blodomloppet in Visby is a fun run organised to raise awareness of the vital importance of blood donation and promote a healthy lifestyle. Participants can choose to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km on scenic routes that include Visby’s city wall, old town, promenade, Almedalen and harbour. There is also Lilla Blodomloppet for children, with shorter distances. The event is open to individuals and teams, and ends with a group picnic for participants.
course_highlights: The 5 km route follows Visby’s city wall and passes through the historic old town
The 10 km route includes the city wall, promenade, Almedalen and Visby harbour
Lilla Blodomloppet takes place in an urban setting and starts behind the main stage
additional: Late registration is available on site from 16:00 on 16 June at the Information Tent. Participants receive a T-shirt, race bib, medal and gift for blood donors. Team members can collect a picnic bag after finishing or use a picnic card (valid only for Blodomloppet at a distance). The scenic routes pass through historic and central parts of Visby. Water stations and medical assistance are available. Changing facilities and toilets are provided. Parking information and directions are available on the website. Participants can register individually or in teams of up to five. Participants receive a T-shirt, race bib and medal; team members can collect a picnic bag after finishing. Lilla Blodomloppet has distances of 300 m and 1.6 km.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://blodomloppet.se/vara-lopp/visby/): 2027-06-15 — "Välkommen till Blodomloppet 2027! ... 15 juni 2027" (was estimated 2027-06-15)

name: Kohila pikamaajooksude sari 2026 IV etapp 400m
description: Kohila pikamaajooksude sari 2026 IV etapp 400m toimub Kohila Spordikeskuse staadionil ning on mõeldud kõigile jooksuhuvilistele. Sarjas on erinevad distantsid ja vanusegrupid, kus osalejad saavad punkte vastavalt oma kohale igas jooksus. Stardimaks on 8 eurot, noortele ja pensionäridele 5 eurot, tasumine toimub sularahas kohapeal. Eelregistreerimine on soovitatav ja lõpeb võistluspäeval kell 16.30, hilisemad registreerujad paigutatakse tagumistesse jooksudesse. Sarja võitjad selguvad vanusegruppide kaupa ning autasustamine toimub sarja lõpus.

name: Kohila Pikamaajooksusari
description: Kohila Pikamaajooksusari on Kohila valla liikumissari, mis koosneb mitmest etapist ja on suunatud piirkonna spordihuvilistele. Sarja eesmärk on edendada spordi- ja liikumisharrastust ning pakkuda osalejatele võimalust võistelda erinevates distantsides. Igal etapil saavad osalejad kauni meenemedali ning kogu sarja kokkuvõttes toimub punktiarvestus võistlusklassides. Sarja korraldab Kohila Spordikeskus, mis toetab tervislikku eluviisi ja aktiivset liikumist.

name: KEVEK ja Tartu Kalev staadionijooksu sari
description: KEVEK ja Tartu Kalev staadionijooksu sari on Tartu Spordiselts Kalevi korraldatav kergejõustiku staadionijooksude sari, mis pakub võimalust osaleda mitmetel etappidel Tartu ja Ülenurme staadionitel. Sarja eesmärk on pakkuda võistlemisvõimalusi lastele ja noortele ning edendada kergejõustiku harrastamist Tartu linnas ja maakonnas. Võistlused toimuvad suvekuudel ning on avatud erinevatele vanuseklassidele. Registreerimine sulgub võistluspäeval kell 12.00, mis võimaldab paindlikku osalemist.

name: Midsommarjoggen 2026
description: Midsommarjoggen is a running celebration in the Rynningeviken Nature Reserve in Örebro, inviting runners, families and colleagues to kick off Midsummer week together. The race is 7.2 km long and follows easy-to-run gravel paths with beautiful views and two wooden bridges over the Lillån River. The youngest runners can take part in an exciting 600-metre Kidsrun without timing. After the finish, the evening continues with a pleasant after-run gathering with food, drinks and good company at Stora Hjortstorps Gård.
course_highlights: 7.2 km through the Rynningeviken Nature Reserve on easy-to-run gravel paths
Two wooden bridges over the Lillån River
Two longer hills near Venastugan
additional: The Kidsrun starts at 17:45, with runners gathering at 17:40. Race numbers can be collected from 16:00 to 18:00 on race day. Timing is done with a transponder, which is lent out at race-number collection and must be returned after the race. Water and sports drink are available at 3 km and 5 km. Toilets are available near the race area and at the refreshment stations. There are no changing facilities or showers on site. An after-run gathering with food and drinks is offered after the race (not included in the entry fee). Young people born in 2008 or later receive a 50% discount on the entry fee. Members of certain running clubs may receive a discount through the members’ pages. Group registration is available by contacting info@epictrail.se. After-run gathering at Stora Hjortstorps Gård with food, drinks and good company.

name: Tallinna noorte MV
description: Tallinna noorte MV on individuaalne kergejõustiku võistlus noortele ja täiskasvanutele, mis toimub Tallinnas. Võistlus hõlmab mitmeid vanuseklasse alates U-14 kuni täiskasvanuteni ning erinevaid kergejõustiku alasid nagu jooksud, hüpped, tõuked ja heited. Võistluse eesmärk on austada Eerik Konisti mälestust ning populariseerida kergejõustikku noorte seas. Kõiki vanuseklasse autasustatakse medalitega ning parimad saavad eriauhinnad. Võistlus toimub staadionil ja algab hommikul kell 11.00, registreerimine algab kell 10.00.

name: Tänndalen 100 miles
location: Ski Lodge Tänndalen, Tänndalen, Härjedalen Municipality, Jämtland County, Sweden
description: Tänndalen 100 Miles is a spectacular 161-kilometre ultrarace on easy-running asphalt through the mountain landscapes of Sweden and Norway. The race starts at Ski Lodge in Tänndalen and takes you across vast mountain expanses, alongside sparkling waters and all the way to the World Heritage city of Røros, before returning to the finish at Ski Lodge. The race offers magical midsummer light and a unique mountain experience for ultrarunners.
course_highlights: 161 km of easy-running roads through the mountain landscapes of Sweden and Norway
The route includes a loop to Funäsdalen and the World Heritage city of Røros
Start and finish at Ski Lodge in Tänndalen
additional: The race starts at 19:00. The organiser’s information says sunset is around 23:00 and describes the race as one of the few 100-mile races where a headlamp is not needed. Prize money is offered to the top three finishers in both the women’s and men’s categories.

name: Borejoggen
price_range: 300–350 kr för Borejoggen och Lagjoggen enligt 2026 års prisuppgifter; Minijoggen 150 kr
description: Borejoggen is a long-established running race held in Torsby every Midsummer’s Eve, with a 42-year tradition. The race follows an 8.5-kilometre asphalt course through central Torsby and welcomes runners of all abilities, from elite athletes to recreational runners. Children and young people can take part in the 1.5-kilometre Minijoggen. There is also a popular team event, Lagjoggen, where three participants compete together and the team’s combined time is counted.
course_highlights: 8.5 km asphalt course through central Torsby
1.5 km Minijoggen for children and young people
Water stations at 2 km, 4 km, 5.8 km and the finish
additional: Mass start for Minijoggen at 9:30 on Östmarksvägen. Mass start for Borejoggen and Lagjoggen at 11:00 on Östmarksvägen. Changing facilities and showers are available at Torsby Ski Tunnel and Valbergsstugan. Prizes are awarded for the sprint prize at 2 km, the mountain prize at Kollsberg after 5 km, and the top three finishers in the women’s, men’s and team categories. Traffic marshals and course guides are stationed at road crossings with traffic. Medical care is available at the finish, with emergency response ready on the course. Previous editions have had their start and finish at Herrgårdsparken. Borejoggen and Lagjoggen have started at 11:00, and Minijoggen at 9:30. The prize and start times for 2027 have not been confirmed in the sources.

name: Orsakajtn
description: Orsakajt'n and Orsabajk'n are an MTB and running event held every Midsummer’s Eve in Orsa. The event follows a route through the Ore River valley, with forest trails, gravel roads and a little asphalt, and gentle to moderate climbs over sand ridges. Race numbers are sent digitally the day before and can be collected at the venue or at Karl Hedin in Orsa. The MTB race requires a licence and membership in a club affiliated with the Swedish Cycling Federation.
course_highlights: The route runs through the Ore River valley on forest trails, gravel roads and asphalt
Gentle to moderate climbs over beautiful sand ridges
The route is marked with orange enduro arrows and kilometre signs
additional: Race numbers are sent digitally to your mobile phone the day before the event. Race numbers can be collected at Karl Hedin in Orsa on Thursday from 16:00 to 20:00, or at the start location on race day. No on-site entries; registration closes one hour before the start. No refunds in case of injury or illness. Parking is available at Lillåvallen. The MTB race requires a licence and membership in a club affiliated with the Swedish Cycling Federation. Registration is online and closes one hour before the start; on-site entries are not available. Race numbers can be collected at Karl Hedin in Orsa or at the respective start location on race day. MTB competition classes require a licence and membership in a club affiliated with the Swedish Cycling Federation.

name: Kuusalu valla kergej. MV
description: Kuusalu valla kergejõustiku meistrivõistlused on traditsiooniline kergejõustiku võistlus, mis toimub Kuusalus. Võistlusel osalevad erinevad vanusegrupid ja distantsid, pakkudes võimalust nii harrastajatele kui ka edasijõudnutele. Üritus on pühendatud Margus Keerma mälestusele ning korraldab seda spordiklubi Treeningpartner. Võistlus on hea võimalus näidata oma oskusi ja nautida sportlikku atmosfääri Kuusalu vallas.

name: Ümber Saadjärve jooks
description: 38. Ümber Saadjärve jooks toimub 20. juunil 2026 Kukulinnas, pakkudes osalejatele 17 km pikkust jooksu ja tervisekõndi ümber Saadjärve. Rajal on asfaltkattega tee ning kolm joogipunkti, mis tagavad hea varustuse jooksu ajal. Lisaks põhijooksule on kavas lastejooksud erinevates vanuseklassides ning tervisekõnd, mis sobib kõigile liikumishuvilistele. Iga lõpetaja saab meene medali ning parimad autasustatakse vanuseklasside kaupa. Üritus on traditsiooniline ja hästi korraldatud, pakkudes meeldivat spordielamust kogu perele.

name: EcoTrail Stockholm
description: EcoTrail Stockholm is a nature-focused running event offering several distances for all ages and levels, from children’s races to ultradistances. The races follow beautiful trails through forests, the archipelago, countryside and urban environments, with a high proportion of nature experiences. The event is marked by a strong environmental ethos and sense of community, where runners can challenge themselves in an inspiring, well-organized setting. The finish is at Stora Skuggans Amphitheatre on Norra Djurgården, with beautiful medals and an after-party for participants.
course_highlights: A high proportion of nature, with forest trails, archipelago and countryside
Viewpoints and sights along the course
Start and finish at Stora Skuggans Amphitheatre on Norra Djurgården
additional: Mandatory equipment for 58 km includes a water container holding at least one liter, a cup or mug for drinks at aid stations, and a mobile phone with a fully charged battery and the race organizers’ phone number. Aid stations do not provide cups; participants must fill their own cup, mug or bottle. The time limit for 58 km is 11 hours. For 21 km, a cup, mug or bottle for drinks is required. There are also children’s races and virtual races at various distances. Wooden medals with a unique theme are awarded to everyone who finishes. Start and finish at Stora Skuggans Amphitheatre. All finishers receive a wooden medal.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://stockholm.ecotrail.com/): 2027-06-19 — "19 juni 2027 EcoTrail Stockholm" (was estimated 2027-06-12)

name: Pasvalio maratonas
location: Pasvalio kultūros ir poilsio parko stadionas, Pasvalys, Pasvalio rajonas, Lietuva
organizer: Bėgimo mėgėjų ir sveikos gyvensenos klubas „Vėtra“, Lietuvos bėgimo mėgėjų asociacija, Pasvalio sporto mokykla
description: The Pasvalys Marathon is a traditional running event held in the city of Pasvalys. It aims to promote running among young people and adults and encourage a healthy lifestyle. The event takes place at the stadium in Pasvalys Culture and Recreation Park, where participants compete in the marathon, half-marathon, and children’s race. The course length and number of laps are adjusted for the different distances, with water and refreshment stations every 5 km. Participants receive prizes and commemorative medals, and the event is part of the Pasvalys City Festival “Vys par to ãlo” programme.
course_highlights: 10 km course; 4 laps for the marathon and 2 laps for the half-marathon
Water and refreshment stations every 5 km
Start and finish at the stadium in Pasvalys Culture and Recreation Park
additional: Race numbers are distributed from 8:00 at Pasvalys Stadium. The children’s 400 m race starts at 11:00. Participants must have a doctor’s permission or an application bearing a doctor’s approval; otherwise, they are responsible for their own health during the competition. Participants who finish within the time limit receive commemorative medals. Various distances are offered, and participants can look forward to medals, certificates, prizes, and refreshments.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 4. Pariisi Maastikujooks
description: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 ühendab tervisesportlasi ja harrastajaid kevadest sügiseni, pakkudes mitmekesiseid jooksu- ja kõnnivõimalusi. Sarja eesmärk on toetada tervislikke eluviise ning julgustada kohalikke osalema spordiüritustel. 4. Pariisi Maastikujooks toimub 21. juunil Pariisi puhkekülas ning on osa pika traditsiooniga jooksusarjast, mis hõlmab erinevaid vanusegruppe ja distantsivalikuid. Ajavõtt toimub kiibiga ning numbrid tuleb kinnitada kõhule või rinnale, rõhutades korraldajate hoolt osalejate mugavuse ja turvalisuse eest.

name: Mapri Ehitus x Vägilase jooks Rummu
description: Mapri Ehitus x Vägilase jooks Rummu on mitmekülgne takistuskross, mis toimub Rummu karjääris. Rajal tuleb ronida, roomata, tõsta ja tiritada läbi muda, vee, liiva ja mägede, pakkudes väljakutset kõigile osalejatele. Võistlus on osa Vägilase jooksu sarjast, mis on tuntud kui Eesti parim OCR üritus. Rada on tummisem ja pakub põnevaid takistusi ning elamusi looduses.

name: Maraton igas linnas Keila
description: Maraton igas linnas Keila on unikaalne jooksuvõistlus, mis pakub osalejatele võimalust joosta maratoni distants erinevates linnades. Rajal on korraldatud toitlustuspunktid iga 400 meetri järel ning rajal on olemas ka WC-d, mis teeb jooksu mugavaks ja toetab sportlaste heaolu. Võistlus sobib nii kogenud maratonijooksjatele kui ka neile, kes soovivad proovida oma vastupidavust. Üritus on hästi organiseeritud ja pakub meeldivat kogemust kõigile osalejatele.

name: Pärnumaa Võidupüha maraton
description: Pärnumaa Võidupüha maraton toimub 22. juunil 2026 Tori vallas, kus võistluskeskus asub ajaloolise Tori Eesti Sõjameeste Mälestuskiriku juures. Maraton toob kaasa mitmeid uuendusi ning on korraldatud koostöös Pärnumaa Spordiliidu ja toetajatega. See on traditsiooniline ja legendaarne jooks, mis pakub sportlastele mitmekesist ja meeldejäävat kogemust.

name: Night Trail Run  Sommar 2025
description: Night Trail Run Sommar 2027 is a personal and unique trail race held on the longest day of the year in Sollentuna, Stockholm. The race starts early in the morning at 02:00 and offers 30 kilometres of wonderful trail running at dawn, as participants meet the light along the way. With a maximum of 100 participants, the race focuses on the experience and the chance to enjoy nature as it awakens. Navigation is by GPS route and map, and a generous breakfast is served after the finish so participants can share the experience with other runners.
course_highlights: 30 km of trail running at dawn, welcoming the summer light
Two aid stations along the course
Navigation by GPS route and map
additional: Maximum 100 participants for a personal experience. Start and finish at Attunda Orienteering Club’s clubhouse, Ytterbyvägen 22 in Sollentuna. Take the commuter train to Rotebro station and walk 1.5 km to the start/finish. Parking at Sollentuna Golf Club, followed by a 500 m walk. Registration is open until one hour before the start. Minimum age: 18. Breakfast is served after the race. Participant numbers are limited. A generous breakfast is served after the finish.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.nighttrailrun.se/om-sommartrail): 2027-06-21 — "Måndag 21 juni 2027. Start klockan 02.00." (was estimated 2027-06-20)

name: Häädemeeste Võidupüha jooks
description: The Häädemeeste Victory Day Run is a traditional running event held near the Häädemeeste bus station. The event invites everyone who enjoys being active to celebrate Victory Day in a sporting and community-minded spirit. In addition to the main race, a children’s run for the youngest members of the family will be held for the first time. After the run, participants can enjoy the Midsummer celebration at Häädemeeste Summer Garden. Participation is free, and registration takes place on site.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Häädemeeste bus station
Children’s run before the main race
Midsummer celebration at Häädemeeste Summer Garden after the run
additional: Registration and gathering take place on site at the Häädemeeste bus station from 16:00 to 17:30. Participation is free.

name: 49. Jaanijooks ümber Karksi-Nuia paisjärve
description: 49. Jaanijooks ümber Karksi-Nuia paisjärve on traditsiooniline jooksuvõistlus, mis toimub Karksi ordulinnuse varemete lähedal. Võistlus kulgeb ümber maalilise Karksi-Nuia paisjärve, pakkudes osalejatele kauneid vaateid ja meeldivat jooksukogemust. Üritus on mõeldud nii harrastajatele kui ka kogenud jooksjatele ning loob võimaluse nautida sportlikku päeva kogukonnas.

name: Jooks suvesse
description: Pööripäevajooksud on aastane võistlussari, mis koosneb mitmest etapist, kus osalejad saavad koguda punkte ja võistelda vanusegruppides. Jooks suvesse on üks sarja etappidest, mis toimub Kuressaares Loode tammikus. Rajal on vaheldusrikas pinnas, sealhulgas kergliiklustee ja metsateed, mis võivad olla ilmastikuolude tõttu porised. Osalejatele on tagatud elektrooniline ajavõtt, korduvkasutatavad rinnanumbrid ja joogitopsid ning finišis magus amps ja jook.

name: Jaanijooks ümber Karksi-Nuia paisjärve
description: Jaanijooks ümber Karksi-Nuia paisjärve on traditsiooniline maanteejooks, mis toimub Karksi-Nuia piirkonnas. Võistlus pakub osalejatele võimalust nautida kaunist järve ümbrust ning sportlikku väljakutset. Üritust korraldab MTÜ Karksi Sport, kes on pühendunud kohaliku spordi edendamisele. Jaanijooks on hea võimalus nii harrastajatele kui ka kogenud jooksjatele osaleda sõbralikus ja toetavas keskkonnas.

name: Modine Söderköpings Stadslopp

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Ordinarie anmälan stänger söndag 13 juni kl 23.59. Ordinarie avgift: 325 kronor.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Från 14 juni tillkommer 50 kronor extra (totalt 375 kr). Efteranmälan via hemsidan till söndag 20 juni kl 16.00.

description: Modine Söderköping City Race is a festive fun run taking place on June 22, 2027, with the start and finish in Brunnsparken in Söderköping. Participants can walk, jog, or run 5 kilometers through the town’s beautiful surroundings along the Storån River and Göta Canal. The race features music, performances, and plenty of encouragement along the course, creating a wonderful atmosphere for runners and spectators alike. After crossing the finish line, all participants are treated to a hearty summer plate by ICA Supermarket. This annual running celebration is organized by Norrköpings Löparklubb and attracts many participants and spectators.
course_highlights: 5 kilometers through Söderköping, starting and finishing in Brunnsparken
The course consists of three laps: the first along the Storån River and Göta Canal, the second through central Söderköping, and the third around Brunnsparken and the residential neighborhood
Music and performances along the entire course create a festive atmosphere
additional: Race bibs can be collected at ICA Supermarket Söderköping on Monday, June 21, from 12:00 to 18:00, or on race day in Brunnsparken from 15:00 to 18:30. The top flap of the race bib is the timing chip. After crossing the finish line, all participants are treated to a hearty summer plate by ICA Supermarket, served on the grass. On-site late registration is available at ICA Supermarket on June 21 from 12:00 to 18:00 and on race day from 15:00 to 18:30. Only Swish is accepted for on-site late registration. The 2027 race takes place on Tuesday, June 22, with a 19:00 start. All participants receive a medal. Race bibs can be collected at ICA Supermarket Söderköping or on race day in Brunnsparken. Late registration costs an additional 50 kronor.
