pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Tisdagen 22 juni 2027 är det dags för Modine Söderköpings Stadslopp!

name: 12. Rõuge maastikujooks-kõnd
description: 12. Rõuge maastikujooks-kõnd on Võru maakonnas, Rõuge Ööbikuorus toimuv maastikujooksu ja kepikõnni üritus, mis pakub osalejatele võimalust nautida loodust ja liikumist. Üritus sobib nii jooksjatele kui ka kepikõndijatele ning kõndijatele, kes soovivad aktiivselt aega veeta. Liikumisharrastuse kompetentsikeskus korraldab sündmust eesmärgiga edendada liikumist ja tervislikku eluviisi. Osalejad saavad kogeda kaunist maastikku ning liikumise rõõmu hea enesetunde nimel.

name: Karlstad Stadslopp

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Ordinarie pris fram till sista anmälningsdag

description: Karlstad Stadslopp is a community celebration and recreational race featuring a fast, scenic 10 km course through the most central parts of Karlstad. The race is marked by a sense of community and the joy of running, with many spectator spots along the course. In addition to the main race, there is also the Minilopp for children aged 7–12 and the Miniminilopp for the youngest children. Karlstad Stadslopp is a traditional summer event that brings together over 3,000 runners and is part of SM-veckan.
course_highlights: Certified 10 km course through central Karlstad
Start on Tingvallabron at 18:35
Many spectator spots where runners pass several times
additional: Seeding for start corrals is based on the estimated running time provided at registration. Team competition for the 10 km, with 5–6 people per team; the five fastest times count. Bib pickup and late registration take place in Museiparken on race day. Concert with Dotter at Sandgrund after the finish. Gift cards are available to purchase as gifts. There is also the Karlstad Minilopp for children aged 7–12 and the Miniminilopp for children aged 0–6.

name: St Olavsloppet
organizer: St Olavsgruppens Ideella förening i Sverige och St Olavsloppet A/S i Norge
description: St Olavsloppet is a unique three-day relay race stretching from Trondheim in Norway to Östersund in Sweden. The race offers two main distance options, StOlav 340 and StOlav 210, with teams running timed daily stages and using GPS tracking. It is a social and challenging competition for teams in various categories, including open teams, corporate teams and club teams. There are drink stations and timed changeovers along the route, and the event is characterised by a great atmosphere and teamwork among participants.
course_highlights: Three-day relay from Trondheim to Östersund
Drink stations approximately every four kilometres and at changeovers
GPS tracking with a relay baton for each team
additional: Start groups are based on the team’s running speed, with seeding by the race management. Race bibs must be worn clearly visible on the chest and back, without being folded; otherwise, a time penalty will be added. Changeovers are permitted only at regular and extra changeover points, with timing at regular changeover points. GPS transmitters are attached to the relay baton, which is handed over at changeovers. Teams may hand out their own drinks, but not from moving vehicles. Discounts are available when multiple teams from the same association or company register. Teams can take part in one, two or three daily stages. Categories include, among others, open class, corporate teams, women’s teams and club teams.

name: Trosa Stadslopp
description: Trosa Stadslopp is a long-running community celebration held every year on the first Friday after Midsummer. In 2026, the race takes place on Friday, June 26. The course winds through picturesque summer Trosa, with large crowds and the waterfront close by, creating a summery atmosphere for both racing and recreational running. The event has categories for elite runners, recreational runners, young people and children, and offers both the 8,900 m main race and shorter recreational options.

name: Sillamäe promenaadijooks
description: Sillamäe Promenaadijooks on tuntud linnajooks, mis toimub Sillamäe Kultuurikeskuse juures. Jooksu traditsioon sai alguse treppide jooksuna ning 2021. aastast kannab see nime Promenaadijooks. Võistlusel on erinevad distantsid alates mudilaste lühikestest jooksudest kuni täiskasvanute 7 km põhidistantsini, mis pakub väljakutset ka treenitud sportlastele. Üritus on kogukondlik ja kaasahaarav, kus lisaks jooksule on ka mitmeid muid tegevusi ning toetajate ja vabatahtlike panus on oluline.

name: EUTR - Estonia Ultra-Trail Race
description: Estonia Ultra-Trail Race (EUTR) 9th Edition will be held on 26-27 June 2026 in Narva, Ida-Virumaa region, Estonia. The race starts and finishes at the sport township Akkekula (Nut Hill). Organized by the noncommercial sports club SK ETR, the event features certified trails by the Trailrunning International Association, offering ITRA points for finishers. The race includes multiple distances catering to different levels of trail runners, including an ultra-trail and shorter trail options.

name: Fjällmaraton Gastronomi
location: Ottsjö and Trillevallen, Åre Municipality, Jämtland County, Sweden
description: Fjällmaraton Gastronomi is a relaxed mountain marathon offering an experience-filled day in the Åre Mountains, with good food and drink served along the classic mountain marathon trails. Participants can choose between two distances, 22 km and 43 km, both following well-marked trails, with starts in Ottsjö and Trillevallen respectively and the finish in Ottsjö. With an open start time, runners and walkers can complete the course without time pressure, making the race an enjoyable experience in a mountain setting. Accommodation near the start and finish is recommended for the best transfer options.
course_highlights: Local food served at aid stations along the course
Well-marked mountain trails with scenic views
Two distances: 22 km and 43 km, starting in Ottsjö and Trillevallen respectively, and finishing in Ottsjö
additional: Entries can be transferred for a fee of 250 kr. Food and drink stations serve local food, and a kåsa (drinking cup) is provided for use at cup-free stations. Bus transfers to the start are available from Ottsjö, Trillevallen and Undersåker, with return transfers after the finish. Electronic chip timing. A safety team is in place to respond quickly to accidents. The number of start places is limited (400 participants). The open start time allows participants to complete the course without time pressure. Those who want to take it easy are advised to start early. The entry fee includes, among other things, food and drink stations and bus transfers.

name: Jordgubbslunken
description: Jordgubbslunken is a popular countryside race in Rudskoga with the motto “walk, jog, run.” The race offers Lilla Lunken (6 km) and Stora Lunken (10 km), as well as Minilunken for children (born in 2017 or later). The start and finish are at Grunnebacka School, and the courses follow Rudskoga’s winding village roads through a beautiful cultural landscape. At the finish, all participants receive one litre of strawberries. There is also a generous prize table and a grand prize drawn by start number.

name: Silverleden Ultra 100 Miles
description: Silverleden Ultra is a challenging ultramarathon in Bergslagen, with several distances ranging from 9 km to 100 miles. The races follow the well-known Silverleden, a hiking trail with challenging elevation changes and beautiful views. Silverleden Ultra 100M is known as one of Sweden’s toughest 100-mile races, with a high dropout rate. The event offers a unique running experience with varied terrain and a strong sense of community among participants.
course_highlights: Challenging elevation changes with long, steep climbs
Trail terrain with rocks and roots, with few sections on roads
Fantastic views from the peaks along the trail
additional: Bus transport is included in the entry fee for the 33 km and 100 miles races, departing from the finish area at Hurtigtorpet. Bus departure times are Friday at 13:00 for 100M and Saturday at 11:30 for 33K. A limited number of pitches for caravans and motorhomes are available at the start and finish; book by email. Children and young people can take part in the 9 km race for free when accompanied by a registered adult. Silverleden is a well-maintained hiking trail with bridges over bogs and waterways, and it is marked year-round.

name: Silverleden Ultra
description: Silverleden Ultra is a challenging ultramarathon in Bergslagen, with several distances featuring hilly terrain, technical trails and beautiful views. The races follow the well-marked Silverleden trail, known for its steep climbs and varied surfaces with rocks and roots. The event offers something for both experienced ultrarunners and those who want to try shorter distances in a scenic setting near Hällefors.
course_highlights: Hilly, technical trail terrain with many steep climbs
Fantastic views from the summits along the trail
Well-marked hiking trail with bridges over marshes and waterways
additional: Bus transport is included in the entry fee for the 33 km and 100-mile distances, departing from the finish area at Hurtigtorpet. Places are limited, and children and young people can take part in the 9 km race for free when accompanied by a registered adult. There is also an option to park a caravan or motorhome at the start and finish after registering in advance.

name: Muraste jooks
description: Muraste jooks on osa Harku valla jooksusarjast, mis toimub 28. juunil 2026 Muraste Kooli staadionil. Võistlusrada kulgeb mööda Muraste tänavaid ja kergliiklusteid, olles tähistatud ja avatud teedel. Distantsid on mitmekesised, sobides nii lastele kui täiskasvanutele, ning lisaks on võimalus osaleda perevõistlusel. Autasustatakse parimaid vanuseklassides ning sarja lõpetajad saavad hooajamedali. Korraldajaks on MTÜ TreeningPluss, kes paneb rõhku liikumisrõõmule ja sportlike eluviiside edendamisele.

name: TrailÖvik
location: Själevad, Örnsköldsvik Municipality, Västernorrland County, Sweden
description: TrailÖvik is a trail race in Själevad with four different courses to suit all levels. Participants can enjoy a challenging running experience in magnificent natural surroundings, with fantastic trails and fairytale views of the World Heritage Site of the High Coast. The course has been praised by both recreational and elite runners for its fun trails, challenging climbs and beautiful views, with no gravel roads or asphalt. The event has a welcoming, family atmosphere while still being professional, and is well worth travelling to experience.
course_highlights: Fantastic trails in magnificent natural surroundings
Fairytale views of the World Heritage Site of the High Coast
Challenging climbs and no asphalt sections
additional: Race bibs must be collected at the arena no later than 30 minutes before the start. On-site registration opens at the arena and closes 30 minutes before each start. The courses are marked with signs and tape, but runners are encouraged to study the map carefully before starting. Printed maps are available at the beginning of Älgstråket, and digital maps can be downloaded to the Avenza Maps app. Spiked shoes are recommended in wet weather due to slippery rock slabs. Safety staff are available at checkpoints and the finish to help with minor injuries and discomfort. Results are posted immediately after finishing at the arena and on the website. It is possible to test-run the courses.

name: Böda Beach Run
location: Böda Sand Beach Resort, Löttorp, Öland, Sweden
description: Böda Beach Run is a challenging and fun race for the whole family, with distances ranging from 500 metres to 10 kilometres. The race takes place on the beautiful, long sandy beach at Böda Sand Beach Resort on Öland, offering a unique and scenic running experience. Everyone who finishes receives a medal as a keepsake. The event is held annually and is part of Böda Sand’s wide range of summer activities and events.
course_highlights: Run on one of Öland’s most beautiful beaches, with almost two miles of white sand
Courses ranging from 500 metres to 10 kilometres
Family-friendly race with a medal for everyone who finishes
additional: The race is part of Böda Sand’s summer programme, with activities for the whole family. There are several distances to choose from, making it accessible to both children and adults. Böda Sand also offers many other sports and leisure activities alongside the event. Everyone who finishes receives a medal. An accommodation offer at Böda Sand has previously been mentioned in the race information.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.bodasand.se/evenemang/): 2027-06-30 — "Böda Beach Run — 30 juni 2027" (was estimated 2027-06-23)

name: Böda Sandsloppet
location: Böda Sand SportCamp, Böda, Öland, Sweden
description: Böda Sandsloppet is a family-friendly running race held at Böda Sand SportCamp on Öland. The race offers several distances for both children and adults, with routes through lovely forest terrain. There are classes for children aged 7 and up, as well as for men and women, who can choose between 4 km and 6.5 km. All participants who complete the race receive a medal as a keepsake.
course_highlights: Route through lovely forest terrain
Adults can choose between 6.5 km and 4 km
Children’s classes include shorter distances, with no timing for the youngest participants
additional: Late registration is available through 1 July and on race day from 15:00 at bib collection. Payment can be made in cash, by card or via Swish. There is no timing or awards ceremony for children aged 11 and younger. The start and finish are at Böda Sand SportCamp. According to the race information, start times are 16:30 for 1 km, 16:50 and 17:30 for the 1.8 km youth classes, 17:10 for P/F11, 18:00 for 4 km and 18:30 for 6.5 km. Participants aged 11 and younger are not timed and do not take part in the awards ceremony.

name: Byrundan
location: Unos park, Gamleby, Västervik Municipality, Sweden
description: Byrundan is a running race held in Gamleby, starting and finishing in Unos Park. The race offers distances for all ages, from children to adults, on a beautiful summer course through Gamleby. There are several categories and distances, including children’s and youth races, as well as a joint start for the 4 km and 8 km races. All participants receive a medal after finishing, and prizes are awarded to the top finishers in each category, along with sprint prizes in the 4 km and 8 km races. Byrundan is part of TOUR DE RUN and is organised by Gamleby OK.
course_highlights: The course runs through beautiful summer scenery in Gamleby
Start and finish in Unos Park
Water stations at the start/finish and at 4 km
additional: Race numbers can be collected in Unos Park from 15:00 until one hour before the start. Children are offered hamburgers/sausages after the race, sponsored by ICA Supermarket. Medals are sponsored by Metallfabriken Norden AB. Professional timing by Racetimer. The prize ceremony takes place at approximately 19:25 for children and 20:45 for everyone else. A sprint prize at 450 m for the 4 km and 8 km races is a gift card worth 3000 kr. The 8 km course record comes with a 1000 kr prize.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 22. Emumäe jooks
description: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 ühendab tervisesportlasi ja liikumisharrastajaid kevadest sügiseni, pakkudes võimalust proovile panna oma võimed erinevates vanuseklassides ja distantsidel. 22. Emumäe jooks on sarja viies etapp, mis toimub 4. juulil Emumäel. Sarja eesmärk on populariseerida jooksmist ja tervisekõndi ning toetada kohalikke harrastajaid. Võistlused toimuvad mitmetel distantsidel, alates lühikestest lastesõitudest kuni põhijooksudeni kuni 10 km. Ajavõtt toimub kiibiga ning numbrid tuleb kinnitada kõhule või rinnale.

name: Võhma terviseraja maraton
description: Võhma terviseraja maraton on maastikumaraton, mis toimub Võhma linna terviserajal. Rada on 620 meetrit pikk ring, mida tuleb läbida 68 korda, kokku 42,2 km. Jooks toimub 4. juulil 2026 algusega kell 9:00 ning pakub osalejatele medalit, ajavõttu, rajateenindust, toitlustamist finišis ja pesemise võimalust. Lisaks maratonile on võimalus joosta ka lühemat distantsi tasuta ja ilma aja fikseerimiseta, mis sobib kõigile liikumishuvilistele.

name: Kolmårdsrundan / Kolmården Ultra Trail
description: Kolmården Ultra Trail is a challenging and scenic running experience in the deep forests of Kolmården, with distances of 45 km and 60 km. The course offers varied terrain, with forest trails, mountain ridges featuring spectacular views, sections along the shores of Bråviken, and technical running in nature reserves. The race is suitable for both elite runners and recreational runners seeking a memorable trail experience. At the finish, participants receive a medal and a light meal, included in the entry fee.
course_highlights: Start in Kolmården Forest, with trails through varied terrain
Views from the mountain ridge at Kvarseboklint and running along the shores of Bråviken
Technical and challenging running through Bråviksbranten Nature Reserve
additional: Mandatory equipment: mobile phone, running vest/backpack/belt with at least 0.5 L of fluids, a pressure bandage/blood stopper, and a map with the emergency number (provided at bib collection). Aid stations: the 45K has 4 stations, and the 60K has 5 stations offering sports drink, energy products, and water. The cutoff time for the 45K is 13:30 at 44 km (pace 9:00 min/km). Participants are served a light meal at the finish. Start and finish at Klintvallen in Kvarsebo. Medical services are available on site. After finishing, participants receive a medal and are offered hot vegetarian soup. Mandatory equipment rules apply; aid stations are located along the course.

name: Mörksuggejakten TrailRun

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startavgift före 1/7 Barn och ungdom upp till 16 år 150 kr

description: Mörksuggejakten is one of Sweden’s most popular events in the long-distance race cup, offering a top-class competition since 1997. The cycling race in Rättvik features a beautiful and varied course covering 74 km, with a shorter 46 km option. The route passes through Rättvik, climbs to heights with breathtaking views over Lake Siljan, follows gravel roads and trails, and passes distinctive locations such as Dalhalla and Springkällan. Younger participants can take part in Lilla Mörksuggejakten, with several spectator-friendly courses in the Jarl area. Mörksuggejakten TrailRun also offers 10 km and 20.8 km runs starting from IK Jarl Rättvik.
course_highlights: The course offers beautiful views over Lake Siljan from the heights around Vidablick and the Hedsåsen summer pastures
The route follows gravel roads and trails, and crosses narrow suspension bridges over the Enån valley
Passes distinctive locations such as Dalhalla, Springkällan and Kungshol
additional: Mass start for all classes at 09:30. Maximum time: 5 hours. Race bibs can be collected on race day from 08:00 at IK Jarl. The courses are marked with red-and-white tape and signs. The course is 95% trail and 5% gravel road. It is permitted to switch to a shorter distance during the race. Parking is available at Rättvik Arena; camping in the parking area is prohibited.

name: 6. Navi jooksu-kõnnitiir
description: Võrumaa jooksu- ja kõnnisari on mitmeetapiline jooksu- ja kõndimisürituste sari, mis pakub erinevaid distantsivalikuid nii täiskasvanutele kui ka lastele. Põhidistantsid varieeruvad ligikaudu 5 kuni 8 kilomeetri vahel ning rada kulgeb peamiselt asfalt- ja kruusateedel, sisaldades ka väikest osa pehmel pinnasel. Sarja raames toimuvad ka minidistantsid ja mudilaste jooksud, mis on sobilikud kõigile vanusegruppidele. Võistlused toimuvad Võrumaa erinevates paikades, pakkudes osalejatele võimalust nautida piirkonna kaunist loodust ja sportlikku kogukonda.

name: Navi jooksutiir
description: Navi jooksutiir on Võru maakonnas toimuv jooksu-, kepikõndi- ja kõnnivõistlus, mida korraldab Navi Külaselts. See üritus pakub võimalust nautida liikumist ja tervislikku eluviisi kaunis looduses ning sobib erineva tasemega osalejatele. Jooksutiir on osa laiemast liikumisharrastuse edendamise algatusest, mille eesmärk on toetada aktiivset ja tervislikku eluviisi. Üritus kutsub kõiki liikumishuvilisi nautima sportlikku päeva ja liikumise rõõmu.

name: Kambja Tervisejooksud
description: Kambja tervisejooksud on kolmetapiline jooksusarja üritus, mis kutsub nii harrastajaid kui kogenud jooksjaid aktiivselt aega veetma värskes õhus. Igal etapil on võimalik valida umbes 5 km pikkuse terviseraja ringi või 10 km võistlusjooksu vahel. Lisaks toimub põnev võimsusjooks, kus selgitatakse välja parim jõu ja kiiruse suhe. Sarja lõpetajatele on auhinnad ja loosimised, sealhulgas peaauhind jalgratas. Osalemine on tasuta ning registreerida saab nii veebis kui kohapeal.

name: 7. ETAPP
description: Käime Koos is a recreational sports series by the Estonian Sports Association Kalev, inviting participants to take part in various hiking and walking stages across Estonia. The 7th stage takes place on Kesselaid, offering participants the chance to enjoy the beautiful natural scenery of the Muhu escarpment. The series aims to promote physical activity and a healthy lifestyle through hiking and walking together. Participants can experience varied terrain and combine exercise with good company.
course_highlights: Beautiful natural scenery of the Muhu escarpment
Varied terrain suitable for walking and hiking
The series takes place in different parts of Estonia, showcasing local natural beauty
additional: Käime Koos stages take place in different locations across Estonia, where participants can enjoy nature and physical activity. The series is organised by the Estonian Sports Association Kalev. More information and contact: Sirje Soovik +372 506 2250.

name: Vooremäe tipujooks
description: Vooremäe Tipujooks on Tartumaa Spordiliidu korraldatud jooksuvõistlus, mis toimub Vooremäel. See on traditsiooniline suvine spordisündmus, mis kutsub osalema jooksuhuvilisi ja pakub võimalust nautida kaunist loodust ning sportlikku võistlust. Võistlus on osa Tartumaa spordikalendrist ja sobib erineva tasemega jooksjatele.

name: 45. jooks ümber Pühajärve
location: Pühajärve Spa & Holiday Resort, Otepää, Valga County, Estonia
description: The 45th Run Around Lake Pühajärv is a traditional running race held around Pühajärv Spa & Holiday Resort. The distance is 10.7 km, and the course is well marked and secured, offering participants beautiful views of the lake. The race is part of the 2026 Maru Lake Runs series and is its third event. The start is at 12:00 on Saturday, July 11. Participants are provided with timing, refreshment stations and an awards ceremony.
course_highlights: A 10.7 km course around Lake Pühajärv
Refreshment stations at 4.4 km and 7.7 km
The course is marked and secured by course marshals
additional: Start groups are formed based on previous results; elite runners may start in the first group. Timing is chip-based, with the chip attached to the back of the race bib. Participants receive a medal, sports drink and water on the course and at the finish, as well as medical assistance along the entire course. The awards ceremony is scheduled for approximately 13:30, with awards for the top six. Participants can register on site, and discounts are available. The course runs around Lake Pühajärv and is suitable for both recreational and experienced runners.

name: Sportland Kõrvemaa Triatlon 2026
location: Kõrvemaa Matka- ja Suusakeskus, Kõrvemaa, Estonia
description: Sportland Kõrvemaa Triathlon takes place on 11 July 2026 at Kõrvemaa Hiking and Ski Centre and offers an exciting recreational triathlon experience. The main distance consists of a 250 m swim, a 20 km mountain-bike ride and a 4 km run, which runs largely along the ski trails and forest roads of the Põhja-Kõrvemaa Landscape Protection Area. In addition to the main event, participants can take part in the Stebby duathlon and youth duathlon, which are intended for different age groups. The event is well organised, with chip timing, medical support and aid stations. After the race, participants receive a medal and can enjoy hot soup, a sauna and bike washing facilities.
course_highlights: The swim takes place in the pond at Kõrvemaa Hiking and Ski Centre; one lap, with a maximum depth of 2.5 m
The 20 km cycling course follows the ski trails and forest roads of the Põhja-Kõrvemaa Landscape Protection Area
The 4 km trail run is marked and secured
additional: Starts are staggered in waves of five, with a 10-second interval between each start. Competitors must wear a helmet while cycling and a timing chip around their ankle. The entry fee includes medical first aid, aid-station service, a medal, hot soup, a smoothie, access to a sauna and hot tub, and bike washing. There is a bag drop at the event centre and a place to change clothes in the sauna anteroom. The swim number must be written on the cheek or shoulder with a waterproof marker. Drafting is allowed during the cycling leg. Trail course, family races, free soup and sauna, registration information, entry fees vary, limited number of places

name: Mõisa jooks
organizer: SK Team Kehtna ja Alutaguse vallavalitsus
description: Kehtna mõisajooks on sõbralik ja kogukonnale suunatud jooksuvõistlus, mis toimub Kehtna mõisa piirkonnas. Võistlusel on kolm distantsi: põhijooks 5 km, noortejooks 2,5 km ja lastejooks 500 m, mis sobivad erinevas vanuses osalejatele. Üritus pakub lisaks jooksule ka lastekaitsepäeva sündmusi, ponisõitu ja batuute, luues meeldiva perepäeva atmosfääri. Korraldajaks on SK Team Kehtna, kes on pühendunud spordi ja kehalise aktiivsuse edendamisele kogukonnas.

name: 5. Pühajärve pargimiil
description: 5. Pühajärve pargimiil on 1,6 km pikkune jooksuvõistlus, mis toimub Pühajärve Puhkekeskuse pargis laupäeval, 11. juulil 2026. Start ja finiš asuvad samas kohas ning võistlus algab kell 12.10. Võistlus on avatud kõigile jooksuhuvilistele ning pakub meeldivat võimalust nautida jooksu kaunis pargikeskkonnas. Osalejatele on tagatud medal, rinnanumber, ajavõtt kiibiga, spordijook ja vesi finišis ning meditsiiniline abi kogu raja ulatuses.

name: Pajusi Mudajooks
organizer: MTÜ Sporty ja MTÜ Pajusi Küla Selts
description: Pajusi Mudajooks on Kesk-Eesti populaarne rahvaspordiüritus, mis pakub osalejatele põnevat ja seikluslikku takistusrada kuni 10 km pikkusel rajal. Üritus toimub 11. juulil 2026 Pajusi külas ning sobib nii individuaalsetele jooksjatele kui ka võistkondadele. Rajal on nii looduslikke kui ka tehislikke takistusi, mis nõuavad osalejatelt nii füüsilist kui vaimset vastupidavust. Lastele on eraldi rajad ning kõigile lõpetajatele antakse mälestuseks medal. Osalejatele on tagatud tasuta parkimine ja soe supp pärast jooksu.

name: Musköloppet
description: Musköloppet is a popular running race held in the spectacular archipelago setting of Muskö. The race has a long tradition and celebrated its 30th anniversary in 2022, after being paused during the pandemic. There are several different courses and categories, including children’s races, and the event offers a wonderful nature experience, with the start and finish at Muskö Hembygdsgård. Late registration is available on site up to one hour before the start.
course_highlights: The race takes place in the beautiful archipelago setting of Muskö
Start and finish at Muskö Hembygdsgård
Children’s races over 1.5 km and 2.5 km for different age groups
additional: Late registration is available on site at the start and finish area up to one hour before the race begins. There are water stations along the course, and runners may arrange their own drinks. Race management may decide to restart the race if needed. Pacing assistance from non-competitors is not permitted. The children’s races start at 10:00 for 1.5 km (ages 7–10) and at 10:30 for 2.5 km (ages 11–14). The countdown on the official website indicates 10 July 2027. However, the published times and distances on the website are for 2026. The relay costs 150 kr per team, and the children’s race for ages 4–6 is free, according to the published information.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.muskoloppet.se/): 2027-07-10 — "Nedräkning till Musköloppet 10 juli 2027" (was estimated 2027-07-10)

name: Gotland Run 511k (2026)
description: Gotland Run 511k is a unique running adventure and a journey to explore your inner landscape. It is not a traditional race, but a self-supported run around the beautiful island of Gotland, including a loop around Fårö, starting and finishing in Visby. Participants have 10 days to complete the approximately 511 km course, with support from four Angel Stations along the way. The organizer provides basic support, while runners are responsible for their own food and accommodation.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Visby, Gotland’s medieval capital
Clockwise loop around the island, including Fårö
Mixed terrain with asphalt, gravel roads, and shorter trails
additional: Participants must check in twice daily using an online tool. Accommodation on the first night is at Visby Fängelse Hostel in shared rooms. A pre-race dinner and briefing are held the evening before the start. Angel Stations offer support, water, rest, and sometimes shower facilities. The ferry to Fårö runs every 30 minutes, but requires a call between 22:00 and 05:30. The run must be completed on foot within 10 days, averaging approximately 51 km per day. Luggage storage is available at the hostel. Parking is available near the ferry terminal, with cheaper options at Visby Airport. This is a self-supported event: participants are responsible for most of their food and logistics. The entire distance must be completed on foot within ten days, with regular position reports.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://runtrip.se/race-memo-2027/): 2027-07-10 — "SATURDAY, JULY 10 — The race starts at 10:00 am outside the main entrance of Visby Fängelse" (was estimated 2027-07-03)

name: PALMS Südasuve Challenge - Võsu 2026
location: Võsu, Lääne-Nigula vald, Lääne County, Estonia
description: PALMS Midsummer Challenge - Võsu 2026 is a sporting summer event held in the town of Võsu. It is an enjoyable and active challenge for running enthusiasts, offering the chance to enjoy summer nature and community support. The event is part of the Estonian Night Run series and brings together runners from different regions. Võsu’s beautiful coastal scenery provides excellent conditions for a sporting experience.
course_highlights: Coastal scenery in the town of Võsu
A pleasant, active summer running environment
Part of the Estonian Night Run series
additional: The event includes a range of swimming distances and is open to both local and virtual participants, offering summer sea air and sport in a friendly atmosphere.

name: Vimka tõusu maraton
description: Vimka tõusu maraton on suvine maraton Viimsi poolsaarel, mis pakub osalejatele ühe suure ringi läbimist. Stardipaik ja finiš asuvad Randvere kooli parklas. Rada on mitmekesine, hõlmates nii asfalteeritud teid kui ka metsaradu, kus on mitmeid tõuse ja langusi, mis muudavad jooksu põnevaks ja vaheldusrikkaks.

name: Semesterhalvmaran
location: Torps herrgård, Kumla Municipality, Örebro County, Sweden
description: Semesterhalvmaran is a recurring running event organized by the running club LK Gränslöst, inviting runners to experience the beautiful open landscapes of the Närke Plain. The race starts and finishes at Torps herrgård outside Kumla and offers a lovely running experience on gravel roads among rolling grain fields. After a two-year break, the race returns on July 11, 2027, welcoming runners of all levels to take part in a community filled with the joy of running. LK Gränslöst is an inclusive club that aims to bring runners from across the country together and build a strong community around running.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Torps herrgård outside Kumla
Run on gravel roads among rolling grain fields on the Närke Plain
Beautiful, nature-rich surroundings on the Närke Plain
additional: Registration is planned to open in January. The race is organized by the running club LK Gränslöst, which also organizes other races and group training every Wednesday at 18:00 in Örebro. The club focuses on community and the joy of running for all levels.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.lkgranslost.se/semesterhalvmaran-finish/): 2027-07-11 — "Söndagen den 11 juli 2027 är det åter dags för löpning på Närkeslätten när den är som bäst!" (was estimated 2027-07-03)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Söndagen den 11 juli 2027 är det åter dags för löpning på Närkeslätten när den är som bäst!

name: Võru kergejõustikuõhtu
description: Võru kergejõustikuõhtute sari on traditsiooniline kergejõustikuürituste sari, mis ühendab heite-, hüppe- ja jooksualad. Sari koosneb mitmest etapist, kus osalejad saavad võistelda erinevatel distantsidel ja aladel, kasutades IAAF punktitabelit paremusjärjestuse koostamiseks. Võistlused toimuvad Võru staadionil ning on avatud erineva tasemega sportlastele. Sari pakub mitmekesist kergejõustikuelamust nii harrastajatele kui ka edasijõudnutele.

name: Västervik City Run
description: Västervik City Run is a city race of approximately 6.3 km that takes place in and around central Västervik, starting and finishing at Grönsaks- och Fiskartorget. The race offers a scenic course along the cycle path beside Gamlebyviken, passing landmarks including the Stegeholm Castle ruins and Myntbryggan. After finishing, participants receive a medal as proof of their participation. The race is a popular summer tradition that welcomes runners of all ages.
course_highlights: A city race of approximately 6.3 km in central Västervik
The course follows the cycle path beside Gamlebyviken and passes the Stegeholm Castle ruins
Start and finish at Grönsaks- och Fiskartorget
additional: A children’s race (Sparbanksloppet) of 800 m for children up to 10 years old, with a group start from Fiskaretorget at 18:30. Participants receive medals after finishing. A separate Sparbanksloppet of approximately 700 metres is offered for children up to 10 years old. Registration for the 2027 race opens on 1 May.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.vikhockey.se/boka-bord-2/city-run/): 2027-07-12 — "Måndag den 12 juli är det dags för 2027 års löpartävling i Västerviks centrum!" (was estimated 2027-07-05)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Måndag den 12 juli är det dags för 2027 års löpartävling i Västerviks centrum!

name: Lüllemäe mägedejooks
description: Lüllemäe mägedejooks on Valgamaa jooksusarja III etapp, mis toimub Lüllemäe terviseradadel. Põhijooksu distants on 4,5 km ning lisaks toimuvad tillu- ja minijooksud lastele Lüllemäe Põhikooli staadionil. Võistlus on sobilik erinevas vanuses jooksjatele ning pakub võimalust nautida kaunist loodust ja sportlikku võistlustunnet. Osavõtutasu on lastejooksudel tasuta ning põhijooksu tasud on mõistlikud, soodustades laia osavõttu.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 9. Rakvere valla Suvejooks
description: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 on mitmeetapiline jooksu- ja kõnnisari, mis hõlmab erinevaid jooksuvõistlusi Lääne-Virumaa piirkonnas. 9. etapp, Rakvere valla Suvejooks, toimub 18. juulil 2026 Rakveres aadressil Kooli 4. Sarja eesmärk on pakkuda sportlikku väljakutset ja rõõmu jooksuhuvilistele ning toetada aktiivset eluviisi kogu piirkonnas.

name: Väinjärve jooks , 8. Järvamaa Järvede jooksud VI etapp
description: Järvamaa Järvede jooksud on traditsiooniline jooksusarja võistlus, mis koosneb mitmest etapist erinevate järvede ääres Järvamaal. Väinjärve jooks, mis toimub 18. juulil 2026, on selle sarja kuues etapp. Võistlus pakub osalejatele võimalust nautida kaunist loodust ja mitmekesist maastikku järve ümbruses. Sarja raames on võimalik osaleda erinevatel distantsidel ning see sobib nii harrastajatele kui ka kogenud jooksjatele.

name: Rakvere valla suvejooks
description: Rakvere valla suvejooks on traditsiooniline jooksuvõistlus, mis toimub Sõmeru piirkonnas. See on osa Lääne-Virumaa jooksu- ja kõnnisarjast ning pakub sportlikku väljakutset jooksuhuvilistele. Rajad on mitmekesised ja sobivad erineva tasemega jooksjatele. Võistlus on sõbralik ja kogukondlik, kutsudes osalema kõiki jooksusõpru.

name: Lidingöloppet Funäsfjällen
description: Lidingöloppet Funäsfjällen is a challenging trail race in a mountain setting, with steep climbs, sloping trails and flat meadows offering fantastic views of the mountains. The race combines adrenaline-filled running with scenic experiences and is held at Bruksvallarna ski stadium in Bruksvallarna. This is the fourth edition of the race, welcoming runners to a unique and beautiful challenge in the Swedish mountains.
course_highlights: Steep climbs and sloping trails
Flat meadows with incredible mountain views
A downhill stretch towards Bruksvallarna village after a tough climb
additional: Bib pick-up takes place at the venue in Bruksvallarna. A late-entry fee of SEK 100 applies to registrations on race day. During the week before the race, running clinics, shoe testing, try-out mountain running sessions and other activities are held in Bruksvallarna. Water stations and food and drink stations are available along the course.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.lidingoloppet.se/lidingoloppet-funasfjallen): 2027-07-17 — "Date 17 juli" (was estimated 2027-07-10)

name: 31. Jooks-kõnd ümber Uhtjärve
description: 31. Jooks-kõnd ümber Uhtjärve on traditsiooniline jooksu- ja kõnnisari Võrumaa piirkonnas, mis pakub mitmekesiseid distantsivalikuid igale osalejale. Võistlus toimub kaunis looduskeskkonnas Uhtjärve ümbruses, pakkudes sportlikku väljakutset nii jooksjatele kui ka kõndijatele. Sarja raames on kavas erinevad distantsid ja minidistantsid, mis sobivad nii algajatele kui ka kogenud sportlastele. Võistlus on osa Võrumaa jooksu- ja kõnnisarjast, mis on tuntud oma sõbraliku atmosfääri ja hea korralduse poolest.

name: Jooks ümber Uhtjärve
description: Võrumaa jooksu- ja kõnnisari on mitmeetapiline jooksu- ja kõndimisürituste sari, mis pakub erinevaid distantsivalikuid nii täiskasvanutele kui ka lastele. Põhidistantsid ulatuvad umbes 5 kuni 8 kilomeetrini ning rada kulgeb peamiselt asfalt- ja kruusateedel, pakkudes ka maastikupalasid. Sarja raames toimuvad ka minidistantsid ja mudilaste jooksud, mis on sobilikud kõigile vanusegruppidele. Üritus on avatud kõigile spordihuvilistele ning rõhutab tervislike eluviiside propageerimist ja kogukonna kaasamist.

name: Aastajooks
organizer: Spordiklubi Pärnu Kahe Silla Klubi MTÜ
description: Pärnu aastajooksud on traditsiooniline jooksusarja üritus, mis sai alguse 1985. aastal ja on inspireeritud idamaade kalendrist, pühendudes igal aastal vastava aasta sümbolloomale. 2026. aasta jooksusarja teema on tulihobuse aasta, mis koosneb üheksast etapist, mis toimuvad kolmes erinevas Pärnu piirkonnas: Vallikäär, Pärnu rand ja Reiu-Raeküla terviserada. Igas asukohas toimub kolm etappi, pakkudes osalejatele mitmekesist ja huvitavat jooksukogemust. Sarja eesmärk on pakkuda sportlikku väljakutset ja rõõmu nii harrastajatele kui ka kogenud jooksjatele.

name: Kohila Pikamaajooksusari
description: Kohila Pikamaajooksusari on Kohila valla spordihuvilistele mõeldud jooksusarja võistlus, mis pakub mitmekesiseid jooksuvõimalusi erinevatele vanuse- ja tasemeklassidele. Sarja eesmärk on edendada liikumisharrastust ja pakkuda osalejatele meeldivat sportlikku kogemust. Igal etapil saavad osalejad kaune meenemedali ning sarja kokkuvõttes toimub punktiarvestus. Kohila Spordikeskus korraldab sarja ning pakub kaasaegseid tingimusi ja tugevat spordikeskkonda.

name: KEVEK ja Tartu Kalev staadionijooksu sari
description: KEVEK ja Tartu Kalev staadionijooksu sari on Tartu Spordiselts Kalevi korraldatav jooksusarja võistlus, mis toimub Tartu linnas. Sarjas on mitmeid etappe, mis pakuvad võimalust osaleda staadionijooksudes erinevates vanuseklassides. Võistlused toimuvad peamiselt Tamme ja Ülenurme staadionil ning on suunatud nii noortele kui ka täiskasvanutele, pakkudes sportlikku ja sõbralikku võistluskeskkonda. Registreerimine sulgub võistluspäeval kell 12.00, mis annab paindlikkust osalemiseks.

name: Kaldoaivi Ultra Trail
description: Kaldoaivi Ultra Trail on maailman pohjoisin ultrajuoksutapahtuma, joka järjestetään Utsjoella, Lapin erämaassa. Reitti kulkee Kaldoaivin korkeimpien tunturien huipuille ja tarjoaa upeita, haastavia maisemia. Kilpailu testaa juoksijoiden kestävyyttä ja taitoja vaativassa luonnossa, mutta palkitsee kokemuksella, joka saa monet palaamaan vuosittain. Tapahtuma sisältää myös maastopyöräkilpailuja ja tarjoaa monipuolisia vaihtoehtoja eri tasoisille osallistujille.
course_highlights: Reitti kulkee Kaldoaivin korkeimpien tunturien huipuille
Upeat ja karut Lapin erämaamaisemat
Vaativa ja opettavainen polkureitti
additional: Ilmoittautuminen kahdelle päivälle antaa -30% alennuksen halvemman sarjan hinnasta. Osallistumismaksu sisältää huoltopisteiden juoma- ja energiansaannin, peseytymismahdollisuudet, varustepussin kuljetuksen maaliin, lähtönumeron, ajanoton, Kaldoaivi Ultra Trail -kevytrepun, KUT-tuotteen ja Finisher-riipuksen. Sarjan vaihdot ja siirrot ovat maksuttomia 7.7.2027 asti. Kilpailukeskukset ja lähtöpaikat ovat Nuorgamissa ja Utsjoella. Kilpailun aikataulu sisältää useita lähtöaikoja eri matkoille 23.7. ja 24.7.2027. Kilpailun osallistujakiintiöt vaihtelevat matkoittain, esimerkiksi MTB & E-MTB 57 km: 100 osallistujaa, Trailrun 168 km: 100 osallistujaa. Tapahtuma sisältää useita matkoja, joihin sisältyvät trailrun, mountain biking ja maantiepyöräily, ilman mukavuuksia reitin varrella. Osallistumiseen sisältyy kilpailunumero, aikamittauschippi, kevyt reppu ja finisher-riipus. Tapahtuma järjestetään heinäkuussa 2027, ja tarkemmat aikataulut ja ilmoittautumistiedot löytyvät verkkosivuilta.

name: Mispo maastikumaraton
description: Mispo Maastikumaraton on maastikujooks, mis toimub Kurgja piirkonnas Põhja-Pärnumaal. Võistluse distantsid on 42,195 km (maraton), 21,097 km (poolmaraton), 14 km ja 7 km. Start antakse C.R. Jakobsoni Talumuuseumi juurest kell 11.00 ning sekretariaat avatakse kell 9.00. Kõik lõpetajad saavad finišis joogi, söögi, sauna, diplomi ja medali. Võistlus on traditsiooniline ja korraldatud Terviseklubi Mispo poolt, kes on aktiivne spordiklubi alates 1989. aastast.

name: Sakala metsajooks
description: Sakala metsajooks on maastikujooks, mis toimub Metsarada piirkonnas Kurgja vallas. Võistlused hõlmavad erinevaid distantse, sealhulgas maratoni, poolmaratoni ning lühemaid 7 km ja 14 km jooksu. Start antakse C.R. Jakobsoni Talumuuseumi juurest kell 11.00 ning osalejatele on finišis tagatud jook, toit, saun, diplom ja medal. Jooks on traditsiooniline ja korraldatud Terviseklubi Mispo poolt, pakkudes sportlikku ja sõbralikku atmosfääri.

name: Helags Fjällmara
description: Helags Fjällmara is a classic mountain marathon held in the Ljungdalsfjällen since 1985. The race offers several distances to suit all levels, from the challenging 42 km full marathon to the 800-metre children’s race. It offers a unique mountain experience amid beautiful scenery and varied terrain, and is family-friendly, with races for both adults and children. The start and finish are on the meadow in the centre of Ljungdalen, and the event includes energy and drink stations, a personal cup, a medal for everyone who finishes, and showers and a sauna after the race.
course_highlights: Trail race amid the beautiful mountain scenery of the Ljungdalsfjällen
Distances ranging from an 800 m children’s race to a 42 km full marathon
Start and finish on the meadow in the centre of Ljungdalen
additional: Mass start for all distances. Race bibs are distributed at the gymnasium by the event area, with a chip for electronic timing. Energy and drink stations along the course and after the finish. A medal for everyone who finishes. Showers and a sauna are available after the race. Participant caps apply to each distance; for example, 100 participants for the 42 km race. Children under a certain age must run with an adult.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://helagsfjallmara.se/): 2027-07-24 — "24 Juli 2027" (was estimated 2027-07-17)

name: Hornsjön Runt
description: Hornsjön Runt is a traditional running race around Öland’s only inland lake, through beautiful and varied Öland countryside. The race offers several distances for both young people and adults, including a walking class. Along the course, participants pass gravel roads with limestone surfaces, grass, cow pastures, deciduous and coniferous forest, and sand dunes. Everyone who finishes receives a medal, and prizes are awarded to the top three in each class.
course_highlights: The race goes around Öland’s only inland lake
Varied terrain including gravel roads, grass, cow pastures, deciduous and coniferous forest, and sand dunes
Three water stations along the course, as well as at the start/finish
additional: A walking class is available for 5.5 km and 11 km, with start times between 13:00 and 16:00 and no timing. Showers and changing facilities are available at Högby Idrottsplats. Prizes are awarded to the top three in all classes. The start and finish are at Pensionat Hornsjön. Youth classes have different start times between 15:30 and 16:00, depending on age and distance. There are distances for children and young people, as well as an untimed walking class. Everyone who finishes receives a medal.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://olandrunning.se/lopp/hornsjon-runt/): 2027-07-24 — "Tid & datum 24 juli 2027" (was estimated 2027-07-17)

name: Hamra Trail Run 2026
description: Hamra Trail Run is a friendly, exclusive trail running event held in spectacular mountain surroundings at Pensionat Strandgården in Fjällnäs. The event offers three distances—Sprint 12 km, Distance 24 km and Ultra 48 km—with varying elevation gain and aid stations along the course. Runners are expected to be self-sufficient and follow the clearly marked orange flags along the route. The event is limited to a maximum of 150 participants and is known for its community spirit and scenic experience.
course_highlights: Sprint 12 km with approximately 300 m of elevation gain and 1 aid station at 4 km
Distance 24 km with approximately 630 m of elevation gain and 2 aid stations at 4 km and 20 km
Ultra 48 km with approximately 1,300 m of elevation gain and 4 aid stations, including at the start/finish
additional: Race bibs are collected at the race office on race day, with different collection times depending on the distance. A mandatory pre-race briefing is held before the start. Runners must bring their own cup/mug/bottle, as disposable cups are not used at the aid stations. Mandatory equipment includes an extra layer, a wind jacket/wind pants depending on the weather, a first-aid kit including an elastic bandage, and a fully charged mobile phone with the safety number saved. Parts of the courses are muddy and unmarked, particularly across Skenörsfjället, where the terrain is dense and rugged. The cut-off time for the 24 km is 3.5 hours, with a maximum time of 8 hours. Runners are encouraged to stop and help others if needed and to follow the flags carefully. GPX files for all distances are available. According to the available race information, the number of entries is limited to 150. A runners’ dinner is held after the finish.

name: KFC Südasuve Challenge - Pirita 2026
description: KFC Südasuve Challenge on südasuvine spordipidu, mis toimub Pirital juba kolmandat korda. See kogukonnajooks pakub kauneid mere- ja vanalinna vaateid ning võimalust valida kolme distantsi vahel, kus saab joosta, kõndida või läbida distantsi lapsevankri või keppidega. Start ja finiš on mugavalt ühes kohas rannajoonel ning rada kulgeb mereäärsel kergliiklusteel ilma liiklust sulgemata. Kõiki lõpetajaid ootavad KFC kingitused ning meeleolu hoiab päevajuht ja maskott.

name: Leigo Trail
description: Leigo Trail on vaheldusrikas trail-jooks Lõuna-Eestis, mis toimub Leigo järvede ümbruses. Võistluskeskus asub Leigo turismitalus ning rada pakub erinevaid distantsi- ja raskusastme valikuid, sobides nii algajatele kui ka kogenud jooksjatele. Rajad kulgevad metsaradadel, savi-kruusateedel ja järveäärsetel looduslikel radadel, pakkudes tehnilisi tõuse ja laskumisi ning kauneid vaateid. Sündmus ühendab looduse, liikumise ja kogukonna ning pakub meeldivat elamust kogu perele.

name: Iigaste metsajooks
description: Iigaste metsajooks on osa Rein Leppiku nimelisest Valgamaa jooksu- ja kepikõnnisarjast, mis toimub iga aasta suvel. See metsajooks pakub osalejatele võimalust nautida kaunist loodust ja sportlikku väljakutset 7,4 km pikkusel põhijooksul ning lühematel distantsidel jooksu ja kepikõndi. Võistlus toimub Iigaste külas ning on sobilik erinevatele vanuseklassidele, pakkudes medalite ja diplomitega tunnustust parimatele. Osavõtt on soodne ning registreerimine toimub mugavalt internetis.

name: Runmaröloppen 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Mini-Lunken 1.5km 60kr inkl nummerlapp, medalj och en kula glass.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Lunken 5.7km: från 150kr inkl nummerlapp, medalj och finisherdryck.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Halvmarathon 21km: från 350kr inkl nummerlapp, medalj och finisherdryck.

description: Runmaröloppen is a unique running event in the heart of the Stockholm archipelago on the island of Runmarö. The races offer a friendly, welcoming atmosphere and scenic courses suited to children, seniors and experienced runners alike. The start and finish are at Svängens Krog, and the day offers running, food, ice cream, swimming and a wonderful atmosphere. The half-marathon course is approximately 21 km long and is considered one of Sweden’s most beautiful, while Lunken, at 5.7 km, passes through lush sheep pastures and archipelago villages. Mini-Lunken and Antikrundan are shorter races for children and seniors, and there is also a dog class in which dogs receive an edible medal.
course_highlights: Half-marathon, 21 km around all of Runmarö, with historic and scenic views
Lunken, 5.7 km through lush sheep pastures and authentic archipelago villages
Mini-Lunken and Antikrundan, 1.5 km for children and seniors
additional: The start and finish are at Svängens Krog. Mini-Lunken starts at 11:00, and Lunken and the half-marathon start at 13:00. There are energy stations and encouragement around the island. After finishing, everyone receives a medal and a finisher drink; Mini and Senior Lunk participants are treated to ice cream. There are a maximum of 200 places for the half-marathon and 120 for Lunken in the first release, with another 30 places released later. A dedicated taxi boat runs between Stavsnäs Vinterhamn and Styrsvik, as does Vaxholmsbåt route #23. Race bibs can be collected at Svängen and Låttas Bageri. There will be an evening dinner and party at Svängen after the race. 20% of the surplus is donated to Skärgårdsstiftelsen. The event offers children’s races, a 5.7 km race and a 21 km half-marathon. Participant numbers are limited. According to the existing event information, 20 percent of the surplus goes to Skärgårdsstiftelsen.

name: Salomon 27K
location: Ottsjö, Åre Municipality, Jämtland County, Sweden
description: Salomon 27K is a mountain-running event covering 27 kilometres and crossing three mountains, with a beautiful finish in Ottsjö. Many consider it one of Sweden’s most beautiful races, offering a unique mountain experience and pure poetry in nature. Food and drink stations serving locally crafted food are available along the course, and a safety team can provide rapid assistance if needed. Participants can also take a bus transfer to the start and back after the finish.
course_highlights: 27 kilometres of mountain running across three mountains
Beautiful finish in Ottsjö
Food and drink stations serving locally crafted food
additional: Bus transfers to the start are available from Ottsjö, Trillevallen and Undersåker, as well as a return transfer after the finish. Electronic chip timing. A kåsa drinking cup is used at cup-free drink stations. A safety team is on hand to respond quickly to accidents. Entries can be transferred for a fee of 250 SEK. A large portion of the entry fee goes towards upgrading the Fjällmaraton trails for sustainable development. The race is part of Fjällmaratonveckan.

name: Pajūrio basatlonas
description: Pajūrio Basatlonas is a unique barefoot run on the seaside sand, held in Smiltynė, Klaipėda. The event takes place during the Sea Festival and gives participants an unforgettable experience of running between the sea and the dunes. The race promotes running culture in Lithuania and encourages a healthy lifestyle. Participants can choose from several distances and enjoy the beautiful coastal scenery and gentle breeze.
course_highlights: Barefoot running on seaside sand
Start on the beach by the southern pier, Kopgalis, Smiltynė
Distances of 500 m, 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km, with a 2-hour time limit
additional: A 2-hour time limit applies to all distances. Participants must have an identity document, a race number attached, and an electronic timing chip attached to their shirt. Participants run voluntarily and assume all risks associated with taking part. Barefoot running on seaside sand, various distances (500 m, 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km), online registration, regulations and rules, awards and commemorative medals.

name: Peak Performance Vertical K
description: Åre Vertical K is a prestigious vertical race held annually on Tuesday evening as part of Kia Fjällmaraton Årefjällen. The race starts with a mass start at Åre Torg and finishes at the summit of Åreskutan, gaining exactly 1,000 vertical metres. It is a demanding race, and participants can expect to give their all from start to finish. The course records to beat are 46:24 for women and 39:13 for men. Prize money is awarded to the top three finishers in both the women’s and men’s categories.
course_highlights: Mass start at Åre Torg
Finish at the summit of Åreskutan
Exactly 1,000 vertical metres
additional: Food and drink stations along the course featuring local food products. A kåsa is used for serving drinks at cup-free hydration stations. Bus transfers to the start from Ottsjö, Trillevallen and Undersåker, and bus transfers back after the finish. Electronic chip timing. Safety team for rapid response in the event of accidents. Entry can be transferred for a fee of SEK 250. Insurance is recommended to cover refunds in the event of illness or injury. Prizes are awarded to the top three women and men. The course records are held by Emmie Collinge in 46:24 and Kilian Jornet in 39:13.

name: 10. ETAPP
description: TV 10 Olümpiastarti on Eesti Kergejõustikuliidu korraldatud võistlussari, mis on suunatud koolinoortele ja noortele sportlastele. Võistlused toimuvad erinevates vanuseklassides ning hõlmavad mitmekülgseid kergejõustiku alasid. 10. etapp toimub 29. juulil 2026 Tartus Tamme staadionil, pakkudes noortele võimalust oma oskusi proovile panna ja kogemusi saada. Sarja eesmärk on toetada noorte sportlikku arengut ja pakkuda lõbusat ning motiveerivat võistluskeskkonda.

name: Fjällmaraton 100k
location: Fångåmon, Åre Municipality, Jämtland County, Sweden
description: Fjällmaraton 100K is a classic mountain marathon that starts at dawn in Fångåmon and follows a beautiful, winding, easy-to-run trail to Vålådalen via Nulltjärn. The route then joins the classic Fjällmaraton course over Ottfjället and continues over Hållfjället, Grofjället and Välliste on the way back to Ottsjö. The race offers a unique atmosphere, with a recovery zone in the finish area where participants can relax in a sauna and recover with non-alcoholic beer. All participants must be self-sufficient during the race, with the option to refill water at official aid stations along the course.
course_highlights: Starts at dawn in Fångåmon
Beautiful, easy-to-run trail via Nulltjärn and Vålådalen
Passes over Ottfjället, Hållfjället, Grofjället and Välliste
additional: Food and aid stations along the course serving local artisanal food. The official drink is U Sport by Umara (lemon). Participants receive a Fold-a-Cup for use at the aid stations. Bus transfers to the start from Ottsjö, Trillevallen and Undersåker, and back after the finish. Recovery zone with a sauna and non-alcoholic beer in the finish area. Entries can be transferred for a fee of 250 SEK. A safety team is on hand to provide rapid assistance in the event of serious injuries. Participants are responsible for their own fluids and energy between the official aid stations.

name: Vormsi maraton
description: Vormsi maratonid VIII on kahepäevane jooksuüritus Vormsi saarel, mis toimub 31. juulil ja 1. augustil Sviby sadama lähedal. Osalejad saavad valida maratoni või poolmaratoni distantsi mõlemal päeval, kusjuures rajad kulgevad peamiselt asfalteeritud teedel Vormsi saarel. Rajad on tähistatud ja ajavõtt toimub elektrooniliste SI-pulkadega. Pärast jooksu on võimalus osaleda seltskondlikus suminas ja nautida sauna ning sooja suppi finišis. Üritus on väike ja sõbralik, sobides nii kogenud jooksjatele kui ka harrastajatele.

name: 28. Holstre-Paistu maanteejooks Hanno Priksi mälestuseks
description: Holstre-Paistu Road Race is the fourth stage of Viljandi Municipality’s running series and takes place in Paistu. The race is intended for runners of all abilities and offers young people and adults alike the opportunity to take part. Participation in the series motivates runners to complete all four stages, and active participants are rewarded. The course runs through the scenic Viljandi County, offering an enjoyable running experience.
course_highlights: Road race in the Paistu area
Participation opportunities in different age groups
Participants are motivated by awards in the running series

name: Mapri Ehitus x Öövägilane
description: Mapri Ehitus x Öövägilane on takistuskross, mis toimub Lähte terviseradadel. See on mitmekülgne ja väljakutseid pakkuv jooks, kus osalejad ronivad, roomavad, tõstavad ja tiritakse läbi muda, vee, liiva ja mägede. Üritus sobib nii algajatele kui ka kogenud takistussõitjatele, pakkudes põnevat ja lõbusat kogemust. Sarja eesmärk on pakkuda mitmepäevast võistlust, kus iga etapp on oma näoga ning rõhk on nii lõbususel kui ka füüsilisel väljakutsel.

name: Mapri Ehitus x Vägilase jooks Lähte
description: Mapri Ehitus x Vägilase jooks Lähte on takistuskross, mis toimub Lähte terviseradadel ja jõulinnakus. Rajad on 4 km ja 8 km pikkused ning pakuvad osalejatele tõsist proovikivi, kus tuleb läbida mitmekesiseid takistusi, mis panevad proovile nii jõu kui osavuse. Vägilase jooks on Eesti mitmekülgseim takistussarja üritus, mis sobib nii algajatele kui ka kogenud takistussõitjatele. Üritus on osa sarjast, kus rõhk on maastikul, takistustel ja seikluslikul kogemusel.

name: Ottsjö 12k
location: Ottsjö, Åre Municipality, Jämtland County, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Barn i åldern 10 -13 får springa tillsammans med förälder eller annan vuxen och endast betalar 200kr

description: Ottsjö 12K is a 12-kilometer mountain trail race with 300 meters of elevation gain. It offers a beautiful and memorable course without being as demanding as the longer distances during Fjällmaraton Week. The race is a perfect first step for runners who want to challenge themselves in a mountain setting and perhaps later try Salomon 27K or Kia Fjällmaraton. Children aged 10 to 13 can run with an adult at a reduced price, and youths aged 14 to 18 receive half off the entry fee. The race is organized with a focus on sustainability and safety, with food and drink stations along the course and bus transfers to the start and back from the finish.
course_highlights: 12 km of mountain trail with 300 meters of elevation gain
Beautiful and memorable course in a mountain setting
Food and drink stations featuring locally made food along the course
additional: Bus transfers to the start from Ottsjö, Trillevallen and Undersåker, and return bus transfers after finishing. Electronic chip timing. Safety organization for a rapid response in case of accidents. A kåsa (traditional drinking cup) is used at cup-free drink stations. Children aged 10–13 can run with an adult. Half price for youths aged 14–18. The standard minimum age is 14. Children aged 10–13 can participate with an adult for 200 kr, and participants aged 14–18 pay half the entry fee. The adult must stay in contact with the accompanying child throughout the race.

name: Bruksleden Terrängmaraton

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Sista dag för ordinarie anmälan är fredagen den 17 juli.

description: Bruksleden Trail Marathon is a trail race organised by Fagersta OK, offering two distances: 42 km (Helan) and 21 km (Halvan). The race follows the beautiful Bruksleden trail through forests, winding paths and past lakes, with varied and technically challenging terrain. With a limited number of 200 places, the event has a friendly, welcoming atmosphere. There are aid stations along the course staffed by volunteers, and after the finish, showers and a light meal are available. This is an ideal race for experienced trail runners and curious recreational runners alike who want to enjoy nature and a challenge.
course_highlights: Run through beautiful forests and along winding woodland trails
Pass sparkling lakes
Varied and technically challenging terrain with steep climbs and descents
additional: Places are limited to 200 to preserve a friendly atmosphere. There are aid stations along the course staffed by volunteers. Showers and a light meal are available after the finish. Previous editions have started and finished in the area around Fageråsen/Fagersta; the arrangements, distances and practical information for 2027 have not been confirmed.

name: Vääna-Jõesuu jooks
description: Vääna-Jõesuu jooks on osa Harku valla jooksusarjast, mis toimub 2. augustil 2026 Vääna-Jõesuu kooli staadionil. Võistlusel on mitmed distantsid alates laste jooksudest kuni 5 km põhijooksuni, mis kulgeb mööda Vääna-Jõesuu tänavaid ja metsateed vastupäeva. Sarja eesmärk on motiveerida inimesi tegelema spordiga ning pakkuda liikumisrõõmu ja sportlikke eluviise. Võistluse korraldavad kohalikud jooksu- ja triatloniklubid koostöös valla ja külaseltsidega.

name: ÜLEMISTE Ööjooks - Tallinn 2026
description: ÜLEMISTE Night Run - Tallinn 2026 is a running and walking event taking place in the Ülemiste district of Tallinn. The event offers an opportunity to get active and support well-being and health. It is part of a wider initiative to promote recreational physical activity in Estonia, organised by the Centre of Competence for Recreational Physical Activity. Participants can enjoy being active in an urban environment and support their mental and physical health.
course_highlights: Running and walking in the Ülemiste district of Tallinn
A great opportunity to get active and support your health
Organised by the Centre of Competence for Recreational Physical Activity
additional: Participation involves running and walking; registration is open

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 20. Tapa linnajooks
description: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari on traditsiooniline jooksu- ja kõnnisari, mis pakub mitmekesiseid jooksuvõimalusi erinevatele vanuseklassidele ja tasemetele. Sarja etapid toimuvad erinevates Lääne-Virumaa paikades, pakkudes jooksjatele nii linnajooksu kui ka maastikujooksu elamusi. 20. Tapa linnajooks toimub 8. augustil 2026 Tapa Gümnaasiumi juures ning on osa sarja pikaajalisest traditsioonist, mis ühendab tervisesportlasi ja jooksuhuvilisi. Sarja eesmärk on motiveerida inimesi aktiivselt liikuma ning pakkuda meeldivaid jooksukogemusi.

name: Paldiski liigub
description: Paldiski liigub on Lääne-Harju Liikumissarja kolmas etapp, mis toimub Paldiski Spordikeskuses. Rada kulgeb mööda Paldiski tähtsamaid vaatamisväärsusi, tänavaid ja kergliiklusteid, pakkudes osalejatele kauneid loodusvaateid ja ajaloolist atmosfääri. Pere väiksematele on korraldatud tasuta lastejooksud, kus rõhutatakse liikumisrõõmu ja elukestvat liikumisteadlikkust. Sündmus toimub Paldiski linna päeva raames, kus autasustatakse sarja parimaid ning õhtu lõpetab kontsert.

name: Kia Fjällmaraton 45 km
description: Kia Fjällmaraton 45K is a demanding mountain marathon across classic mountain terrain, held during Fjällmaraton Week in the Åre area. The race dates back to 2005, and for 2026 the course is planned to cross Ottfjället along the event’s signature trail. The race welcomes both experienced mountain runners and curious beginners looking for an unusual and scenic challenge. To earn the well-known wooden medal, you must finish within the “medal time” (the winner’s time + 30%); all participants must be self-sufficient on the course.
course_highlights: The course crosses Ottfjället over classic mountain terrain
Food and hydration stations at Edsåsdalen (12 km, 25 km), Tobaksdalen (35.5 km), and Hållvallen (40 km)
Finish in Ottsjö, with a shared post-race lunch for all finishers
additional: Participants must be self-sufficient on the course; the official hydration product at the stations is Umara (2:1 lemon, 120 g/l). Water and toilets are available at the start in Trillevallen. Support along the course is not permitted except at the official stations. In addition to drinks, the stations offer bars, bananas, buns, and, at later stations, hot dogs, coffee, and broth. The race is approximately 45 km long with around 1,200 metres of elevation gain (according to a race report). Participants are self-sufficient between aid stations; official food and hydration are available at Edsåsdalen, Tobaksdalen, and Hållvallen. Kia offers Fjälltransfer, with free transfers between the finish and the parking area, as well as a bus between the finish and Undersåker/Åre. Accommodation in Åre near Kia Fjällmaraton includes, among other options, Hotel Åre Fjällsätra.

name: Stora Stöten Run
description: Stora Stöten Run is a trail race in the heart of the Falun Mine World Heritage Site, offering a historic and varied running experience. The course passes medieval smelting sites, mining farmsteads, dams and dam houses, following old routes known as Vattnets Väg till Gruvan (The Water’s Way to the Mine). The race has three distances (21.6 km, 13.6 km and 5.6 km) and welcomes both competitive runners and recreational participants, with the option to run timed or untimed. The event is organised by the orienteering club OK Kåre, which welcomes participants to the start and finish at Falun Mine.
course_highlights: Three courses: 21.6 km, 13.6 km and 5.6 km, starting and finishing at Falun Mine
The course passes medieval smelting sites, mining farmsteads, dams and dam houses along Vattnets Väg
Varied terrain: gravel, grass, trail tracks, nature paths and short paved sections; an initial climb and clearly marked downhill sections
additional: Start and finish at Falun Mine; warm-up begins at 12:10 on Falu Rödfärg’s paved area (approximately 7 minutes), led by Friskis & Svettis; all courses start at the same time, and runners are divided into two optional groups based on target pace (group 1: women ≤6 min/km, men ≤5 min/km). Runners can choose to run with or without timing; prizes go to the first three finishers on each course, with raffle prizes for other participants; teams can be registered (teams of 3), and registrations can be transferred free of charge through the registration system. The race information mentions aid stations/water stops, parking, race office, showers/changing facilities and course markings. All three courses start and finish at Falun Mine; results from previous years are available.

name: Ölands Marathon
description: Öland Marathon is a flat, easy-to-run marathon starting and finishing in the square in Löttorp. The course consists of a 2.1 km loop in Löttorp, followed by an 11.2 km loop run three times, for a total distance of 42,195 metres, entirely on asphalt. During the race, runners have views of Blå Jungfrun and pass three aid stations per lap offering sports drink, cola and water. All finishers receive a unique medal made of Öland limestone, and the women’s and men’s winners each win dinner for two at Kalk in Löttorp.
course_highlights: Flat, easy-to-run course
100% asphalt
Three aid stations per lap offering sports drink, cola and water
additional: Bib numbers can be collected from 12:00 on race day. Personal energy supplies must be handed in at least one hour before the start. Accommodation is available in four-bed cabins at Högby IP. Prizes are awarded to all age-group winners and the top overall finishers.

name: Svartåloppet
location: Svartå Folkets hus, Svartå, Degerfors Municipality, Örebro County, Sweden
description: Svartåloppet is a fun run held on the second Saturday in August, starting and finishing at Svartå Folkets hus. The race offers three distances: 2.5 km on flat roads, and 5.5 km and 14 km on hilly forest roads and trails. Timing is handled by Racetimer, providing a modern and reliable system. The race is open to all ages and has a long tradition in Svartå, dating back to the 20th century.
course_highlights: The 5.5 km and 14 km courses are hilly forest routes on forest roads and trails
The 2.5 km course is a flatter road route
Start and finish at Svartå Folkets hus
additional: Timing is handled by Racetimer using a modern and reliable timing system. Svartå IF is the organizer and has its own facilities, including a floodlit trail and club cabin at Hyttvallen. Results from several past years are available via Racetimer. The start and finish are at Svartå Folkets hus. Timing is handled by Racetimer.

name: Nätra Fjällskogslopp
location: Hinnsjöstugan, Nätra fjällskog, Örnsköldsvik Municipality, Sweden
description: Nätra Fjällskogslopp is a trail race organised by Nätra GIF youth since 2021. It has quickly become popular and sold out. The race offers four distances: 22 km, 15 km, 9 km and a 2 km children’s race, all through the beautiful and challenging terrain of Nätra Fjällskog. The courses follow trails and forest roads, cross bogs on boardwalks, and offer wonderful nature experiences with views of Hinnsjön and the coastal landscape. The start and finish are at Hinnsjöstugan, and the organisers ask participants to respect the nature reserves along the course.
course_highlights: Beautiful terrain with trails, forest roads and boardwalks across bogs
Climbs up Selshöjden and Västanåhöjden, with views of the coast and Ulvön
A downhill stretch with enchanting views over Hinnsjön
additional: Start times: 22 km at 9:30, 15 km at 9:45, 9 km at 10:00 and 2 km at 10:10. Bibs must be collected by 9:00. A clothes drop-off is available at Hinnsjöstugan. Recommended equipment includes a mobile phone, water/energy supplies and a map of the course. Parking is along the road past Hinnsjöstugan, a short walk from the start. Participants are asked to choose their starting position according to their ability, with those aiming to race at the front. The courses are marked with ribbons in different colours for each distance. Clear course markings and participant support.

description: Häv & Gräv Vikbovändan is a recreational race held on Vikbolandet in Östergötland during the summer. The main event is approximately 45 km long and features a scenic route with both gravel and asphalt sections. Along the way, participants can enjoy local delicacies at several aid stations. The event offers running, cycling and duo categories, as well as a children's race in the forest on illuminated trails. It is a welcoming, nature-oriented experience focused on community and local flavours.
course_highlights: Approximately 45 km, with a 50/50 mix of gravel and asphalt
Aid stations with locally produced delicacies and the opportunity to visit production facilities and a shop
Children's race in the forest on illuminated trails, with a medal and ice cream afterwards
additional: Start times: Children's race 10:30, Running + duo 11:30, Cycling 12:30. The children's race is free and does not require advance registration. Helmets are mandatory for cycling. All participants who register in advance receive a collapsible cup to use at the aid stations to avoid disposable cups. On-site registration may be available if places remain, up until 30 minutes before the start. Participants who register in advance receive a collapsible cup, which they should bring along during the race to reduce the use of disposable cups.

name: Kivijärviloppet
location: Kivijärvi, Övertorneå Municipality, Norrbotten County, Sweden
description: Kivijärviloppet is a traditional cross-country race organized by Kivijärvi IF since 1970. The race is held in the village of Kivijärvi in Tornedalen and offers several distances, with a 12 km main event open to both women and men, with no age categories. The race is known for its long history, beautiful courses and generous prize table, thanks to its sponsors. Many well-known athletes have taken part over the years, giving the race strong local and national standing.
course_highlights: Cross-country race with several distances: 0.5 km, 1.5 km, 5 km, 7.5 km and 12 km
Course markers in different colors for each distance: yellow, white, blue and red
The race has used the same courses since it began in 1970, except during Covid
additional: Courses are marked with colors for different distances: 0.5 km and 1.5 km (yellow), 5 km (white), 7.5 km (blue), 12 km (red). The race offers a generous prize table for children, adults and recreational runners, thanks to generous sponsors. Kivijärvi is about 15 kilometers south of Korpilombolo along the Övertorneå road. Information on the official website applies to 2026 and does not confirm the date of August 7, 2027.

name: Fjällmaraton Sälen by EQPE
description:
Fjällmaraton Sälen by EQPE is the trail-running adventure for anyone looking to combine the joy of running, a challenge and spectacular scenery. Choose between 42 km, 21 km or 10 km—and bring the whole family! Children up to 12 years old can run for free in Barnens Fjällmaraton.
The course takes you over rugged mountain trails, boardwalks and winding paths all the way to the finish and the lively After Run party at Experiumtorget in Lindvallen. Fjällmaraton Sälen is a deluxe running experience. Secure your place and experience the mountains with us!
